**Mechanical & Electrical Engineer**

**Central London | 40 Hours per Week | £50,000 - £60,000 per annum, depending on experience**

We're looking for an experienced Mechanical & Electrical Engineer to join our team as the dedicated resident engineer on a flagship Central London contract.

This is a resident role where you'll take ownership of the building's critical engineering systems, ensuring a safe, compliant and exceptional environment for our client and building users. You'll be the first point of contact for all M&E matters, building strong relationships with stakeholders while delivering both planned and reactive maintenance to the highest standards.

If you're a hands-on engineer who enjoys autonomy, problem-solving and taking pride in a building's performance, we'd love to hear from you.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Take full responsibility for the day-to-day operation and maintenance of all mechanical and electrical systems across the site.
* Carry out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance activities.
* Diagnose and repair faults across electrical, HVAC, lighting, power, water and building services systems.
* Monitor plant performance and proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency and compliance.
* Escort and manage specialist subcontractors carrying out maintenance and repair activities.
* Maintain all statutory compliance records, maintenance documentation and asset information.
* Build strong working relationships with the client, acting as a trusted technical advisor on site.
* Support the delivery of minor project works, upgrades and installations.
* Ensure all activities are undertaken safely and in accordance with current health & safety legislation.

**About You**

* Qualified in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering through a recognised apprenticeship, NVQ Level 3, City & Guilds or equivalent.
* Proven experience working within commercial buildings, facilities management or building services environments.
* Strong knowledge of both mechanical and electrical building systems.
* Excellent fault-finding and diagnostic skills.
* Experience delivering both planned and reactive maintenance.
* Confident working independently and managing your own workload.
* Strong communication skills with a customer-focused approach.
* 18th Edition qualification would be advantageous for electrically biased candidates.

# ****About Aalyria:****

Aalyria is a leading technology company that supplies laser communications technology and temporospatial software-defined networking platforms to the aerospace industry. With technology acquired from Google, Aalyria is at the forefront of innovation in satellite and airborne mesh networks, as well as cislunar and deep-space communications. We are revolutionizing the orchestration and management of planetary mesh networks using any radio or optical spectrum, any orbit, and any hardware across land, sea, air, and space.

## ****Role Overview:****

We are looking for a Solution Architect (SA) with deep expertise in end-to-end SATCOM and 3GPP mobile network architecture, spanning RAN, Core, transport, and service orchestration, with a strong focus on 4G/5G Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) and Direct-to-Cell and their evolution toward 6G, to join our growing NTN/DTC team within the Spacetime division.

The role sits at the intersection of space systems, cellular networks, and cloud-native telecom orchestration platforms, owning architectural definition, product evolution and definition, end-to-end system architecture technical trade-offs, and system-level optimization across the full stack, to be implemented in Aalyria’s Spacetime platform.

The role also involves a heavy customer-facing component, with the candidate expected to be comfortable interfacing with customer stakeholders at all levels and be able to lead technical discussions with customers or prospective customers, with an eye towards business development.

## ****Key Responsibilities:****

* ****SATCOM and NTN RAN optimization, O-RAN SMO/RIC, SON & Radio Resource Management (RRM)****
* + Design and optimize radio resource management (RRM), scheduling, beam management, mobility, and interference coordination mechanisms
  + Support development of customer resource management solutions and Spacetime algorithms to be implemented by Aalyria Spacetime software engineering team
  + Address satellite/NTN-specific constraints (Doppler, delay, ephemeris, beam hopping, power limits, feeder link constraints)
  + Drive the design and support the implementation in Spacetime of advanced orchestration and resource management capabilities for Direct-to-Cell architectures, including spectrum reuse, sharing and coexistence with terrestrial MNO networks
  + Ensure RRM and Spacetime implementation alignment with regulatory and spectrum constraints (ITU-R, regional regulators)
* ****System & Solution Architecture domain****
* + Understand and, in some cases, end-to-end system architectures for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) with knowledge of the end-to-end service chain (UE → RAN → Core → Transport/SDN (inc. front, mid and back-haul) → Service layer)
  + Lead customer engagement and projects around architecture for LEO/GEO/MEO and multi-orbit satellite systems integrated with 3GPP 4G/5G (Rel-17+) and future 6G concepts
  + Own architectural blueprints, interfaces, and decomposition across space segment, ground segment, and mobile network domains, in particular in their interactions with Aalyria’s Spacetime.
  + Lead customer solution architecture, requirements collection and translation into Spacetime requirements and project execution
  + Drive technology selection and trade-off analyses, where needed
  + Drive technical proposal writing for commercial and public sector customers
* ****Standards & Ecosystem****
* + Understand, interpret and apply 3GPP specifications (RAN, SA, CT) relevant to Spacetime for NTN, SCS, and D2D and RAN OAM/orchestration (e.g. RAN3, SA2, SA5) and Mobility (e.g. RAN2, etc)
  + Contribute to or interface with standards bodies and industry forums (e.g. 3GPP, ETSI, GSMA, O-RAN, ESA NTN Forum, MSSA, etc)
* ****SDN, Cloud-Native, Network Orchestration & Automation****

* + Design network and 3GPP RAN/CN function orchestration and FCAPS
  + Define interfaces and APIs for automation, orchestration, and inter-domain coordination
* ****Delivery & Stakeholder Interface****
* + Lead specific technical customer or prospective customer engagements, proposals, including also applications to public sector grant proposals across US, UK, EU and globally (e.g. ESA, UKSA NTIA, NSF, etc) as needed, and conduct technical reviews
  + Translate high-level requirements into implementable technical architectures
  + Act as technical authority across engineering, product, and partner teams

## ****Required Qualifications:****

* Strong background in 4G/5G mobile network architecture (RAN + Core)
* Proven experience and understanding in SATCOM system architecture (space + ground)
* Deep understanding of 3GPP architecture, protocols, and interfaces
* Hands-on knowledge of RAN concepts: PHY/MAC, scheduling, mobility, beamforming, interference
* Experience producing architecture documents, system diagrams, and technical specifications
* Understanding of 3GPP APIs, RAN OAM and control plane concepts, networking protocols and interfaces
* Understanding of concepts of cloud native, NFV, orchestration and automation, network automation and orchestration APIs, etc
* Strong communication and leadership skills, ability to interface with business stakeholders in the telco, satcom and defense sectors at all levels and work collaboratively in a cross-cultural team environment

## ****Preferred Qualifications:****

* Direct experience with NTN, SCS, or Direct-to-Cell systems
* Familiarity with 3GPP Rel-17+ NTN enhancements
* Experience and/or familiarity with satellite (GEO, MEO, LEO, etc) constellations and other aerospace systems and their challenges
* Knowledge of O-RAN (SMO, RIC, xApps/rApps)
* Knowledge of GSMA APIs
* Exposure to simulation, modeling, or digital-twin tools for radio or network planning.
* Experience with network orchestration and APIs
* Software engineering/development experience or experience with scripting and/or simulation languages
* Registered patents in relevant wireless communications techniques
* Publications in journals/conferences in the field of satellite or mobile communications

## ****What We Offer:****

* ****Opportunity to lead high-impact, innovative projects in the space technology and digital infrastructure domain.****
* A dynamic, international environment collaborating with leading research centres and industrial partners.
* Competitive compensation package based on experience.
* Hybrid working policy with flexible arrangements.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a strong backend Software Engineer to join the Spacetime team and help build the next generation of our platform: orchestration of 5G Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) and Direct-to-Cell services, and coordination between satellite operators and terrestrial mobile networks through 3GPP- and O-RAN-aligned interfaces.
Spacetime orchestrates radio resource management, the scheduling of pointing and handovers for steerable directional antennas and laser terminals, and the control plane for routing and switching across highly dynamic networks such as non-geostationary satellite constellations. In the cellular domain, Spacetime acts as the RIC/SMO for the NTN itself. The NTN work extends the platform with RAN and Core network models and with federation interfaces through which Spacetime coordinates with the SMOs of terrestrial mobile network operators for TN-NTN coordination.
First and foremost, this is a software engineering role. You will design and build distributed systems in a modern, cloud-native codebase, working side by side with our 3GPP/NTN solution architects who own the standards and systems expertise. Engineers on the team routinely pick up the telecom domain as they go, therefore deep prior knowledge of it is a genuine advantage, not a prerequisite.

Develop and maintain the Spacetime platform using C++, Golang, Java, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers
Build scalable, distributed systems on Kubernetes
Design and develop Spacetime features for 5G NTN and Direct-to-Cell orchestration, including RIC/SMO capabilities for the NTN, network model extensions, and federation APIs for TN-NTN coordination with terrestrial operators' SMOs
Translate 3GPP and O-RAN concepts and interface specifications into clean, well-tested software, in collaboration with our solution architects
Integrate with other components of the Aalyria platform to ensure end-to-end functionality
Develop and maintain documentation related to the software design and implementation
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and technologies related to 5G NTN, O-RAN, and satellite communications
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code
Troubleshoot and debug issues in the software

Professional experience working in C++, Golang, and/or Java
Knowledge of gRPC and Protocol Buffers
Experience building and operating distributed systems
Familiarity with wireless communications, modeling of wireless performance, or satellite communications

We know that engineers who combine strong software craft with deep 3GPP/O-RAN domain expertise are rare, and rarer still in 5G NTN. Experience in any of the areas below will make you stand out, but we do not expect any one candidate to cover them all. If you are a great software engineer and these topics excite you, we will give you the environment and the domain experts to master them.
Professional software development experience on systems related to 3GPP 4G/5G networks: RAN (eNB/gNB, CU/DU), Core (EPC/5GC), or their management and orchestration (OAM, FCAPS, NRM/network models)

Experience with wireless standards work or applying 3GPP/ETSI/O-RAN specifications in production software
Hands-on experience working with Kubernetes and cloud-native telecom deployments (CNFs, Helm, service mesh)
Professional experience with performance optimization of distributed systems
Experience working in the aerospace & defense or telecommunications industry

**Operations Professional Development Program – the UK**

Our Operations Professional Development Program (OPDP) is an entry-level, three-year rotation program designed to offer hands-on experience while promoting personal and professional growth. As a participant from the UK, you will begin the program and first two rotations in your home country at our Witney site, then you will complete your final-year rotation abroad.

Upon completion, PDP participants graduate into their next full-time position in their home country, continuing to grow their career and contributing as an Abbott professional using the foundation of skills, experience and network developed during their time in the program.

**As a OPDP participant you will:**

* Be a regular full-time employee of Abbott and qualify for the same competitive salary and benefits as other Abbott employees.
* Assume full responsibility and contribute as a functional operations professional.
* Rotate through three challenging, demanding, and diverse assignments.
* Develop a well-rounded skill set through assignments in the established learning tracks (see below) for the program.
* Relocate abroad for the final assignment to experience diversity and operations.
* Work within multiple business units during your rotational program at Abbott.
* Have the opportunity to explore possible crossover assignments within other Operation Programs (i.e. Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Operational Excellence).
* Be paired with a mentor to assist in the development of your operations career.
* Create a personalized growth plan to serve as a step-by-step guide towards the experiences, knowledge, and resources necessary to achieve your career goals
* Obtain training customized to support your individual growth and development.
* Report to a department manager in each assignment who will oversee your day-to-day responsibilities.

**OPDP rotation overview:**

* In the UK, the OPDP rotation is based on annual rotations over the three year Program. Your career with us will commence working directly with the FreeStyle Libre sensor product, learning the manufacturing process. A series of rotations across functions will follow in Technical, Operations Planning, Quality Assurance, Project Management or Engineering.
* No assignment is repeated; each is with a different Assignment Manager
* OPDP participants starting the program in Summer 2027 will complete a three-year program with the final international (overseas) rotation ending in June 2030.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s Degree/Master’s in Engineering (Automation/Mechanical/Electrical), Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Food Science, or related disciplines (grade 2:1 or higher)
* Interest in pursuing a career in Operations – Production, Engineering, Plant Quality, etc.
* Track record of outstanding academic performance and co-curricular activities.
* Has the capacity to apply skills and knowledge to address operational challenges and add value to the business.
* Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Possess strong interpersonal, leadership & communication skills.
* Eager to learn and has the flexibility and willingness to work on different projects.
* Previous work experience in internship or co-op work experience.

The Sr. Specialist, Country Study Start Up proactively drives and executes all start up and maintenance related activities and deliverables for assigned studies and sites in their assigned country or countries. The Sr. Specialist, Country SSU is responsible and accountable for on-time, budget and quality delivery and execution of the start-up and maintenance activities. Acts as a site start up expert and provides SME support and mentoring of Specialists, Country Start Up by delivering training and change management in the adoption of new technologies and processes. * Ensure successful and on time and quality execution of start-up and maintenance activities for assigned sites and studies. Advanced competency in establishing the country/site activation plans and priorities including risk assessment and mitigation plans with CCOM/COM, Area SSU and CSM Lead, Contract Manager, CTS/Regulatory Affairs, and ability to work across multiple complex protocols and Sites. Proactively identifying and communicating issues impacting delivery and providing proposed solution
* Attend regional/area start up calls and provide input for assigned sites/studies. Collection of essential documents from sites and completing quality check (ALCOA) Compile and submit ethics and other required local document packages including customization of ICFs, patient facing materials and safety reporting.
* Coordinate with Regulatory and CTS on CA submission and approval status to assure alignment with other site activation requirements. Lead Collaborations with contract manager, Site Monitor, Area CSM Lead regarding activation timelines to assure timely site activation. Review site and/or IRB/EC comments on ICFs and routing for approval by required functional areas.
* Trigger clinical supply shipments. Complete IP release activities and triggering IP shipment. Issue site green light letter and activating sites in IXRS. Track all start up and maintenance related activities in Vault SSU as appropriate.
* Maintain local country and site intelligence database and EDLs in Vault. Able to mentor junior personnel on Vault. Maintain SSU performance metrics and KPIs for assigned sites/studies.  Provide start up updates and metrics to CCOM/COM and Area SSU and CSM Leads. Support COM / CCOM to analyse and drive improvements in Country SSU performance metrics. * Train and mentor Specialists, Country Start Up
* Participate in process improvement initiatives as required.

  

Qualifications

  

* Bachelor's Degree (degree in health care or scientific field) highly preferred or equivalent years of experience required
* Senior experience of clinical research  and study start up management experience for the designated region.  Must have hands on experience in interpreting regional clinical research regulations and processes.
* Experience working with central and local IRB/EC sites, inclusive of reviewing site and/or IRB/EC comments on ICFs and routing for approval by required functional areas
* Adept and experienced working with Vault SSU in the capacity of essential document processing, IP release, and ICF IRB/EC review. Experience working with remote/virtual teams.

**About Allica Bank**

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

**Department Description**

Security is a hands-on, delivery-focused team that helps Allica Bank move quickly while maintaining strong, proportionate, and effective security controls.

The team combines day-to-day operational support with continuous improvement, automation, control assurance, and stakeholder partnership across the bank.

We work closely with Technology, Engineering, Product and business teams to make security practical and effective, while ensuring our controls support the requirements of a regulated banking environment.

**Role Description**

* The purpose of this role is to strengthen Allica Bank's identity and access controls by making access easier to request, safer to approve and simpler to evidence. The role will combine day-to-day IAM operations with engineering, automation, and continuous improvement to reduce manual effort and improve the security and governance of identity services.
* The role sits within Security and focuses on Identity and Access Management, primarily across Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Entra Identity Governance, Azure identity, access management and security controls, with support for Google Cloud Platform IAM governance, engineering and automation as that capability develops.
* The successful candidate will contribute to the day-to-day running of IAM services, including access requests, joiner/mover/leaver activity, access reviews, privileged access, RBAC, application SSO, and application onboarding. Alongside BAU responsibilities, they will identify and deliver improvements to processes, controls, and automation.
* This is not a purely operational IAM role. The successful candidate will be expected to run IAM services, engineer improvements, automate repeatable work, strengthen controls and help mature identity services across the bank.
* Experience using automation and AI tools to improve processes, reduce manual effort and strengthen security controls is desirable.
* Success in this role will be measured through the quality and timeliness of IAM operations, stronger identity governance and evidence, improved automation, and reduced manual effort.

**Principal Accountabilities**

* Operate and maintain IAM services, including user lifecycle management, access requests, provisioning, deprovisioning and access changes across Microsoft Entra ID and integrated applications.
* Manage identity governance and access controls, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), least-privilege access, Conditional Access and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
* Manage access reviews and certifications, including reviewer engagement, evidence collection, exception handling, remediation tracking and reporting.
* Onboard and integrate applications into the IAM/IGA platform, including SSO, SAML/OIDC, SCIM provisioning and secure authentication using Microsoft Entra ID.
* Support application and vendor onboarding from an IAM perspective, assessing authentication, provisioning, privileged access, logging, ownership and access review requirements.
* Maintain effective IAM controls and audit evidence, supporting internal and external audits and regulatory requirements.
* Identify and deliver improvements through automation, improved workflows, better request processes, clearer ownership and enhanced reporting, reducing manual effort and improving control effectiveness.
* Support identity-related issues and investigations, working with application owners, Technology, Security and other stakeholders to resolve access issues and manage associated risks.
* Maintain IAM documentation and operational standards, including process guides, access models, onboarding standards, control evidence, and runbooks.
* Support wider identity and cloud access services where needed, including Azure identity, access management and security controls, credential lifecycle management, and Google Cloud IAM governance, engineering and automation.
* Provide clear reporting to Security leadership, highlighting IAM risks, control status, work in progress, blockers, and remediation actions.
* Support related control and regulatory activities, including Risk Smart Indicators and Data Subject Access Requests, where IAM input or evidence is needed.

**Personal Attributes & Experience**

* Experience in Identity and Access Management, Security Operations, Cloud Security or technical operations, ideally within a regulated or control-focused environment.
* Good hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Azure identity, access management and security controls, including users, groups, Enterprise Applications, SSO, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management and access management controls.
* Understanding of IAM principles and controls, including least privilege, RBAC, privileged access, joiner/mover/leaver processes and segregation of duties.
* Experience supporting access reviews, remediation, audit evidence and operational controls, with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
* Comfortably balancing BAU operational work with hands-on engineering, including improving processes, writing or adapting scripts, documenting workflows and automating repeatable tasks.
* Able to work effectively with application owners, Technology, Security, suppliers and non-technical stakeholders to translate access requirements into practical and secure controls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate access issues, identify root causes, and recommend practical improvements.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain identity risks, controls and needed actions in plain English.
* Strong ownership and accountability, particularly where access approvals, evidence, remediation and control outcomes are involved.
* Understands the importance of effective, auditable controls in an FCA/PRA-regulated environment.
* Able to consider the end-user experience when designing and improving access processes, balancing security, usability, and operational efficiency.
* Microsoft identity and governance: Microsoft Entra Identity Governance, Conditional Access, PIM, access reviews and Enterprise Applications
* Automation and scripting: Microsoft Graph, PowerShell, Logic Apps, Azure Functions or similar automation tooling
* Azure identity, access management and security controls
* Application integration: SAML, SCIM, OAuth, OpenID Connect, SSO onboarding and secure provisioning patterns
* Google Cloud Platform IAM governance, access models, engineering standards and automation
* 1Password or similar credential management platforms
* Cloud audit logging and identity monitoring
* Service desk and IT workflow platforms

The successful candidate does not need experience across every technology listed. Curiosity, the ability to learn quickly, and a strong understanding of IAM principles are more important than knowledge of a specific product.

# Physical Security Analyst

London, Greater London, England, United Kingdom

## **About AlphaSense:**

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

**Location: London, Hybrid**

**About the Role**

The Physical Security Analyst will serve as AlphaSense's on-the-ground security presence in London, UK, protecting our people, facilities, and sensitive assets across our EMEA operations. This is a broad, hands-on role that spans physical security operations, incident response, and introductory insider risk support—with a primary emphasis on physical security.

You'll own day-to-day physical security for our London office while serving as the local point of contact for security incidents and escalations. You'll work closely with AlphaSense's Insider Protection team in New York City, relaying ground-level observations, supporting risk reviews, and contributing to a regionally-informed security posture. This role is well-suited for a security professional with 4+ years of experience who is ready to take on real ownership and grow into a broader security function over time.

**About the Team**

This role sits within AlphaSense's Insider Protection team, which is responsible for identifying, investigating, and mitigating risks posed by trusted insiders—whether through malicious intent, negligence, or compromise. The team partners closely with HR, Legal, IT, Security Engineering, and business leadership. As the London-based member of this team, you'll bring a local perspective and on-site presence that our global team cannot replicate remotely.

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the primary on-site security point of contact for AlphaSense's London office, owning day-to-day physical security operations
* Monitor and manage physical access control, visitor management, and badging—ensuring appropriate coverage and flagging anomalies
* Conduct periodic site security walk-throughs and risk assessments, recommending mitigation measures to security leadership
* Lead first-response on physical security incidents—tailgating, unauthorized access, workplace concerns—documenting findings and escalating appropriately to the NYC team
* Support access provisioning and deprovisioning processes in coordination with IT, with particular attention to high-risk joiners, movers, and leavers
* Provide physical security data and observational support (badge history, visitor logs, site context) to insider threat investigations conducted by the broader team
* Assist in identifying behavioral indicators or anomalies at the site level that may warrant further review by the Insider Protection team
* Coordinate with building management and local security vendors to maintain consistent security standards and address facility-level concerns
* Maintain clear, thorough incident logs and produce written summaries for security leadership in a format suitable for escalation or recordkeeping
* Support basic security hygiene efforts in the office environment—clean desk compliance, device handling awareness—in coordination with IT
* Liaise with local law enforcement, emergency services, or vendors as situations require
* Stay current on regional security trends and threat landscape relevant to UK and EU operations

**What We Are Looking For:**

* 4+ years of experience in physical security, corporate security, loss prevention, or a related field, ideally in a technology, financial services, or similarly fast-paced environment
* Hands-on familiarity with physical security systems—access control platforms, video surveillance, visitor management tools—at a level beyond basic use
* Strong analytical and documentation skills; able to produce clear written incident reports and communicate findings to a remote leadership team
* Sound judgment and professional maturity when handling sensitive personnel matters or security incidents
* Comfortable operating independently in an environment where the broader security team is remote and across a significant time zone difference
* Intellectually curious about insider threat and security investigation concepts, and eager to build capability in those areas with team support

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience in a corporate investigations, compliance, or risk function—even at a supporting level
* Exposure to insider threat concepts, DLP tools, or security monitoring workflows
* Familiarity with how physical access data intersects with logical/IT access governance and identity management
* Experience coordinating with HR, Legal, or Facilities on sensitive matters
* Relevant certifications such as PSP, CPP, or Security+, or interest in pursuing them
* Background in financial services, market intelligence, or a data-sensitive technology environment

**Why Join Us?**

* Own physical security for a meaningful regional office at a company where protecting AI-driven market intelligence is a genuine strategic priority
* Work within a modern security organization that values convergence between physical security and insider threat functions—your on-the-ground observations will directly inform risk decisions made at the global level
* Receive direct mentorship from AlphaSense's Insider Protection team leadership, with a clear development path into investigation and insider risk work
* High ownership from day one: this is not a support role, it's a critical local function with real visibility

Job ID: 10525888 | Amazon UK Services Ltd.

## Description

Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit. Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world.  
  
The Amazon Leo Partner Services (ALPS) organization is looking for a Senior Partner Development Manager to join our Global Enterprise Services team, supporting our rapidly growing indirect partner ecosystem. You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for strategic reseller partners, technology solution distributors, and systems integrators who deliver Amazon Leo satellite connectivity to end customers across multiple verticals including maritime, energy, enterprise, and transportation.  
  
This role offers you the opportunity to serve as the technical lead and voice of the partner for organizations ranging from regional resellers to multi-national telecommunications companies. You will provide dedicated technical and operational support and guidance to ensure partners maintain high technical standards in their Amazon Leo service delivery, enabling them to successfully deploy, manage, and support satellite connectivity for their customers. Your technical acumen and partner-facing skills will enable you to represent Amazon Leo within partner environments, driving discussions with partner technical teams on service implementation, integration challenges, support escalations, and technical optimization. You will provide proactive technical guidance to help partners plan and implement solutions using best practices while keeping their Amazon Leo deployments operationally healthy and resilient. You will also coordinate partner onboarding and integration projects, applying project management skills to ensure successful technical delivery across the partner ecosystem.  
  
This position may require access to export-controlled information (ECI) subject to EAR and ITAR. Final employment decision is contingent upon satisfactory completion of export control screenings and obtaining any necessary export licenses or approvals, based on nationality, citizenship, and other factors considered by applicable export control regulations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Serve as primary technical point of contact for strategic partners post-launch, ensuring optimal performance and technical success of Amazon Leo service delivery through partner channels  
  
Provide proactive technical guidance to partner technical teams, monitoring performance metrics and conducting regular technical reviews to maintain high service delivery standards  
  
Coordinate partner onboarding and integration projects, managing timelines, dependencies, and technical milestones across multiple partner accounts  
  
Manage technical support processes for partner-reported issues, ensuring rapid resolution and maintaining partner confidence in Amazon Leo technical capabilities  
  
Coordinate engineering support resources and drive technical optimization initiatives across the partner ecosystem  
  
Engage partners and their field teams in technical workshops and focused meetings to communicate technical best practices and post-sales support protocols

Anthropic is seeking Software Engineers to join our Observability team within the Infrastructure organization. The Observability team owns the monitoring and telemetry infrastructure that every engineer and researcher at Anthropic depends on—from metrics and logging pipelines to distributed tracing, profiling, error analytics, alerting, and the dashboards and query interfaces that make it all actionable. By joining this team, you'll have a direct impact on the reliability and operational excellence of Anthropic's research and product systems.

We're building next-generation observability systems—high-throughput telemetry pipelines, fleet-wide continuous profiling, eBPF-based tracing and network visibility, and agentic diagnostic tools—so engineers can detect, diagnose, and resolve issues in minutes rather than hours, even when the answer lies in the kernel, the network stack, or an accelerator rather than on a dashboard.

* Drive fleet-wide efficiency by turning continuous profiling and utilization telemetry into actionable optimization insights across CPU, memory, and accelerator fleets
* Partner with Research, Inference, Product, and Infrastructure teams to ensure observability solutions meet the unique needs of each organization

Do you want to work with senior leaders from a range of the UK’s leading companies and their pension schemes? Are you interested joining a growing team aiming to address the challenges facing UK defined benefit pension schemes today? If so, then the Aon covenant team is for you!

We are currently recruiting someone with  consultancy experience and on a professional qualification pathway into the Pensions Covenant & Security Team in London or St Albans. The role will be primarily responsible for providing pension scheme trustees and sponsoring companies with credit and corporate finance advice on the financial strength (the “covenant”) of their sponsors, the impact and regulatory consequences of corporate activity, and the implications for the pension scheme’s strategy.

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually 50% of the time and from our London or St Albans office (with a requirement to attend a “team day” in London once a week, currently on Mondays).

**What the day will look like**

* Producing high quality written financial strength analysis reports and present the findings to key stakeholders;
* Providing pension scheme trustees with advice on the financial strength of their sponsors and assessing the impact of any corporate activity (e.g. impact of M&A, special dividends, etc. on pension funds) or scheme related activity (e.g. surplus release);
* Interacting with senior level pension fund trustees and company executives (normally at finance director or CFO level) and senior members of the Aon team both within the Covenant & Security team and more widely; and
* Supporting the team in growing the covenant practice through internal and external networking channels.

**Covenant and Security Team**

Aon’s Covenant and Security consulting team has seven members and has advised the trustees/employers of over 300 pension schemes whose assets vary in size from £10m to £6bn. We are seeking an Associate Consultant or Consultant who has an interest in credit advisory and corporate finance.

The Covenant and Security team advises DB pension schemes on the financial strength of their corporate sponsors (e.g. food retailers, car manufacturers and drug companies), on the impact that corporate events (e.g. restructuring, M&A, special dividends, etc) have on their ability to support their associated defined benefit pension schemes, and whether they can safely release surplus funds from their scheme.

The financial strength of a sponsor influences how much investment risk a pension scheme can absorb, the valuation of the pension scheme’s liabilities and its longer-term strategy for paying pensions. These schemes can often be meaningful (e.g. £ billions) and represent some of the UK’s largest institutional investors which explains why DB pensions dominate the financial press and why pensions covenant consulting is such a high-profile role. The Covenant team has growth plans and appointed a new leader in 2026, so this is a great opportunity to have a real impact whilst furthering your career.

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

* Experience of working in a financial advisory environment such as restructuring, corporate finance, or transaction services would be positive or an in advisory capacity to DB pension scheme trustees or sponsors. Due to the nature of the role an understanding of both DB pension schemes and financial strength of companies is relevant. We anticipate the successful candidate will have relevant experience in one of these areas but not necessarily both – instead an interest, ability and willingness to learn is key.
* Sound understanding of corporate financial statements and likely to have an accountancy (e.g. ACA or ACCA) or CFA qualification. We are happy to speak to candidates on the actuarial qualification pathway but are unlikely to be able support completion of those qualifications in this role.
* Strong interpersonal, report writing and presentation skills
* Candidates that are highly organised, able to manage competing priorities, and with excellent communication skills
* An understanding of employer covenant matters and/or DB pensions would be useful, but not required as training would be provided

This is a hunter role at its core - built for someone who thrives on originating and closing six- and seven-figure ARR deals in competitive, technically sophisticated markets.

Join us a Vulnerability Management Analyst with BPL CIO- own the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle across the entire estate: from scanning orchestration through triage, prioritisation, SLA assignment, remediation tracking, exception management, and reporting. You are the single point of accountability for knowing, at any moment, what vulnerabilities exist in the organisation’s systems, how severe they are in the context of the business, who is responsible for fixing them, and whether they are being fixed within agreed timescales.

This role is critical because vulnerability management sits at the intersection of several key processes in the CISO operating model. The pre-release security sign-off process checks a service’s open vulnerability backlog before approving a production release — if a service has critical vulnerabilities open beyond SLA, it cannot ship new features. The monthly Risk and Compliance Steerco reviews vulnerability trends as a key risk indicator. The Board receives quarterly reporting on mean time to remediate and open vulnerability counts. The PCI DSS compliance programme depends on quarterly internal and external scanning with clean results. All of this runs through you.

The role requires a particular kind of judgement. You will deal with hundreds or thousands of vulnerability findings from multiple scanning tools (SAST, SCA, DAST, infrastructure scanning, CSPM, container scanning, penetration testing). Most of those findings will not be equally important. Your job is to contextualise them: a critical CVSS vulnerability in an internet-facing payment API is fundamentally different from the same CVSS score on an internal development tool with no access to sensitive data. You prioritise based on exploitability, business context, exposure, and regulatory sensitivity — not just generic severity scores.

If you are someone who combines analytical rigour with excellent stakeholder management skills— someone who can triage a thousand findings into a prioritised, actionable list and then work across a dozen engineering teams to ensure the right things get fixed in the right order — this role will suit you.

To be successful as aVulnerability Management Analyst, you should have experience with;

* Demonstrable experience in vulnerability management, security operations, or a related security discipline where you have been responsible for managing vulnerability findings from identification through to verified remediation
* Experience with vulnerability scanning tools across multiple domains: infrastructure scanning (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, or equivalent), application scanning (SAST/DAST/SCA tools such as Semgrep, Snyk, Checkmarx, or Burp Suite), and cloud or container scanning (Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Trivy, or cloud-native equivalents)
* Understanding of CVSS scoring and, critically, the ability to contextualise vulnerabilities beyond raw CVSS scores
* Experience with contextual vulnerability prioritisation approaches: SSVC, EPSS, CISA KEV, or equivalent frameworks that move beyond generic severity to business-contextualised priority
* Data analysis and dashboard creation skills
* Familiarity with PCI DSS Vulnerability management requirements
* Experience managing vulnerability exceptions and risk acceptances in a structured, documented process

* Experience coordinating ASV (Approved Scanning Vendor) scans for PCI DSS, including scope definition, false positive management, and the rescan/remediation cycle required to achieve a clean quarterly scan

## Company Overview

The Yorkshire Cricket Foundation (YCF) is the home of community and recreational cricket, putting cricket at the heart of Yorkshire and inspiring people of all ages, abilities and backgrounds to connect with the game.

From the iconic Headingley Stadium to communities across Yorkshire, the YCF creates opportunities, experiences and a positive impact that supports participation, wellbeing and social connection.

As part of the Yorkshire Cricket network, the YCF delivers programmes, events and initiatives that bring people together, strengthen communities and support the development of clubs and leagues. Working in partnership with schools, clubs, local authorities, faith groups and other organisations, the YCF aims to grow participation, foster inclusive environments and ensure cricket is accessible, welcoming and sustainable across Yorkshire.

## Job Purpose

Reporting to the Head of Business Development, the Impact Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the Yorkshire Cricket Foundation (YCF) can demonstrate the impact of its work to a wide range of stakeholders including staff, trustees, funders and the communities in which the YCF operates.

You will therefore lead on the monitoring, evaluation and reporting of all recreational cricket and community programmes and strategic initiatives, using data to demonstrate the social impact of cricket. The Impact Manager will ensure that programmes (e.g. Wicketz, Women & Girls, Disability) are delivering positive change, meeting funding requirements and improving lives through the power of cricket.

As such, you will be responsible for data analysis and using databases to manage both our internal programme data and externally funded programmes, harnessing the power of data and insight to deliver compelling storytelling.

- Design and implement Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) frameworks to track progress against key performance indicators (KPIs) for diverse community programmes.

- Design and implement primary data collection tools and analyse relevant secondary data sources.

- Translate evaluation findings into actionable learning that informs organisational strategy, practice and future programme development.

## About us

* Work is complete when it answers the agreed question and the result has been evaluated, documented and communicated. Successful approaches should be ready for further development, maintenance or scaling.

---

## Key responsibilities

* Lead product discovery by studying scientific and customer workflows, gathering input from scientists, engineers, leadership and customers, and using prototype feedback to identify problems software could solve.
* Work with scientific and technical experts to turn agreed needs into clear scopes covering research questions, experiments, inputs, outputs, requirements, deliverables and acceptance criteria.
* Own and maintain scoping and delivery documents, including decisions, owners, dependencies, timelines and changes.
* Turn agreed scopes into prioritised work and coordinate delivery across science and software within the agreed roadmap, running planning, retrospectives and product updates and introducing lightweight templates and workflows where needed.
* Agree measures of scientific value, product adoption, workflow improvement, quality and reliability, then recommend product decisions based on results, risks and trade-offs.
* Coordinate release and deliverable readiness with the relevant scientific and technical leads, ensuring results are documented and follow-up or maintenance work is planned.

---

## What you will bring

* Product or project management experience independently leading ambiguous research or technical work from the initial question and requirements through delivery and follow-up.
* Strong professional grounding in at least one relevant discipline, such as product management, research science or software engineering.
* Experience working with scientists and software engineers in a research-heavy or technical environment.
* The ability to understand a problem's inputs, outputs, experiments and evidence without being the domain expert.
* Clear written communication, strong organisation and the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and surface risks.
* A practical, evidence-led approach to process rather than reliance on a particular product framework.

---

## Nice to have

* A scientific or technical background gained through postgraduate study or relevant professional experience, such as work as a researcher, computational scientist or software engineer.
* Experience delivering scientific software, research-heavy products or an internal scientific platform.
* Experience working across scientific and software teams in biotechnology or with external research partners.
* Familiarity with molecular modelling, protein structure, scientific machine learning or the evaluation of data-intensive products.
* Experience using AI tools and automation to improve product workflows while validating outputs and applying critical judgement.

---

## Why join us

* Help shape how Bindbridge turns scientific research and software into products for our customers.
* Work directly with founders and specialists across science, engineering and the commercial team.
* Establish product practices in an early team where clearer planning and delivery will have an immediate effect.
* Meet colleagues in person through company and team meetups when useful, usually in London.
* Receive support for relevant conferences, publications and patents.

---

## Application process

1. CV review - We assess experience defining and delivering complex research or technical projects.
2. Introductory chat - An informal conversation with a Bindbridge team member about your experience and what you are looking for.
3. Product interview - You will work through an ambiguous research problem with a science or engineering lead. The session is a chance to ask questions, draw out expert input and develop a workable scope together, including tasks, dependencies, acceptance criteria and delivery risks.
4. Final interview - A conversation with the CEO about Bindbridge's wider mission and values.
5. References and offer - We check references before making an offer if both sides wish to proceed.

Our interviews require no advance preparation, and we do not use take-home exercises or algorithmic coding tests at any stage of the hiring process. We do not use AI tools to assess candidates. Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all hiring decisions are made by people.

Brave is on a mission to protect the human right to privacy online. * Lead the end‐to‐end delivery of decision‐support software across the full product lifecycle
* Understand complex operational business problems end to end and identify opportunities for data‐driven optimisation
* Drive modelling and system design decisions, balancing implementation time, system behaviour, technical debt and business value
* Prototype, build and deliver industrialised machine learning and optimisation models in Python
* Design and build robust data ingestion, cleaning and processing pipelines

* Ensure software quality through logging, error handling and automated testing
* Harden algorithms against operational and data edge cases
* Quantify product adoption and value capture
* Engage with business stakeholders to gather requirements and feedback
* Contribute to feature prioritisation and roadmap discussions
* Support integration of decision‐support products into operational business processes
* Communicate modelling approaches, trade‐offs and results clearly to technical and business audiences
* Mentor and support junior team members
* Contribute to agile ways of working, including Git versioning, code reviews and delivery predictability

What you’ll bring to British Airways:

* Expert capability in applied machine learning, optimisation and operational research techniques
* Strong Python expertise with experience delivering production‐quality data science software
* Experience working with cloud platforms and modern ML tooling
* Strong software engineering discipline including testing, CI/CD and version control
* Ability to structure complex business and technical problems and propose pragmatic solutions
* Clear communication skills across technical and non‐technical audiences
* Collaborative working style with a focus on continuous improvement
* Systems‐thinking mindset with attention to detail
* Curiosity, resilience and adaptability in fast‐moving environments

Your experience:

* Master’s degree or greater in data science, ML, or operational research, or 6+ years of highly relevant industry experience (required)

* Experience in developing industrialized software, especially data science or machine learning software products (required)

At British Airways you’ll have the chance to take on new challenges and move forward in a way that feels right for you. We encourage all those who work for us to consider opportunities right across our business to help you develop and progress.

We never stand still, and we don’t expect our people to either.

At British Airways we all have a part to play in creating an inclusive place to work. Diverse representation among our people is really important to us and we recognise that all our colleagues are uniquely different and bring their own originality, creativity and identity to work.

Inclusion and diversity is a key driver of innovation and we’re committed to creating a culture where everyone feels that they can be themselves. Role Summary
:   **About the role**

    The British Museum is seeking a Project Curator to join the department of Africa, Oceania and the Americas.  Working on the African Histories and Heritage Programme, you will play a leading role in the delivery of the project: ‘Reconnecting Eastern African Collections and Histories’ (REACH).

    REACH is a new 4-year research and education project aiming to significantly expand knowledge of the British Museum’s Eastern Africa collection and increase its impact. This project will produce an object-based history of the ivory caravan trade and imposition of colonial rule (c1800-1914) in Eastern Africa. Working in collaboration with an international network of partner museums and community stakeholders in Tanzania, Kenya and Uganda, the team will generate new knowledge about museum collections, build strong relationships between partners and share knowledge in East Africa through bespoke schools’ programmes and other activities.

    You will play a vital role in connecting people with the collection, expanding curatorial practice and advancing interpretations of African histories and heritage at the British Museum.

    **About you**

    You are an experienced curator or researcher with a commitment to ethical, collaborative and community-centred approaches to museum collections. Working closely with the Project Lead, you will bring strong research expertise, cultural awareness and the ability to build meaningful partnerships across the British Museum and with colleagues and communities in East Africa.

    You will have knowledge of Eastern African history, anthropology or material culture, experience of archival research relating to African collections or histories, and a strong understanding of the ethical considerations surrounding colonial-era collections. You will also have experience engaging communities, partners or public audiences, project management skills, and a track record of research outputs. You will have knowledge of Kiswahili or another East African language and be willing to travel internationally. Some experience of museum learning programmes would be advantageous.

    **Key areas of responsibility**

    * Lead research into the history and development of the British Museum’s Eastern Africa collections.
    * Build and maintain collaborative partnerships with museums, communities and organisations in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda to deliver research and learning activities.
    * Support research visits and collaborative working with East African partner museums and community partners.
    * Produce and share research findings through publications, events and other project outputs.
    * Improve and enhance the documentation of the Eastern Africa collections.
    * Contribute to the successful delivery of the African Histories and Heritage Programme, working closely with the wider project team and external consultants.

    **About the team**

    You will join a growing team working on the African History and Heritage Programme. Based in the Department for Africa, Oceania and the Americas, this Programme is investigating how material culture – especially from the British Museum collection – can help transform the understanding and presentation of Africa's past and its heritage in a global context. With a particular emphasis on knowledge exchange, collaboration and engaging young people in Africa, the team is undertaking archaeological, anthropological and historical research. AHHP builds on existing research partnerships and is establishing new relationships with academics, museum curators and communities across Africa. This new role is pivotal to the expansion and delivery of the programme.

    **About the Department**

    The Department of Africa, Oceania and the Americas cares for about 350,000 cultural belongings and artworks from across four continents. The scope of the collection is contemporary, archaeological and historical, and includes a large pictorial collection. It spans Africa, the Pacific and Australia, as well as North, Central and South America and the Caribbean. Through historical and more recent cultural artefacts, contemporary artworks and photographs, the British Museum collection highlights the diversity of Africa and its cultures, celebrating creativity and the continent's continued global connections, and telling the story of Africa from the Palaeolithic to the present day.

London, England, United Kingdom

## Opportunity

Brunswick Group’s Investor Brand practice is recruiting for a Senior Account Manager in London.

You will build trusted day-to-day client relationships, keep complex work moving and support Account Directors and Partners on larger programmes.

Investor Brand has three core engines: Financial Communications, Strategic Events and Corporate Brand. These are underpinned by our Film & Live and Design capabilities. The work is varied, from results, M&A and other significant investor moments to naming, rebrands, employee engagement campaigns, annual and ESG reporting, film, content and live experiences.

The Senior Account Manager is part of our wider account management team. You will work closely with account colleagues, Partners, strategists, designers, producers and project managers. The role has no formal line-management responsibility.

**Client and account management**

* Independently manage day-to-day client relationships on smaller engagements and defined workstreams, and support Account Directors and Partners on the largest programmes.

* Plan and run client meetings, status calls and presentations, with accurate follow-up and dependable ownership of next steps.
* Coordinate feedback and approvals, manage expectations and raise risks or sensitive issues early.
* Work as an active member of the wider account management team, sharing client intelligence, actions and opportunities rather than operating as a separate project function.

**Integrated brand and creative delivery**

* Manage projects and workstreams across Financial Communications, Strategic Events and Corporate Brand, with regular involvement in corporate brand and creative work.

* Support discovery, stakeholder engagement, creative reviews, production and launch, keeping the client informed and the work connected.

* Identify follow-on needs and wider client opportunities, and raise them with the relevant account lead.
* Contribute to account plans, pipeline updates, case studies and practice-wide new business activity.

* Build strong working relationships across account management, Investor Brand, Brunswick’s advisory teams and the wider global firm.

## Opportunity

Brunswick is on an exciting journey to harness the power of artificial intelligence and data science to enhance the way we work and the advice we provide to clients. As we continue to expand our AI capabilities, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join our growing team. 

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining AI-powered applications that deliver real value across the business. Working closely with our existing AI team, you will help build innovative solutions using modern AI technologies, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs). 

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with hands-on experience developing and deploying AI applications who enjoys solving complex problems, working with a high degree of autonomy, and turning emerging technologies into practical, high-quality products. 

You will thrive in this role if you are curious, creative, and passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges. You take pride in writing robust, maintainable code and enjoy collaborating with colleagues to continuously improve and expand our AI capabilities. 

## About the Role

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

* Support, run, and iterate existing AI applications.
* Design, develop, deploy, and maintain new AI applications which can be scaled across multiple business use cases, driving operational and commercial outcomes.
* Trial and test solutions with end users to iterate and optimise them.
* Research and analyse data sets using a variety of statistical and machine learning techniques.
* Track and understand the evolving AI landscape.

## What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will be a highly professional, well-rounded individual with strong problem-solving skills, engineering expertise, strategic thinking, and excellent interpersonal skills. They will have a strong academic background complemented by an outstanding career to date. Standout candidates will demonstrate: 

* Experience building solutions with large language models (LLMs) and a deep understanding of the broader generative AI landscape.
* Experience designing datasets, conducting model evaluations, and fine-tuning foundation models to improve task-specific performance.
* Strong Python development skills, including experience writing production-quality code.
* Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, HTML, and CSS.
* A solid understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.
* An undergraduate degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Mathematics or Computer Science, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment with changing priorities and an iterative, user-focused approach to development.
* Curiosity, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
* Previous experience in professional services would be advantageous.
* Experience developing cloud applications on Microsoft Azure would be advantageous.
* Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g. CI/CD, Git) would be desirable.
* Knowledge of, or experience with, secure software development practices would be advantageous.

## Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

* Support the development of the annual audit plan, committee reporting and continuous improvement initiatives across the function.

* ACA, ACCA, CIA or equivalent professional qualification, supported by relevant post-qualification experience.

* Experience working with risk registers and Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build credibility across all levels of an organisation.
* Experience leading audit engagements and coordinating multiple stakeholders and resources.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present complex issues clearly and concisely, high quality written reporting skills, and a keen attention to detail.

### FDTD Simulation Engineer (Visible Optics)

Engineering - Currie, Midlothian

---

About the Company 

Cnuic Technologies is a deep-tech company based in Edinburgh. We are building next-generation optical systems aimed at pushing the limits of precision manufacturing and nanoscale engineering. We are backed by substantial venture capital and have received grant support from several UK innovation agencies. 

We are a small, focused team working on genuinely difficult hardware problems. The work is fast-paced and collaborative, and we give engineers the space and resources to do serious technical work. If you want to build something from the ground up and care deeply about getting the physics right, this is a good place to be. 

About the Role 

This is a principal-level engineering role focused on the design and development of metasurface  
enabled optical systems. You will be working at the intersection of electromagnetic theory, nanophotonic simulation, and macro-scale optical design, taking ideas from first-principles. 

At the core of this role is a deep understanding of how light interacts with matter at sub-wavelength scales. You will design and simulate metasurfaces and metamaterials using rigorous electromagnetic methods, manage the coupling of light from macro-scale optical systems into metastructures, and ensure that designs are both physically sound and fabrication-compatible. 

You will own the end-to-end optical and nanophotonic simulation workflow. This means using Lumerical FDTD and RCWA for unit cell and structure-level electromagnetic analysis, carrying out dispersion analysis and effective medium theory (EMT) modelling, and then bridging to macro-scale system behaviour using Zemax or equivalent ray tracing tools. You will define tolerances, validate against experimental data, and iterate. 

This is a lead role, so you will also help set technical direction for the optics team and work closely with colleagues across simulation, hardware, and systems engineering. 

About You 

* You are comfortable working independently and taking ownership of an open-ended technical problem without a detailed brief.

* You can communicate complex photonics concepts clearly to engineers from other disciplines and to leadership.

* You are happy to defend technical decisions in design reviews and take critical feedback constructively.

* You are comfortable in a startup environment where priorities evolve as experimental results come in.

Technical Requirements 

Electromagnetic Simulation and Nanophotonics 

* Strong, hands-on experience with Lumerical FDTD for sub-wavelength structure simulation, including metasurface unit cell design, near-field analysis, transmission/reflection spectra, and phase response characterisation.

* Solid grounding in electromagnetic theory relevant to nanophotonic design: effective medium theory, dispersion analysis, Mie resonances, and coupled-mode theory as they apply to dielectric and hybrid metal-dielectric metastructures.

* Experience designing and optimising metasurfaces for functional optical properties, such as spectral filtering, phase control, or polarisation manipulation.

* Familiarity with RCWA (rigorous coupled-wave analysis) as a complementary simulation method to FDTD for periodic structures.

Optical System Design 

* Working knowledge of Zemax  
  OpticStudio (or equivalent ray tracing tools such as Code V) for macro-scale optical system design, including modelling of light coupling from bulk optical components into metasurface or nanophotonic structures.

* Understanding of how to represent  
  metasurface phase and amplitude response within a ray tracing environment, and how to iterate between the nano-scale and system-level simulations to optimise integrated performance.

* Experience with tolerance analysis, aberration management, and the practical constraints of manufacturing and alignment.

Benefits & Compensation  

We offer a competitive salary appropriate to a principal-level role. In addition: 

* Equity: A meaningful allocation from our option pool, reflecting the foundational nature of this hire.

* Life insurance: Standard comprehensive coverage.

* Office: A well-equipped, modern workspace in West Edinburgh, designed for both focused individual work and team collaboration, with dedicated areas to step away and recharge.

job_description:
**The Role**

We are hiring a Product Marketing Lead to own product marketing for our Risk Applications and Enabling Services portfolio, the products our customers depend on for AML screening, transaction monitoring, payment screening, fraud detection, case management, and regulatory reporting. This is the largest and most active half of our product portfolio, with new products and features shipping continuously. You'll take ownership of each product wherever it is in its lifecycle.

You will report to the VP of Product Marketing and be one of two Product Marketing Leads building out a newly-forming function. This is a foundational hire, with real latitude to shape how product marketing operates at ComplyAdvantage. You will partner closely with the Product Director who owns this portfolio, translating a steady stream of product and feature launches into positioning, enablement and go-to-market execution that Sales and Customer Success actually use.

We run a structured, phased launch process that's still evolving and you'll help shape it as you go, deciding what's genuinely differentiated and worth a moment, and what ships quietly as a release note.

This role has no direct reports today. It is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who wants to own outcomes end to end rather than manage other people's output; someone who can take ambiguous input from Product and Sales and turn it into sharp positioning and a launch that lands, without needing a team underneath them to get there.

**What You Will Do**

Own product marketing for Risk Applications & Enabling Services. You are responsible for positioning, messaging, launch execution and enablement for this portfolio, end to end, from early roadmap conversations through GA and beyond.

Take ownership of products at every stage. Some products in this portfolio are newly launched or launching soon; you'll pick up their ongoing positioning, enablement and buyer narrative rather than starting from a blank page, and build out what's missing.

Lead launches end to end. Decide what earns a flagship moment versus what ships quietly, and own the launch plan, messaging and positioning brief for the releases that matter most.

Build the enablement Sales actually uses. Sales decks, demos, battlecards and FAQs written from a real understanding of the buyer and competitive landscape, not templated from a brief.

Contribute to competitive intelligence and win-loss. This is shared across the Product Marketing team for now; you'll help build the muscle until we have dedicated coverage.

Represent UK/EMEA (and APAC in the interim) market context. You're the voice of our primary market in company positioning, even as we build out dedicated regional coverage over time.

Partner with Product without owning their roadmap. You influence priorities through evidence, buyer feedback, competitive dynamics, win-loss signal, not through authority. You operate as a peer to a Product Director, not a downstream recipient of their decisions.

Use AI in your own work. We expect Product Marketing to use AI-assisted workflows for research synthesis, competitive analysis, and first-draft positioning and content. This is how we work, not an aspiration.

**What We Are Looking For**

*Essential:*

* 7-10 years of overall professional experience, including 3-5+ years in product marketing
* Experience at a high-growth, multi-product technology company; you understand what it means to market a portfolio, not a single product, and to prioritize across competing launches
* Demonstrated ability to own a launch end to end: positioning, sales enablement, messaging and go-to-market, without heavy oversight
* Strong independence and autonomy: comfortable defining your own plan within a broader strategy rather than waiting for detailed direction
* Proven ability to influence without authority: you can shape a Product Director's or sales leader's thinking through evidence and argument, not reporting lines
* Excellent written and verbal communication: able to translate complex, technical product capability into a sharp, buyer-relevant narrative
* Comfort operating in a regulated, technical B2B environment, translating product and engineering input into content a commercial audience can act on
* Demonstrable AI adoption in your own working practice; already using it to work differently, not just interested in it

*Preferred:*

* Experience in fintech, security, or identity markets
* Experience marketing AI or agentic tools, platforms, or features
* Experience marketing to multiple distinct buyer personas within the same portfolio
* Familiarity with win-loss and competitive intelligence practices
* Experience partnering with Sales on enterprise or upmarket motions

**What Success Looks Like**

At 60 days: You understand the Risk Applications and Enabling Services portfolio end to end, including any products that have recently launched or are approaching launch, and where our competitive and buyer knowledge has gaps. You've built working relationships with the Product Director for this portfolio, Sales leadership and Customer Success, and can articulate what's differentiated in our portfolio and why it matters to a buyer.

At 4 months: You are running launches independently through the tiered model. Your highest-priority products have positioning and a sales narrative that Sales trusts and uses, and your enablement materials are the ones reps actually reach for. You've built a first cut of the win-loss picture for your portfolio and can speak to it with data, not anecdote.

At 8 months: Your portfolio's go-to-market motion is measurably working; Sales can point to deals your positioning and enablement helped win. You're a trusted, senior voice in cross-functional planning for this portfolio, and you're operating at a level that could reasonably take on more scope as the team grows.
