job_title: Senior Director, Engineering - Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns
job_description:
## The Opportunity

Fitch Ratings is looking for a builder, a challenger, and a boundary-pusher to lead the engineering organization responsible for all applications and services powering our Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns lines of business. This is not a role for someone who optimizes within the status quo — it's a role for someone who questions it, reimagines it, and has the courage and capability to do something about it.

As Senior Director, you will have executive ownership of four engineering teams comprising a couple of dozen engineers. You'll lead a talented, multidisciplinary group tackling some of the most consequential technology challenges in global financial intelligence — maintaining and evolving the systems that analysts and clients depend on today, while simultaneously building the next generation of platforms from a position of real creative freedom and organizational backing.

This is a role for someone who moves fast, experiments boldly, and doesn't wait for permission to try something new. Someone who has broken things in the pursuit of building something better, who sees constraints as invitations to be clever, and who brings an infectious sense of possibility that raises the ambition of everyone around them. If you've spent time deep in machine learning or AI systems — not just using them, but building them — that's not just a bonus, it's the kind of background that makes this opportunity even more compelling. But this role goes far beyond any single discipline: it's about leading a culture of relentless innovation across every dimension of how software gets built and delivered.

---

## We'll Count on You To

**Challenge the conventional and set a bolder technical vision** Own the strategic direction, execution, and engineering culture of four high-performing full-stack engineering teams. But more than managing what exists — interrogate it. Ask the uncomfortable questions about why things are built the way they are, and lead your teams toward answers that are smarter, faster, and more powerful. Set a technical vision that doesn't just improve the current state but genuinely reimagines what's possible for the platforms powering Fitch's most critical analytical work.

**Build, develop, and inspire exceptional people** Lead, mentor, and empower a team of team leads and engineers across a range of technical backgrounds and experience levels. Foster a culture where intellectual curiosity is celebrated, where experimentation is encouraged, and where people feel safe enough to take risks and learn loudly from what doesn't work. Attract and retain engineers who are hungry, inventive, and proud of both the quality of what they ship today and the audacity of what they're building toward.

**Reimagine and modernize critical platforms** Oversee the full lifecycle of the applications and services central to Fitch's Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns analytical workflows. Balance the discipline of maintaining production-grade systems with the creative ambition to tear down and rebuild what no longer serves the business well. Be the person in the room who asks "what if we started over?" — and who knows when that's exactly the right call.

**Drive greenfield innovation without apology** Identify and actively pursue opportunities to design and build net-new applications and platforms that replace or leapfrog legacy approaches. Embrace the blank canvas — and bring the rigor of world-class software delivery with you. This is an organization that wants to see bets placed, experiments run, and lessons learned fast. Be the kind of leader who creates that energy and channels it into things that last.

**Push the frontier of AI, ML, and intelligent systems** Go beyond adopting AI tools — define how intelligent systems become structural, load-bearing parts of the platforms your teams own. Whether that's LLM-powered workflows, ML models embedded in analytical processes, agentic automation, or AI-augmented developer tooling, bring the depth to evaluate, architect, and champion these capabilities with real technical conviction. If you've built ML systems from the ground up, that experience will resonate deeply here — and you'll have the platform to apply it in genuinely high-stakes, high-visibility ways.

**Influence across a complex and interconnected stakeholder landscape** Act as a strategic partner to a broad and diverse set of stakeholders — including senior leadership, analytical teams, operations, and business relationship management — whose workflows and outcomes depend directly on the platforms your teams own. Navigate a rich ecosystem of technical interdependencies, partnering with peer engineering teams whose systems integrate with, depend on, or are shaped by what your teams build. Build organizational credibility through consistent delivery, clear technical vision, and the ability to bring bold ideas to life in ways that earn trust across the business.

---

## What You Need to Have

* **18+ years of hands-on software engineering experience**, with substantial time in senior technical leadership roles overseeing multiple teams and disciplines
* **Proven multi-team leadership** — demonstrated experience leading team leads and engineers across full-stack disciplines; a track record of building high-performing, inventive engineering cultures at meaningful scale
* **Deep technical credibility and hands-on instinct** — strong command of modern software architecture, cloud-native platforms, and production-grade application delivery; you know when to go deep, and your teams and peers will know it too
* **Full-stack engineering expertise** — proven background with modern enterprise technology stacks, including React, Java, and/or Python in production environments, deployed across AWS and/or Azure
* **A bias for experimentation and innovation** — a demonstrable history of pushing technical boundaries, challenging inherited assumptions, and driving teams toward approaches that are meaningfully better — not just incrementally improved
* **Modernization and greenfield experience** — proven ability to evolve existing platforms while simultaneously designing and delivering new systems; comfort making bold architectural decisions in both constrained legacy and open greenfield environments
* **People leadership and talent development** — demonstrated ability to attract, grow, and retain exceptional engineers and engineering leaders; a builder of teams as much as systems, with a genuine investment in the growth of the people around you
* **Cross-functional stakeholder management** — proven ability to partner effectively across analytical, operational, and business-facing teams as well as peer technical organizations; skilled at managing competing priorities and driving alignment across a complex interdependency landscape
* **Executive communication** — the ability to translate bold technical vision for non-technical audiences, build trust through delivery, and make complex ideas land clearly at every level of the organization
* **Education:** Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field — or equivalent expertise demonstrated through impact

---

## What Would Make You Stand Out

* **An ML or AI engineering background** — if you've spent meaningful time building machine learning systems, training models, designing intelligent pipelines, or architecting AI-native applications, that depth is genuinely exciting for this role and will shape how you lead, what you build, and the kind of talent you attract
* **Deep cloud-native expertise** — hands-on mastery of AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, microservices architecture, and sophisticated CI/CD and deployment pipelines for large-scale application delivery
* **Generative AI and intelligent systems experience** — hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, or production ML systems; the ability to move between engineering credibility and strategic vision without losing altitude
* **AI-native delivery leadership** — direct experience implementing AI-augmented development lifecycles, intelligent testing pipelines, or AI-assisted tooling that materially raises the quality and velocity of engineering teams
* **Transformation and platform modernization leadership** — a history of successfully reimagining complex, production-critical platforms while maintaining delivery continuity and rallying teams around a compelling future state
* **A maverick streak with enterprise judgment** — the rare combination of someone who genuinely challenges conventions and moves with urgency, but knows how to do it within a complex organization without losing stakeholders along the way
* **Financial services domain knowledge** — familiarity with analytical workflows, credit ratings processes, or how technology creates leverage in financial decision-making
* **Technical thought leadership** — contributing to open source, speaking at industry events, publishing engineering content, or establishing technical direction that influences well beyond your immediate team

---

## What We Offer

* **A genuine mandate to innovate** — not a talking point, but real organizational backing to question, challenge, and rebuild the platforms powering some of Fitch's most critical business lines
* **Executive visibility and strategic influence** — direct access to senior leadership, the platform to shape engineering direction across consequential lines of business, and the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on how global financial intelligence is delivered
* **The intersection of depth and breadth** — lead a capable, experienced engineering organization while simultaneously running a bold innovation agenda; this role sits at a genuinely rare intersection of operational accountability and creative freedom
* **A place where ML and AI expertise becomes architecture** — if you've built intelligent systems, this is an environment where that knowledge doesn't sit on the shelf; it shapes product direction, platform design, and how the organization thinks about what's next
* **Cutting-edge technology and continuous learning** — access to the latest AI tools, frameworks, platforms; training and conference budgets; and the expectation that you'll stay at the leading edge and pull your teams forward with you
* **Career acceleration at scale** — high visibility to the most senior leaders at Fitch, a clear path to principal and executive roles, and the opportunity to define what AI-driven financial technology looks like in practice
* **A culture that rewards curiosity** — an environment where bold ideas are welcomed, where experimentation is celebrated, and where the best thinking wins regardless of where it comes from

You'll work on live test and MMM delivery under supervision from the start, and you'll be the first person looking at a client's data when a number doesn't behave the way it should. It's a role for someone who wants to learn causal measurement properly, in a business where it's the product rather than a side project.

> **Team:** Marketing Science

> **Level:** Graduate — Entry (Data Science Career Development Framework)

> **Location:** London

---

## What you'll do

### Marketing mix modelling (MMM) & Testing Services

* **Assemble and validate test data** — geo-level spend and conversion series, checking pre-period parity between treatment and control, spotting the coverage gaps that invalidate a design before it launches
* **Support test design under review** — market matching and control selection, power and minimum detectable effect sanity checks, and identifying contamination risks such as geo-targeting settings that don't behave the way the platform's documentation claims
* **Run analysis and read the results honestly** — pre-treatment fit diagnostics, lift estimates with their intervals, and what a null result does and doesn't tell you
* **Qualify client data for MMM** — spend coverage across channels, whether there's enough variation in spend to identify an effect at all, series length and granularity, collinearity between channels, and gaps that will bias the result
* **Assemble and validate model input datasets**, and investigate the discrepancies that surface when you do
* **Support model runs and read the diagnostics** — fit, residuals, convergence, and whether a channel's estimated contribution is plausible
* **Contribute to output-extension work** under review — building on an existing MMM result, for example forecasting or budget scenario work derived from it
* **Compare results across methods** — where MMM, incrementality, and platform-reported figures disagree, understanding why is the interesting part of the job

### Model trust and diagnostics

* **First and second line on client trust queries** — investigating why a number changed, working in SQL against client data to isolate the cause
* **Distinguish a bug from a methodology change** — attribution window changes, model recalibration, data feed gaps, and platform reporting shifts all look similar from the outside and have very different signatures underneath
* **Triage PSPs on model trust**, resolve what you can, and escalate what turns out to be a genuine model problem with a clear diagnosis attached
* **Reconcile platform-reported figures against our measurement** — why walled-garden ROAS disagrees with ours is the hardest recurring question in the business, and you'll be learning it from the inside
* **Log and tag incidents consistently**, so recurring failure patterns become visible and can be automated away rather than repeatedly handled

### Client communication and enablement

* **Run templated explainer sessions** under review, walking clients through how our measurement works
* **Draft documentation and presentations** above the core explainer content, and feed recurring query themes back into the source material
* **Fact-check methodology claims** in product marketing collateral before it goes out

---

## What we're looking for

We’re looking for someone with a strong foundation in maths and stats with clear communication who is looking to growth their skillset.

### Technical

* **Working proficiency in SQL** — you can investigate a discrepancy yourself rather than asking someone else to pull the data
* **Python**, or a demonstrated ability to pick it up quickly. Most of our analysis tooling sits there.
* **Grounding in inferential statistics** — hypothesis testing, uncertainty, statistical power, and what a null result means
* **Some exposure to experimental design** — randomisation, control groups, confounding, and why a badly designed test is worse than no test
* **Strong AI fluency** — you use AI tools to get moving on unfamiliar problems and plug gaps in your own knowledge, and you QA the output before you rely on it

### Communication

* Clear, concise written communication — a large share of this job is explaining something technical to someone who isn't
* Composure in client-facing conversation, including when the client is unhappy with a number
* Real attention to detail, and the discipline to log things consistently even when it's dull
* High agency — you'll be given ownership as fast as you demonstrate you can hold it

### Nice to have

* Exposure to marketing, ecommerce, or advertising data
* Familiarity with Bayesian methods and/or modelling
* Experience with cloud data tooling
* Experience presenting to or supporting external stakeholders

### How you'll grow

Level doesn't gate what you're allowed to attempt. It scales how much support you get doing it. A Graduate can work on MMM output-extension work; it just carries heavier review than it would for a Mid.

**Incrementality delivery:** Triages test type and routes to Product where self-serve applies. Prepares and validates test data. Supports design and analysis under review.

**MMM delivery:** Qualifies client data. Assembles model inputs. Contributes to output-extension work under heavy review.

**Model trust & PSPs:** First and second line on trust queries. Triages PSPs, attempts resolution, escalates genuine model problems with a diagnosis.

**Client sessions:** Runs templated explainer sessions under review.

**Documentation & enablement:** Drafts documentation and presentations above the core explainer. Feeds recurring query themes back into explainer content. Fact-checks methodology claims in product marketing collateral.

**Automated trust workflows:** Logs and tags trust incidents consistently so recurring failure patterns are visible. Surfaces themes from the query queue into workflow design.

**Supervision:** Detailed instruction; works closely with senior colleagues. Development time protected against product and consultancy workload.

**Upskilling is funded, not assumed.** A named share of entry-tier capacity is held for development work and protected against the support queue. Nobody upskills in the gaps between tickets, so we don't pretend otherwise.

**The step to Junior** is independence: running templated sessions and first-line triage unaccompanied, and resolving the full range of inbound queries with only moderate senior input.

**The step to Mid** runs through one of two routes — owning a piece of MMM output-extension work, or taking a recurring trust problem you already handle manually and turning it into automated monitoring that alerts an account manager before the client notices. Both are genuinely technical, and both are allocated deliberately rather than first-come-first-served. From Mid, you own MMM and incrementality delivery with senior sign-off.

## Why Fospha

* **Causal measurement is the product.** Geo experiments, MMM, difference-in-differences, and Bayesian attribution are what the business sells. You'll be working on them, not adjacent to them.
* **Live client work early.** You'll be on real test and MMM delivery in your first months, with review rather than distance.
* **Structured support, not sink-or-swim.** Session allocation rules, a maintained escalation list, and protected development time exist so that being new isn't a liability.
* **A published ladder.** You'll know what the next level requires and what evidences readiness for it from your first week.

## About Gradiated

* Gradiated is a research lab focused on inference. We co-design software and hardware for efficiently serving open-weight models.
* Our goal is to maximize intelligence per joule. We work across model behavior, software, systems, and silicon to find better ways to run models.
* We start by thinking about the model as a mathematical function, and map that out onto hardware and then build software on top of that which is custom to each model. This maximises performance and removes wasted abstractions.
* We are early. You will help set the technical direction and the way the company works.

## Why this role exists

* We are building an inference research team to find where current hardware and software waste time, memory, and energy when serving open-weight models.
* You will measure those bottlenecks, test changes across the inference stack, and turn useful results into production systems. Your findings will also inform our silicon work.

## What you will do

* Measure target models and workloads on current NVIDIA and AMD hardware.
* Design and implement kernels, numerical formats, memory layouts, and cache policies.
* Change runtimes, schedulers, distributed execution, and serving paths when they limit the system.
* Test latency, throughput, energy use, model quality, correctness, and reliability on real workloads.
* Turn research results into production services.
* Share research publicly so that others can learn about how inference research is done.
* Work with the silicon team to identify hardware bottlenecks and design opportunities.

## Problems you may work on

* Kernels and fused execution paths for exact model shapes.
* Low-bit formats that preserve model quality.
* KV-cache layout, movement, compression, and reuse.
* Sparse and mixture-of-experts execution.
* Speculative and parallel decoding.
* Prefill and decode scheduling across multiple GPUs.
* Performance models that explain the gap between hardware limits and measured results.
* Runtime designs for long-running agent workloads.

To achieve this, the programme will create a secure environment to store and link together regional health and care data from primary care, acute, community, social care and multi-modal sources.

You’re excited by the significant potential for improving access to health data for research and motivated by the opportunity to contribute to this dynamic and ambitious programme across our region and nationally.

  You’re comfortable working independently as part of a busy, supportive team. You are able to work professionally and effectively across a complex and dynamic ecosystem, building trusted and effective relationships to achieve the programme’s aims.

  **About the role:**

  The Research Manager role belongs to a new cluster of roles homed at the University of Exeter that supports researchers to successfully access the SWSDE for health data research projects. The RM will act as the first point of contact for researchers, and will work closely with regional NHS data contributors, the wider SWSDE team, and University of Exeter Professional Services to ensure researchers are given clear and timely information about how the SWSDE can support their planned research.

  The role will primarily focus on triaging projects and managing workflows for the SWSDE, and you will be encouraged to identify and design process improvements as the programme scales. You’ll be encouraged to share your detailed understanding of researcher priorities across other SWSDE workstreams (including communications, technical, operational, Information Governance) to ensure the programme continues to seamlessly meet the needs of all users.

The Data, Automation, and Predictive Sciences (DAPS) function of GSK Research Technologies focuses on large-scale data generation, curation, analysis, and prediction to increase the Probability of Technical and Regulatory Success (PTRS) of assets and unlock upper quartile ambitions.

Collaboration is key, as DAPS will only be successful by working in close partnership with matrix teams within Research Technologies functions, Research Units (all therapeutic areas), R&D Digital & Tech (RDDT), R&D AIML, and Risk & Compliance.

We are seeking a Principal Scientist within the Cheminformatics (CIX) group.  You will leverage large proprietary internal datasets to develop, integrate and embed advanced computational methods and predictive in silico models that accelerate the discovery of medicines.  With a focus on machine learning, cheminformatics and computational chemistry methodologies, you will help drive the development and delivery of key new capabilities for our internal BRADSHAW automated design platform.

**In this role you will have the opportunity to:**

* Build, validate and deploy machine learning models spanning cheminformatics, computational chemistry and quantum mechanics and inform go/no-go decisions across drug discovery programmes.

* Contribute to and validate production-quality code implementing state-of-the-art cheminformatics, computational chemistry and quantum chemistry methods that accelerate and improve decision-making on drug discovery programmes.
* Prepare and present results of key validation experiments, details of capability builds, and developments on active drug discovery projects to internal and external groups in a way that is both informative and accessible to the non-subject matter expert.

* PhD or MSc in Cheminformatics, Computational Chemistry, Informatics, Life Sciences or equivalent with a strong Chemistry foundation.
* Expertise to programmatically collect, combine, mine and analyse complex biological and chemical data to build predictive models.
* Evidence of a broad knowledge of computational sciences including knowledge of machine learning, computational chemistry and cheminformatics methods applied to drug design across differing modalities.
* Knowledge of related disciplines (medicinal chemistry, HT screening, analytical chemistry, systems biology, DMPK, Tox, Imaging) to enable multidisciplinary approaches to be identified and integrated into a cohesive project plan is preferred.
* Evidence of developing and utilizing computer programming and scripting languages such as Python, Java, C/C++, R with knowledge of basic software development practices.
* Expertise with chemical toolkits such as ChemAxon, RDkit and scientific pipelining tools such as Pipeline Pilot, KNIME.

* Demonstrated ability to work as contributing team member and ability to participate in a matrixed team environment.

**Please note the following skills are not necessary but having at least one of the below is preferred. If you do not have any of them, please still apply:**

* Knowledge of and experience applying DNN to drug discovery including *de-novo* molecular generation, reaction and retrosynthetic prediction, property prediction
* Experience applying modern experimental design and acquisition strategies to library design and high throughput chemistry including methods such as Bayesian optimisation
* Experience with Quantum Mechanical methods (e.g. DFT, QM/MM) to elucidate and predict reaction mechanisms and reactivity that pure data-driven models struggle to capture.
* Experience building or using agentic AI / LLM-orchestrated workflows — tool use, multi-step reasoning, or autonomous/semi-autonomous pipelines — for scientific discovery.

* Test evidence, challenge unsupported conclusions and distinguish observed results from emerging findings or hypotheses before information is used externally.
* Produce and commission concise, accessible and evidence-based outputs for external and internal audiences, working with communications and subject-matter colleagues on editorial quality and dissemination.
* Create cohort, thematic and portfolio-level analysis that identifies patterns, differences, enabling factors, risks and practical lessons across multiple grantees.
* Develop and maintain a structured record of grantee organisational and commercial progress, including fundraising, partnerships, expansion and scaling trajectories.
* Monitor relevant markets, sectors, technologies, policy developments and funding ecosystems to identify trends, opportunities and risks for the Innovation Fund and its portfolio.
* Develop dashboards and briefing products that allow teams and leaders to explore portfolio information and make informed decisions.
* Lead the design of an accessible knowledge architecture across approved systems, with clear taxonomies, naming conventions, version control, ownership, retention and quality-assurance arrangements.
* Establish repeatable processes for capturing knowledge from grant implementation, portfolio meetings, field engagement, events and team transitions, reducing reliance on informal or individual-held knowledge.
* Coordinate timely, evidence-based responses to donor and stakeholder information requests, maintaining source traceability and appropriate review and approval routes.
* Build capability across the team through practical guidance, templates and coaching on knowledge capture, data quality, insight generation and use of intelligence tools.
* Manage relevant suppliers or short-term specialists where required and ensure their outputs are integrated into the wider portfolio knowledge base.

**About You**

You are an analytical and curious professional who can move confidently between detailed evidence, strategic questions and clear communication. You will be comfortable working across disciplines and geographies, and able to build the trust needed to obtain, challenge and interpret information from busy teams and grantees.

* Demonstrable experience generating actionable insights from complex programme, portfolio, organisational or market information, with the ability to move from individual cases to cohort- and portfolio-level conclusions.
* A strong track record of producing high-quality public-facing research, insight or thought-leadership content for non-specialist audiences while maintaining accuracy and evidential discipline.
* Substantial experience in business intelligence, market intelligence, portfolio intelligence, research or an equivalent field, including the use of internal and external sources to monitor organisations and wider market trends.
* Experience designing or improving knowledge-management systems and practices, including taxonomy, metadata, information governance, searchability, quality assurance and adoption by users.
* Ability to work with both quantitative and qualitative information, identify limitations and inconsistencies, and communicate what the evidence does and does not support.
* Confidence using business-intelligence and data-visualisation tools, CRM or grant-management systems, and collaborative knowledge platforms. Experience with tools such as Power BI, Salesforce or equivalent systems, Microsoft 365 and SharePoint would be valuable.
* Excellent writing, editing and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor content for donors, senior leaders, partners, practitioners and public audiences.
* Strong stakeholder-management and facilitation skills, including the judgement to challenge constructively, reconcile different perspectives and agree practical standards across teams.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of how early-stage or growth organisations develop, fundraise, build partnerships and scale, ideally in markets relevant to international development and technology-enabled innovation.
* A practical approach to delivery: able to prioritise, establish light but reliable processes, and balance analytical ambition with the information, time and resources available.

**About your Skills**

The core GSMA skills for this role are:

**Analysis** – Central to turning diverse portfolio evidence into credible insight. This role requires the ability to interrogate qualitative and quantitative information, identify patterns and limitations, test assumptions, and draw proportionate conclusions across individual grantees, cohorts and the wider portfolio. Strong analysis will ensure that public outputs, leadership briefings and donor responses are evidence-based, appropriately qualified and useful for decision-making.

**Communication** – Critical for translating complex programme, market and organisational information into clear and compelling narratives. This role requires excellent written, verbal and visual communication, with the ability to tailor insight products, briefings and thought leadership for donors, senior leaders, partners, practitioners and public audiences without overstating the evidence.

**Stakeholder Management** – Fundamental to obtaining, validating and applying knowledge held across grantees, Innovation Fund colleagues, technical specialists, communications teams, donors and external partners. This role requires the ability to build trusted relationships, clarify information needs, reconcile different perspectives and establish shared standards for the timely, accurate and responsible use of portfolio knowledge.

**Commercial Awareness** – Essential for understanding how grantees develop, fundraise, form partnerships, enter markets and scale. This role requires the ability to interpret business models, organisational progress, funding ecosystems and changing market dynamics, and to connect these developments to the Innovation Fund’s portfolio strategy, support offer and external narrative.

**Delivery** – Important for converting an ambitious insights and knowledge agenda into practical, high-quality outputs and systems. This role requires strong prioritisation and project management across research, intelligence, publication and knowledge-management workstreams, ensuring that dashboards, insight products and stakeholder responses are delivered on time, to an agreed standard and with clear ownership.

👉 Analyse customer needs and identify potential solutions

OverviewApplication

Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‐01 Alpha - our rapidly developed humanoid platform now running in real industrial pilots - and we’re growing the team to take it even further.

# About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on **Prototype Engineer** to build, assemble and maintain hardware prototypes for the end effectors on our robots and the human-worn devices operators use to interface with them. You'll run our prototyping shop, build and maintain test rigs, and support hardware testing and trial sessions — turning CAD files and BOMs into working units, fast. This is a high-paced environment where turnaround is tight and your work directly shapes what the design team builds next.

# What You'll Do

* **Build Prototype Hardware:** Build, assemble and maintain prototype hardware from CAD/BOM through to working units.
* **Operate Workshop Equipment:** Operate 3D printers, CNC and general workshop tools to produce prototype parts quickly and to spec.
* **Prototype with MCUs:** Quickly wire up and prototype with MCU platforms such as ESP32 and Raspberry Pi to support test rigs and hardware validation.
* **Build & Run Test Rigs:** Build, set up and run test rigs and validation jigs for durability, calibration and functional testing.
* **Support Hardware Testing:** Support hardware testing, internal trials and demo sessions, providing hands-on troubleshooting and repair.
* **Turn Around Fast:** Deliver prototype builds within tight timelines to keep pace with rapid design-iteration cycles.
* **Manage the Shop:** Maintain an organised prototyping shop and parts inventory, including fasteners, connectors and components.
* **Feed Back to Design:** Document build issues and feed practical build, assembly and serviceability feedback directly into design decisions.

# What We're Looking For

* Background in mechanical/mechatronic engineering, technician training, or equivalent hands-on hardware experience, with 2-4 years' experience prototyping physical hardware or robotics products.
* Practical skills with 3D printing, hand tools, basic machining, soldering and cable/harness assembly.
* Ability to prototype quickly with MCU platforms (e.g. ESP32, Raspberry Pi and similar), plus basic breadboarding and circuit assembly skills.
* Comfortable reading CAD drawings and BOMs and translating them into a physical build; any level of CAD design capability is a plus.
* Experience building test rigs and supporting hardware testing, trials or demos of prototype hardware.
* A practical, get-it-working mindset with good organisational habits, comfortable in a high-paced, iterative environment.  
    
  Nice to have

  + Any level of CAD design capability — not just reading drawings, but creating or modifying simple parts/fixtures
  + Basic electronics debugging skills (multimeter, continuity checks, simple rework)
  + Experience assembling wearable or compact electromechanical devices
  + Experience in a robotics or hardware startup lab environment

# Head of Data

## Build Humantra’s data capability from the ground up - shape strategy, strengthen foundations, and turn trusted data and AI into smarter decisions and global growth.

**About Us**

Founded in Dubai only 4 short years ago, and we're already growing internationally.

Humantra is a global wellness brand on a mission to help people achieve optimal hydration and unlock their best daily performance.

We believe hydration is the most overlooked foundation of health, energy, and mental clarity. Our electrolyte solutions are designed to support modern lifestyles - whether that's training, travelling, working, or simply getting through a busy day.

**The Opportunity**

Humantra is scaling fast across international markets, and we are looking for our first Head of Data to build the data capability required for our next stage of growth. As the business becomes bigger and more complex, we need to ensure our data is trusted, accessible and turned into information and insight that helps us make better decisions, improve performance and create value.

Reporting into the COO, you will own Humantra’s Data strategy across four core areas: Data Foundations & Governance, Analytics & Business Intelligence, Data Platform & Technology, and AI.

This is a highly hands-on leadership role. You will think strategically about the capability Humantra needs for the future while being comfortable getting into the detail and building what is needed today. You will partner closely with the COO, SLT, Technology and leaders across every function, ensuring data and AI are shaping the decisions that matter.

Initially, the focus will be on building strong foundations - understanding how information is created, captured, defined, stored and shared across Humantra - while solving real business problems and improving the quality of the information people rely on every day.

This is a pivotal role in Humantra’s next phase of growth: an opportunity to build our Data capability from the ground up and fundamentally improve how we understand, operate and grow the business.

**What you'll own**

**Data Strategy & Leadership**

* Set and own Humantra’s Data strategy, translating our business ambitions into a clear roadmap for how we produce, manage and use data.
* Partner closely with the COO, SLT and leaders across the business to understand the decisions they need to make and where better data, information and AI could materially improve performance.
* Assess Humantra’s current data landscape - what we have, how it is created, where it sits, how it flows and where the biggest gaps and opportunities exist.
* Establish clear principles for how Humantra produces, manages and uses data, balancing strong foundations and scalability with the pace and pragmatism of a rapidly growing business.
* Act as the senior advisor on data and AI, ensuring both are embedded in key business and technology decisions.
* Build the Data function as we scale, determining the right capability, structure and resources for each stage of growth.

**Data Foundations, Governance & Quality**

* Build the foundations that allow Humantra to trust and use its data effectively, establishing clear ownership, standards and accountability for critical data across the organisation.
* Map Humantra’s critical data, systems, sources and flows, including how information is captured and handed between teams, identifying duplication, fragmentation and gaps.
* Develop a common business language and data dictionary, agreeing consistent definitions for the metrics, terminology and data points that matter most to Humantra.
* Establish clear sources of truth and improve the processes and handoffs that produce our most important information, ensuring it is captured once and can be used confidently across the business.
* Build a lightweight and effective data governance and quality framework covering accuracy, completeness, consistency, metadata, classification, privacy and security.

**Analytics & Business Intelligence**

* Raise the quality and effectiveness of reporting and analytics across Humantra, ensuring leaders and teams have access to trusted information that helps them make better and faster decisions.
* Partner with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Ecommerce, Operations, Finance, Supply Chain and other functions to understand their reporting needs and opportunities to use data more effectively.
* Identify manual reporting, duplicated work and spreadsheet-heavy processes that can be simplified, automated or replaced with more scalable solutions.
* Establish consistent definitions and standards across dashboards and reporting so teams are working from the same numbers and sources of truth.
* Support teams in improving dashboards in the near term while building towards a scalable, self-service analytics environment.
* Build meaningful company-level reporting that gives the COO and SLT visibility of the metrics and drivers that matter most to Humantra’s performance.

**Data Platform & Technology**

* Own the data platform, selecting pragmatic technology that fits the scale we are at today and can grow with us.
* Design how our systems connect and how information moves between them, working closely with Technology partners to ensure data captured in one place is available where it is needed.
* Build and maintain reliable integrations and data pipelines across our commercial, operational and finance systems.
* Ensure the platform is secure, well documented, scalable and cost-effective, with clear standards for access, retention, privacy and security.
* Own the build-or-buy decisions that shape our data capability, selecting solutions based on business outcomes rather than preference for a particular vendor or platform.

**Artificial Intelligence**

* Own where AI is applied across Humantra, identifying the work where it can make a material difference and prioritising opportunities based on the value they create.
* Establish clear boundaries for where AI should and should not be used, particularly across decisions, data and processes that require human judgement.
* Set clear standards for AI outputs, including accuracy, review and the evidence required before outputs are relied upon for business decisions.
* Build Humantra’s capability to use AI effectively, giving teams the tools, training and working practices to apply it confidently in their day-to-day work.
* Ensure AI is built on trusted data and used responsibly in line with Humantra’s data governance, privacy and security standards.

**Skills & Behaviours**

**Must haves**

* Significant experience in senior leadership roles, within rapidly scaling, high-growth businesses.
* A track record of building or significantly transforming a Data capability rather than only operating within an established, mature Data organisation.
* Experience developing and implementing business-led Data strategies and translating commercial priorities into a clear data roadmap.

* Security and safety posture: identity and authorisation for machine actors, network segmentation for OT environments, and the audit and traceability expectations that come with software commanding physical machines

* Structure and sequence content for independent, self-paced learners with low teacher contact — using chunking, scaffolding, retrieval practice, and purposeful digital interactions to keep learners moving, thinking, and motivated without a live teacher.
* Build courses within school systems to the agreed template and brand, using the available technology to create a polished, consistent learner journey.
* Build a suite of multi-modal resources to bring courses to life — video lessons, voiceovers, screencasts, interactive tools, knowledge checks, and other digital learning assets — alongside the written material.

* Work to a production schedule, hitting agreed milestones for each course on a delivery-linked contract.
* Submit drafts for editorial / QA review and sign-off, and revise efficiently on feedback.
* Understand the constraints around correct licensing and developing IP — using third-party content legally and creating compliant, properly owned material that IOS can continue to use long-term.

* Current or recent teacher with a teaching qualification and strong subject and curriculum knowledge.
* Experience developing lesson materials for online delivery.
* Experience of asynchronous lesson design / course development.
* Understanding of how to design for independent, self-paced learners.
* Assessment design aligned to iGCSE and International A-Level specifications, exam-board requirements, and mark schemes.
* Experience working with an LMS / VLE.
* Willing and able to record video lessons and voiceovers, comfortable on camera and mic.
* Awareness of accessibility and inclusion (SEND, WCAG, readability).
* Self-motivated and self-managing — works to deadlines, comfortable working remotely and autonomously, and confident taking ownership of a course from initial specification through to finished build.

* Experience of synchronous lesson design.
* Familiarity with iGCSE and International A-Level exam-board requirements and specification alignment.

* Understanding of GDPR, copyright/licensing, and safeguarding in online education.

# Head of Strategy and Business Operations

## Partner with InvestEngine’s CEO to build the operating model for our next stage of growth, lead company-wide priorities and turn strategy into measurable results.

## About InvestEngine

InvestEngine is everything the modern investor should need. Unbeatable value, market-leading automation, and built for easy, long-term investing. We've built a strong foundation, have over £3 billion invested, award-winning service, and a passionate team — now we're ready to scale. We are seeking a hands-on Head of Strategy & Business Operations to partner with our CEO in setting the strategic agenda, running the company and building the operating model that will carry us through the next stage of growth.

## About The Role

As Head of Strategy & Business Operations, you will operate at the intersection of strategy, operations and executive decision-making, combining analytical judgement with hands-on execution. You will work closely with the CEO as part of a lean leadership team, leading the Strategy & Business Operations function and a team of five.

You will translate high-level objectives into clear execution plans, operating rhythms, KPIs and measurable outcomes, acting as an integrator who drives delivery across every function in the business rather than managing a large team of your own. This is a newly created role: much of the framework you will run does not yet exist in a formal shape, and building it is a core part of the job.

### What You'll Be Doing

**Operating Model & Company Rhythm**

* Design and run InvestEngine's company operating model, including the goal cycle, executive meeting architecture, business reviews and decision governance.
* Own the quarterly goal cycle end to end, working with function leaders to set targets that are ambitious, measurable and owned.
* Run the executive cadence so that decisions are made once, documented and acted upon, and surface risks and slippage early.

**Strategy & Planning**

* Own the annual and multi-year strategic planning process, from framing the agenda to a plan the leadership team commits to.
* Partner with the CEO and leadership team on strategic planning, prioritisation and resource allocation.
* Structure and answer the company's most significant open questions, including market sizing, prioritisation and build-versus-buy decisions.
* Bring an independent, evidence-based point of view to executive discussions, including where it differs from the prevailing one.

**Cross-Functional Delivery**

* Own the portfolio of company-wide initiatives, with clear prioritisation and formal start and stop gates.
* Lead high-impact initiatives end to end, resolving delivery challenges directly rather than escalating them.
* Embed completed work with the function that will own it as business-as-usual, leaving no residual dependency on your team.

**Performance & Reporting**

* Own the monthly CEO pack and quarterly Board pack, produced from a single, trusted source of truth.
* Develop the KPI framework covering commercial performance, delivery, customer outcomes, cost efficiency and operational risk.
* Build the analysis yourself, working with Data & Analytics on the underlying infrastructure.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a team of five, setting remits, priorities and standards, and hiring into open roles.
* Partner closely with leaders across Product, Technology, Platform Operations, Marketing, Data & Analytics, Finance, Compliance and People, securing outcomes from teams that do not report to you.
* Apply AI and automation practically to reporting, planning and internal workflow to keep the function lean as we scale.

### What We’re Looking For

* Significant experience (typically 8+ years) across strategy and operations in fintech, financial services or another high-growth, regulated environment — for example as Head of Strategy & Business Operations, Head or Lead of Strategy & Operations, Chief of Staff, or a similarly broad leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience building a company operating model rather than administering one designed by someone else, and securing genuine adoption by a leadership team.
* Proven track record leading company-wide initiatives end to end, including embedding them into business-as-usual and stopping those no longer worth the investment.
* Experience managing a team of four or more strategy, operations or programme professionals, with evidence of raising performance.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement; you build your own models and argue from the numbers.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and secure outcomes without formal authority.
* Comfortable in fast-paced environments with limited existing structure, and credible with a CEO, an executive team and a Board.

### What Will Make You Stand Out

* Experience in FCA-regulated financial services, particularly a retail investment, wealth or savings platform.
* Consulting, VC or private equity pedigree alongside substantial in-house operating experience.
* Track record of P&L ownership or measurable commercial performance improvement.
* Experience establishing data, analytics or AI capabilities to support executive decision-making.

## Why Join InvestEngine?

* Partner directly with the CEO on the strategic agenda, and play a central role in how a fast-growing UK investment platform is run.
* A genuine blank page: you design the operating model, then run it.
* Lead an established team of five, with open roles to shape and hire yourself.
* A transparent, open culture with collaboration across every function.
* Hybrid working, London-based — in-person collaboration with flexibility.

The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery.

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.

Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.

Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

* **Building world-class teams:** You'll partner with senior Data leaders to develop and execute talent acquisition strategies that attract top-tier talent across Data Engineering and Data Science.

**Determined**Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.

**Together**Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.

Customers start coming in thick and fast. One asks you for a changed WiFi code. Another wants to know if his important package has arrived. A woman needs directions to her meeting room... and can you help her set up the projector and take an order for drinks?

The mail arrives. You sort through it while dealing with a whole host of other customer requests, remembering to email the customer from earlier to let him know his package is waiting for him in his mailbox. And that’s lunch.

Early afternoon, you sit down with the Community Manager to discuss the organisation of next week’s networking event. You plan and write the invites to customers, then create, print and put up posters on the noticeboards around the centre.

The day is coming to a close. Time to gently ask the large group in meeting room 3 to start wrapping up. Once the last person has left the building and everything’s nice and tidy, it’s time to head home.

Established in 1998, JSM Group is a leading specialist infrastructure engineering company. We design and install the complex power networks, digital infrastructure and specialist systems a future-focused worldwide marketplace needs.

From High-Power grid connections to Critical Utilities. Data Centres to Renewable Energy, our full turnkey solution teams manage the full scope to help advise and deliver complex infrastructure projects at speed, on time and with reduced legislation, technical and commercial risks.

**THE TEAM**

Join the Power Operations team at JSM Group Services Ltd., a leading provider of integrated utility infrastructure solutions. Our combination of end-to-end technical expertise, decades of industry experience, and unlimited fresh thinking makes us a trusted partner in delivering next-generation connectivity in energy and communications across the UK, Europe, and beyond.

Our Power team delivers high-value electrical infrastructure projects for some of the most demanding clients in the sector – from hyperscale data centre operators to major industrial and grid clients. We are building a team of exceptional project management professionals who can drive complex programmes from award through to energisation, and we want people who take real ownership of their projects

**SCOPE OF ROLE**  
  
The Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of electrical infrastructure cable projects within JSM Group’s Power Division, encompassing high voltage and extra-high voltage new cable system new connections, and power network reinforcement schemes for Network Operators. The role holder ensures that projects are delivered safely, on programme, within budget, and to the required quality standards, whilst maintaining strong client relationships and developing the site delivery team. This role is central to the Division’s operational performance and directly contributes to JSM Group’s reputation for technical excellence and reliable project execution.  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**  
  
**Project Delivery**

• Take full ownership of project delivery from mobilisation through to handover and close-out, ensuring adherence to programme, budget, and quality requirements,

• Develop, maintain, and monitor the project programme in collaboration with Planners, identifying and managing critical path activities and key milestones.

• Chair and lead project progress meetings, producing and distributing minutes, action logs, and status reports to internal and external stakeholders.

• Coordinate resource requirements with Site Supervisors and the wider operations team to ensure adequate labour, plant, and materials are available.

• Manage the procurement and delivery of materials, ensuring timely call-off against project schedules and maintaining accurate stock records.

• Oversee the production and management of project documentation including method statements, risk assessments, ITP/ITR schedules, and as-built records, supported by Document Controllers and CAD Technicians.

**Commercial & Financial Management**

• Prepare and manage the project cost plan (CVR), monitoring actual expenditure against forecast and reporting variances to the Operations Senior Manager.

• Identify, evaluate, and submit variations and claims in a timely manner, working with Contracts Managers/Administrators to protect JSM Group’s commercial position.

• Review and approve subcontractor applications for payment and manage subcontract performance against agreed scope and terms.

• Contribute to monthly commercial and financial reporting, including cost-to-complete forecasts and margin analysis.

**Health, Safety & Environment**

• Champion a positive health, safety, and environmental culture on all project sites, ensuring compliance with CDM 2015 Regulations, JSM Group policies, and client-specific requirements.

• Ensure all works are supported by suitable and sufficient risk assessments and method statements (RAMS), reviewed and briefed prior to commencement.

• Conduct regular site safety inspections and audits, ensuring corrective actions are closed out promptly.

• Ensure all site personnel hold valid competency cards (CSCS/ECS), relevant training certifications, and are briefed on site-specific hazards and emergency procedures.

**Stakeholder & Client Management**

• Act as the primary point of contact for the client and their representatives on assigned projects, building and maintaining professional and productive relationships.

• Manage DNO, IDNO, and other statutory authority interfaces, ensuring all consents, approvals, and outage programmes are secured in advance of works.

• Coordinate with Pre-Construction and Estimating teams during tender and pre-construction phases to ensure buildability input and smooth project handover.

• Proactively manage stakeholder expectations, providing transparent and accurate reporting on project status, risks, and opportunities.

• Lead, motivate, and develop the project delivery team including Site Supervisors, Project Coordinators, and Project Administrators.

• Conduct regular performance reviews and one-to-one meetings, identifying training needs and supporting career development within the team.

• Foster a collaborative team environment, ensuring clear communication of project objectives, individual responsibilities, and expected standards of performance.

**Technical Skills**

• Sound understanding of HV/EHV cable installation, jointing, and termination techniques.

• Familiarity with DNO/IDNO technical standards, connection processes, and outage planning.

• Competent in reading and interpreting electrical and civil engineering drawings and specifications.

• Understanding of CDM 2015 Regulations, NRSWA, and relevant industry codes of practice.

**Leadership & Management Skills**

• Proven ability to lead and motivate multi-disciplinary project teams in a field-based environment.

• Strong planning and organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple projects.

• Effective decision-making under pressure, with a structured approach to problem-solving.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present to clients and senior management.

**Commercial Awareness**

• Experience in managing project budgets, cost forecasts, and commercial reporting (CVRs).

• Understanding of NEC3/NEC4 and/or JCT contract forms and their practical application.

• Ability to identify and manage variations, early warnings, and compensation events.

**Digital & Systems Skills**

• Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint).

• Experience with project planning software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or Asta Powerproject).

• Familiarity with document management systems and project collaboration platforms.

• Working knowledge of or willingness to adopt ERP/job costing systems used within JSM Group.

**ESSENTIAL**

• Minimum 5 years’ experience in project management within the power, utilities, or electrical infrastructure sector.

• Demonstrable track record of delivering projects with values typically in the range of £500k to £5m+.

• CSCS Black Card (Manager) or equivalent ECS card.

• IOSH Managing Safely (as a minimum).

• APM PMQ (Project Management Qualification) or equivalent (e.g., PRINCE2 Practitioner).

• Full UK driving licence.

• Right to work in the United Kingdom.

**DESIRABLE**

• NEBOSH National General Certificate in Occupational Health and Safety.

• NVQ Level 6 in Construction Site Management or Construction Project Management.

• First Aid at Work certificate (3-day).

• Experience working on DNO framework contracts (e.g., UKPN, SSEN, National Grid).

• Temporary Works Coordinator (TWC) qualification.

• Cable jointing or electrical installation background (craft-qualified route into management).

#### **About Kinetic**

At Kinetic we’re redefining operational excellence in higher education, conferencing, and events. As the leading provider of software solutions for student accommodation, event management, catering, and residential services, we help institutions streamline operations, elevate customer experiences, and unlock their full potential.

With over 25 years of experience and trusted by more than 350 institutions worldwide, our software empowers universities and venues to run smarter, faster, and more collaboratively. From bustling campuses to dynamic corporate environments, our technology adapts to the rhythm of each organisation — helping them thrive in a fast-changing world.

But we’re more than just software. We’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and collaborators who care deeply about our customers and each other. Our culture is built on empowerment, community, and continuous growth. We believe in giving people the tools, support, and freedom to do their best work — and have fun while doing it.

Joining Kinetic means being part of a purpose-driven business where your ideas matter, your development is supported, and your impact is real. If you’re ready to help shape the future of operational technology in education and events, we’d love to meet you.

#### **The Role**

This isn't your typical finance role. If you want to spend your career buried in spreadsheets doing the same thing on repeat, this probably isn't for you. But if you're someone who wants to learn fast, use AI in a real and meaningful way, work across a genuinely varied finance function, and grow into a qualified accountant - all inside a high-growth software business that actually invests in its people - then keep reading.

Here's what makes this role different from most finance assistant positions out there:

* You'll use AI every single day. Not as a gimmick - as a core part of how finance operates at Kinetic. You'll work with Claude AI APIs to automate processes, improve reporting, and build genuinely smarter ways of working. This is a real AI remit, not a bullet point on a JD.
* Degree? No degree? No problem. We're looking for the right person, not the right certificate. Whether you're an A-level leaver ready to take your first step, or someone earlier in their finance career looking to accelerate - if you've got the drive, we've got the opportunity.
* We'll fund your accountancy qualification. We're committed to supporting the right person through their studies to become a fully qualified accountant. This isn't a vague promise - it's a genuine commitment.
* Variety, not pigeonholing. You'll work across payables, debt management, month-end, intercompany, expenses, cost tracking and more. You won't be stuck doing one thing. You'll learn how a finance function actually works in breadth.
* Real access to senior people. You'll report to the Finance Manager and work directly alongside the CCFO. This is a business where junior people get exposure and their voices heard.
* A culture that invests in growth. We don't just talk about development - we structure roles, responsibilities and support around it. If you want to grow quickly and take on more, the door is open.

#### **What You'll Be Doing**

Your day-to-day will be varied. Here's what you can expect to be working on:

Finance Operations

* Process and vet supplier invoices - including spotting anything that looks off or fraudulent.
* Obtain approvals from business stakeholders and load invoices for payment accurately.
* Perform bank reconciliations and maintain financial accuracy across accounting systems.
* Manage employee expenses, ensuring compliance with company policy.
* Process and reconcile intercompany transactions across group entities.
* Track and monitor costs against forecasts, flagging gaps and helping to update projections.

Debt Management

* Monitor overdue invoices and proactively chase debt with internal and external stakeholders.
* Escalate concerning debt in a timely way, working collaboratively with the wider team.

AI & Process Improvement

* Use Claude AI APIs as an integrated part of your daily work - automating tasks, drafting communications, building reporting tools and identifying smarter ways of doing things.
* Contribute to the identification of continuous improvement opportunities across the finance function.
* Bring a forward-thinking mindset to everything you do.

Month-End & Reporting

* Support month-end processing tasks, working collaboratively to meet reporting deadlines.
* Use cloud-based accounting platforms including Xero and/or NetSuite.
* Engage in ad-hoc projects and tasks as needed - this is a role for someone who embraces variety, not avoids it.

#### **What You'll Bring**

We care more about who you are than what's on your CV. Here's what matters to us:

* Drive and curiosity. You want to learn, you're not afraid of hard work, and you take ownership of what's yours.
* AI enthusiasm. You're excited about using AI tools practically - or you're ready to get there fast. No previous AI experience required, but a willingness to engage with it seriously is non-negotiable.
* Numerical aptitude. You're comfortable working with numbers and have a natural attention to detail.
* Strong Excel skills. Essential. Accounting software experience is a bonus but not required - we'll help you develop this.
* Good communication. You can write clearly, work well with others, and aren't afraid to pick up the phone.
* Adaptability. Things move fast at Kinetic. You're comfortable managing competing priorities and don't need to be told the same thing twice.
* Integrity. Finance requires trust. You hold yourself to a high standard.
* AAT Level 3 (or equivalent) would be an advantage, though not essential.
* Accountancy or bookkeeping experience is a plus, but we're just as interested in the right attitude as the right background.
* High attention to detail, with a genuine curiosity about the "why" behind what we do, not just the "how."

#### **How You Work**

**Benefits & Perks**

At Kinetic, we believe work should come with rewards that make a real difference. Here's just a taste of what you can expect when you join us:

* Fully funded accountancy qualification - we'll support you through your studies to become a qualified accountant. This is a genuine long-term investment in you.
* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) - with extra days the longer you're with us
* Two paid wellbeing days each year, with a budget to enjoy some time out with someone important to you
* Enhanced pension contributions to support your future
* Two paid days a year to give back through volunteering, charity work, or sustainability projects with our Green Team
* Salary sacrifice schemes for electric vehicles and cycle-to-work
* 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme for confidential advice and support
* A full annual health check to keep you at your best
* A flexible benefits platform - from life assurance and learning opportunities to retail discounts and cinema tickets

# Data & AI Governance Manager - AI Governance

### **About Kubrick**

Kubrick is an award-winning AI consultancy helping organizations turn AI ambition into measurable, real-world impact. We design, build and scale solutions that solve complex business challenges and deliver lasting value.

We work with leading organizations across industries including financial services, healthcare, retail, energy, aviation, and the public sector, and partner with some of the world’s leading technology providers, including Microsoft, Snowflake, Databricks, and Collibra.

What sets us apart is how we build capabilities and careers alongside the solutions we deliver. Through continuous learning, hands-on experience, and a collaborative culture, our people develop deep expertise while solving complex, real-world challenges for our clients.

### **The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking AI Governance Manager to join our growing Data & AI Governance capability. This role blends client-facing delivery with thought leadership and internal development responsibilities, helping shape and scale Kubrick’s AI Governance proposition.

You’ll bring deep expertise across AI Governance, from AI responsibility and ethics to model risk management, bias and fairness testing, regulatory compliance and best-practice enculturation of processes and ceremonies. You will lead delivery squads, define strategic roadmaps, and guide the selection, configuration and rollout of relevant governance tooling.

You’ll oversee delivery of a variety of engagements, whether focused on standing up regulatory compliance procedures and processes, assessing maturity and building improvements, designing & performing controls and issue triage processes, or designing AI governance operating models.

The role also requires a strong understanding of how governance adds business value, enabling innovation and guiding innovators through the perceived red tape to boost AI enablement rather than throttle it down.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead delivery of AI governance, Responsible & Ethical AI and maturity workstreams for clients.
* Define and implement enterprise frameworks covering AI and Automation, AI Governance, ownership, policy and standards, issue management, and governance processes.
* Support configuration, implementation, and enablement of tooling.
* Design relevant strategies, processes, and catalogue and documentation structures
* Support mapping of end-to-end data flows and identifying parent and child processes.
* Develop and implement AI Governance frameworks and relevant playbooks, advising on AI strategies, controls and responsible and ethical AI.
* Lead internal squads and coach junior team members, providing delivery oversight and subject matter expertise.
* Engage with stakeholders to translate business needs into AI governance initiatives.
* Contribute to internal growth of the capability - developing playbooks, methods, reusable templates, and IP.
* Participate in pre-sales efforts and develop client proposals that highlight the value of AI Governance.
* Work with Kubrick & client staff of other disciplines to understand and assess requirements, design solutions and inform delivery planning.
* Seek, build, and maintain effective client relationships contributing to Kubrick’s commercial priorities and supporting our partnering approach to working with clients.

### **Key Requirements**

* Experience in AI Governance directly, or good exposure to AI Governance concepts and equivalent experience in related governance fields such as Data Governance.
* Previous consulting experience totalling >5 years of experience.
* Proven experience designing operating models, frameworks, and defining relevant roles.
* Recognised qualifications such as the IAPP AIGP, ISO 42001 certification or similar are preferred
* Strong understanding of core AI Governance concepts and how to balance these with human interests.
* Confidence advising around AI implementations and tools, as well as working with AI Governance solutions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, and written/verbal communication skills.
* Ability to lead delivery teams and provide coaching or line management to more junior staff.

### **Benefits**

* Enhanced paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, above the statutory minimum, with shared parental leave options

* Additional family leave support, including up to 18 weeks parental leave, 5 days dependent care leave, paid fertility treatment leave, and up to 3 weeks paid parental bereavement leave

* 33 days annual leave (25 days annual leave plus 8 public holidays)

* Flexible working options, including flexible start and finish times and part-time arrangements, available upon request

* Hybrid working - choose to work from home, the Kubrick office, or your clients' office (if applicable)

* Pension matching up to 5%

* Unlimited mental health support through Help@Hand, available 24/7 for you and eligible family members

* Financial wellbeing support

* Cycle to Work scheme, save up to 43% on a new bike through Evans Cycles

* Specsavers eye care vouchers

* Internal mobility and career development opportunities

* Recognition and reward programs

* Learning and development opportunities, including professional certifications

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

* Mental health, diversity and inclusion support

### **Diversity & Inclusion**

At Kubrick, we not only strive to bridge the skills-gap in data and technology, but we are also committed to playing a key role in improving diversity in the industry. To that effect, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in the industry, including women, those from ethnic minority backgrounds, members of the LGBTQ+ community, disabled people and those who are neurodivergent.

## Job Description

To support the development, validation and industrialisation of electronic products by carrying out prototype assembly, product testing, fault investigation and technical documentation activities. The role provides hands-on test capability throughout the product development lifecycle, helping to ensure products meet performance, reliability, safety, compliance and manufacturing requirements.

In addition to the core test-engineering focus, the role provides practical R&D administration support by helping to maintain accurate documentation, process discipline, meeting records and departmental coordination. These administrative responsibilities support traceability, efficiency and good control of project information.

## Responsibilities

**1. Prototype assembly and development support**

* Assemble, modify and rework electronic prototypes, test samples and development units.

* Support R&D engineers with bench-level debugging, fault finding and root cause investigation.

* Prepare test samples, wiring harnesses, fixtures and basic jigs to support development and validation work.

* Record prototype changes, observations and test outcomes accurately to support design traceability.

**2. Product testing and validation**

* Plan, conduct and document product verification and validation testing in accordance with agreed test plans.

* Use laboratory and electronic test equipment including Probit Lab equipment, environmental chamber, Hi-Pot test equipment, motion detector test equipment, glow wire test equipment, EMC testing using GTEM equipment, multimeters, oscilloscopes and other electronic test instruments.

* Carry out functional, safety, environmental, pre-compliance, reliability and performance testing as required.

* Analyse test results, identify failures or trends, and communicate findings clearly to project stakeholders.

* Prepare concise test reports, test evidence and supporting documentation for design reviews and project records.

**3. Quality, design and manufacturability**

* Communicate regularly with Quality in Design, Design for Manufacture and R&D engineering teams.

* Provide practical test evidence and technical feedback to support design improvement activities.

* Contribute to design reviews by highlighting validation risks, testability issues and manufacturing considerations.

* Support corrective actions and design changes by reproducing faults, validating fixes and documenting results.

**4.** **Industrialisation** **and manufacturing test support**

* Work alongside Industrialisation teams to define and implement test protocols for manufacturing.

* Support the development of production test methods, test limits and acceptance criteria.

* Assist with the transfer of test knowledge from R&D into manufacturing and production environments.

* Provide engineering support during prototype, pre-production and early production build phases.

**5. R&D administration and process support, secondary responsibility**

* Support adherence to established R&D workflows and approval processes, acting as a point of contact for documentation and procedural queries where appropriate.

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date project files, technical documentation and administrative records connected to R&D and test activity.

* Organise and archive compliance-related paperwork and internal reports to support clear traceability.

* Manage purchase orders, supplier documentation and internal requests when required to support R&D delivery.

* Support onboarding of new team members with process guidance and document access.

* Monitor document flow and help ensure approvals are completed in a timely manner, while maintaining the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive project information.

## Qualifications

**Essential**

* Qualification in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, such as HNC, HND, degree or equivalent experience.

* Practical experience of electronics assembly, soldering, prototype build or test sample preparation.

* Experience using common electronic test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies and signal generators.

* Ability to interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, test procedures and technical documentation.

* Strong fault-finding, analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Good written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear test notes and technical reports.

* Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks.

* Proficiency in MS Office and document management systems.

* Good communication skills for liaising across technical and non-technical teams.

* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team.

**Desirable**

* Experience of EMC pre-compliance testing, ideally using GTEM equipment.

* Knowledge of environmental, dielectric strength, glow wire, motion detector or product reliability testing.

* Experience supporting product certification or compliance activities.

* Experience developing or supporting manufacturing test procedures.

* Understanding of lighting controls, motion detection, embedded electronics or electrical installation products.

* Previous experience in administration, preferably in a technical or R&D environment.

* Familiarity with document control and process management tools.

* Minute-taking experience is desirable.
