OverviewApplication

Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, Sierra, and Airtable.

Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised over $50m from top-tier investors. Most recently, Google Ventures led our series B. We’re growing 5x YoY, our customers are raving fans of the product, and our story has been covered in Fortune, Forbes, TechCrunch, and The Times.

It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

## How we work

We operate with one core principle: velocity. In practice, this means we:

* Optimize everything we do around accelerating rate of learning.
* Do truly great work
* Communicate openly and directly, and with full context.

All while maintaining a hard-earned reputation for craft and quality.

## The role:

We're hiring our first Implementation Specialist to own how our customers first experience the product. You'll take new customers from signature to steady state: handle the configuration, run the training, and get every user live and productive across the Metaview agents that they’ve chosen to get started with.

A great implementation sets the whole relationship up for success. Done well, every end user sees value fast and the customer sees clear ROI against their own success criteria.

This is a brand new role, and there's a ton of room to define what great looks like as we build out the function. It's also one of the most hands-on seats in the company for learning how AI actually gets adopted inside a business. You'll see it happen across dozens of companies a year, up close, at a company defining the category.

## Key Responsibilities:

* Run the implementations for our most strategic customers: work through the plan for each new account, drive the setup, keep it on track, and make sure the customer always knows what happens next.
* Build each customer’s version of Metaview: a lot of this is prompt engineering. You’ll write the instructions that tell Metaview's agents what a great candidate looks like for each role, give the agents context on the company and how it hires, build note templates around the customer's real interview process, and connect Metaview to their ATS and the rest of their stack. You’ll move customers onto the more advanced features once the basics are working.
* Run the trainings: end user sessions, hiring manager onboarding, custom loom videos. Success is sustained and increasing usage from all users across all parts of the platform.
* Watch adoption: spot the teams and users who haven't landed and go back in with targeted training or config changes. You're the customer's first call during the onboarding period, and you know when to pull in the rest of the team.
* Leave things reusable: turn what you build into assets the next implementation can use, and share what you're learning about what makes onboarding land.

## You might be:

* A couple of years into implementation, onboarding or professional services at a B2B SaaS company with a complex, multi-module product.
* Already working in the ops side of recruitment - you know the tools and the workflows as well as the hiring.
* A Metaview power user who's already pushing the product further than most of our team.
* None of these exactly, but you recognise yourself in the next section.

## What you bring:

* **Project management.** Not necessarily a previous job title, but one of your real strengths. Comfortable running several implementations simultaneously, each at a different stage with its own milestones, dependencies and stakeholders.
* **Product fluency.** You like understanding how things work and you're happy in the detail. You'll learn to write a strong ideal candidate profile, work out why a sourcing search is returning the wrong candidates, and teach a hiring manager to get more from an agent. You're comfortable with configuration, integrations, data and prompts, and you use AI on your own work. Metaview experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* **Training and behaviour change.** You can take a complex product and break it into pieces someone can actually use, you adjust when the room isn't following, and you know a session went well when people are using the thing a week later rather than when they said thanks.
* **Hospitality.** You sweat the experience. Implementations are tailored to what each customer needs rather than running the same script, and you're easy to have on a call.
* **Systems thinking.** You instinctively turn a one-off session into something reusable.

## What we offer:

* The best co-workers you’ll ever have, in an environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance.
* Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI.
* High compensation, through cash and equity.
* Your own Ramp card for lunch & dinner whenever you're in the office.
* WFH & learning allowance to set up your own space, plus expense any books/resources/tools you'll need for your role.

At Mind Foundry, people have the opportunity to work on problems that are technically challenging, operationally important and genuinely meaningful. We are a close-knit, multidisciplinary team working on complex problems where advanced AI has the potential to make a meaningful difference in the real world. What makes Mind Foundry different is the way we combine technical excellence with pragmatism, responsibility and partnership. We are ambitious about what AI can achieve, but thoughtful about how it should be designed, deployed and trusted. Our teams work closely together, challenging ideas constructively, learning quickly and staying focused on building capability that is useful, credible and operationally relevant.  

As a growing business, we offer the opportunity to have visible impact. You will be close to the customers, the technology and the decisions that shape our direction. We value people who ask good questions, bring others with them, and take ownership.  

This is an exciting time to join Mind Foundry. Demand for trusted, deployable AI capability is increasing, our products and partnerships are maturing, and our work is helping to shape how advanced machine learning can support Defence and National Security in challenging operational environments. If you are motivated by meaningful work, collaborative teams and the chance to help build something with real-world importance, Mind Foundry is a place where you can make a genuine contribution.   

 

**What do we offer?**  

We believe in investing in our people by encouraging career and personal development that aligns with your goals and ambitions. We make sure all staff have the tools, time and support they need to shape their own professional development. We want to help you excel at what you do and support your growth within the company.

Online via MS Teams: 

* Initial discussion with the People team

* 30 minute interview with the Director of Mission Systems

In person at our Summertown, Oxford office: 

* 60 minute interview, including a 10 minute presentation

* 60 minute interview with our Chief Executive Officer

* 30 minute meet the team

**Role Summary**

Mindtrace is hiring an Agentic Workflow / AI Product Engineer to build the agentic workflow layer for its inspection products. This person will help create agents that make industrial AI systems easier to deploy, diagnose, explain, support, and improve.

In this role, you will build production-quality agentic product workflows around inspection evidence, deployment state, hardware health, logs, model outputs, customer workflows, support history, and field feedback.

The ideal candidate has prior hands-on experience building agents or agentic workflows, preferably in real production software rather than only prototypes. They should be fluent in Python and comfortable building robust AI applications that use tools, retrieve context, reason over multimodal evidence, and operate within clear human-in-the-loop boundaries.

**What You Will Do**

* Build agentic workflows for Mindtrace inspection products, including deployment support, system health, incident triage, inspection explanation, reporting, and data-curation loops.
* Develop agents that can use tools, inspect logs, retrieve relevant context, summarize evidence, recommend next actions, and package issues for escalation.
* Work on agentic product workflows that support deployment, inspection review, diagnostics, reporting, escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Integrate agents with product APIs, databases, image records, model outputs, configuration state, hardware status, support history, and customer-specific metadata.
* Design agent workflows that sit inside real task surfaces rather than generic chatbot experiences.
* Build evaluation and observability for agent behaviour, including tool-call history, task success metrics, regression tests, failure modes, traceability, and guardrails.
* Collaborate with ML, product, hardware, client, and deployment teams to turn field experience into reusable product knowledge.
* Help define where agents should explain, recommend, summarize, prepare actions, or escalate, while preserving clear human authority for consequential production decisions.
* Prototype quickly, but harden the right workflows into maintainable product features.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Prior hands-on experience building agents, agentic workflows, LLM applications, or AI workflow products.
* Strong Python fluency for application development, workflow orchestration, AI integration, testing, and data processing.
* Experience with LLM or VLM application patterns such as tool use, structured outputs, retrieval, memory/context management, prompt design, and evaluation.
* Strong backend or full-stack product engineering skills, including APIs, databases, events, permissions, workflow state, and integration with existing systems.
* Ability to build reliable human-in-the-loop AI workflows where agent actions are observable, reviewable, and bounded.
* Experience designing or implementing evaluation for AI systems, including regression testing, task success metrics, failure analysis, and reliability checks.
* Comfort working with multimodal operational data, including images, logs, model outputs, metadata, configuration state, and user feedback.
* Clear communication and product judgement: able to turn ambiguous operational needs into useful workflows that real users can trust.

**Highly Beneficial Skills**

* Experience shipping agents or LLM applications in production environments.
* Experience with vision-language models or multimodal AI over images, video, inspection evidence, diagrams, screenshots, or technical records.
* Experience with RAG over structured and unstructured data.
* Familiarity with observability, log analysis, incident response, support tooling, runbooks, or developer tools.
* Experience building workflow UIs where AI assists a specific operational task.
* Familiarity with manufacturing, quality inspection, industrial automation, field support, or regulated operational environments.
* Experience with vector databases, embeddings, search systems, or knowledge retrieval.
* Experience with model governance, audit trails, release control, permissions, or safety-sensitive AI workflows.
* Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, open-source LLM/VLM stacks, LangGraph-style orchestration, or similar agent frameworks. The candidate should understand enough vision and inspection context to collaborate well with ML and hardware specialists, while remaining primarily focused on agentic workflows and AI product engineering.

**Candidate Profile**

The strongest candidates will have direct experience building and deploying agentic systems into industrial, operational, or similarly complex production environments. They should know how to move beyond prototypes into reliable agent workflows that save time, reduce deployment friction, explain evidence, improve support workflows, and make inspection systems easier to operate and trust. This person should be able to answer questions like:

* What should this agent be allowed to do, and where should a human remain in control?
* What context does the agent need to diagnose this issue reliably?
* How do we know the agent is working, and how do we detect when it fails?
* How do we turn one deployment issue into reusable product knowledge?
* How should agent activity be logged, inspected, evaluated, and improved over time?

GenAI Engineering sits within Motorway's Data and AI function, alongside Machine Learning and the Machine Learning Data Platform. We own the AI features that shape how buyers and sellers experience the marketplace, from agentic workflows in the customer journey to LLM-powered tooling for our dealer network.

What we build goes into the hands of real sellers and thousands of verified dealers, usually within weeks. When it works, someone sells their car more easily. When it doesn't, we hear about it. That feedback loop is short, and it shapes how we work. We have a track record of successful deployments and a strong reputation as a result.

Over the next two years the function scales from shipping AI features to running a serious GenAI platform.

## About the role

We're looking for a Lead GenAI Engineer to set the technical standard for AI work across the function, and to build the hardest parts of it themselves.

You'll own the architecture and standards for complex, product-facing GenAI work. You'll hold sign-off on the systems that carry real risk, and you'll be the person a squad comes to when they've hit something genuinely hard. This is a player-coach role: your own code sets the bar others refer back to, and you'll spend as much energy making senior engineers better as you do building.

Most of what makes a GenAI feature good sits around the model rather than in it. The prompting is rarely the hard part. Retrieval quality is, and so is the data feeding it, evaluation you can trust, sensible behaviour when things fail, and getting it live and keeping it there. The standards that matter most here are the ones that make that work repeatable across teams. We're not precious about the route you took to this kind of engineering.

You'll report to the Engineering Manager for GenAI Engineering, partnering closely with the Principal GenAI Engineer, the Director of Data and AI, and product leadership.

## In this role, you will:

* Set the architecture standard for complex GenAI work across the function, not by mandate but by building things others learn from and want to adopt.
* Hold sign-off on materially complex AI systems, catching architectural, safety and reliability problems before they reach production.
* Own the shared foundations that determine feature quality across teams: retrieval patterns, evaluation infrastructure, data pipelines, and the tooling that makes good practice the easy path.
* Build the hardest pieces of work directly, acting as the technical escalation point for the function's toughest problems.
* Design for systems that stay up and stay affordable, covering graceful degradation, fallback behaviour, and cost and latency at production scale.
* Develop the senior engineers around you by handing them harder problems, room to own decisions, and honest feedback.
* Shape how we hire and review, bringing a clear and defensible view of what good looks like.
* Bring specific, actionable industry insight into planning, explaining what a development means for our architecture rather than noting that the field moves fast.

## About you

* You've set technical direction that other engineering teams actually adopted, and you can talk about where that worked and where it didn't.
* Strong Python, and SQL you genuinely use. A lot of this work is data work: grounding data, golden datasets, and understanding why something failed.
* Deep, current expertise across the GenAI stack, including retrieval at scale, vector stores, agentic orchestration, multimodal work, evaluation infrastructure and fine-tuning where it earns its place.
* You're fluent in the layer underneath: MLOps tooling, deployment and cloud infrastructure (we run on AWS and GCP), and you can tell the difference between a choice that matters and one that doesn't.
* You design systems that survive contact with production, and you've been on the hook when they didn't.
* A strong point of view on evaluation, including the difference between evals that catch regressions and evals that provide comfort.
* Your direct contributions set a quality bar for the people around you.
* You explain hard technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders without either condescending or losing the substance.
* Self-awareness about where your knowledge runs out, and the instinct to bring in expertise early.

## You could be a great fit if

* You build with taste, preferring simple systems that work over clever ones that nearly do.

You’ll own its strategy, its roadmap and its delivery, from a high-level business goal all the way to a shipped, measured feature. South Uist / Stilligarry, Scotland, United Kingdom

## Job Description

**Job title: 1001-342 HMP Project Support | Grade: B | Vacancy type: Fixed Term Appointment until 31 March 2028 | Hours: 35 hours | Salary £30,076 | Location: Uist | Closing date: Midnight 13 September 2026 | Interview date: 01 October 2026**

**Job Purpose Summary:**

To carry out control of mink in support of a project set up and funded by Scottish Natural Heritage The project aims to eradicate American mink (Neovision vision) from the Outer Hebrides.

To trap and humanely despatch American Mink (also rats and potentially ferrets) on the Isles of Lewis and Harris using both “Breakback” (kill) and live capture cage traps.

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* To control mink, by trapping in the Uists, Western Isles
* To record contacts with officials and the public, in relation to this work
* To maintain accurate records of mink trapping operations
* To maintain a high level of personal responsibility in dealing sensitively and humanely with control operations

Finally, please note that the nature of this role can involve walking over moorland of between 8-20 kilometres per day.

**Skills:**

1. Experience of wildlife management, using Live Capture and Kill Traps and outdoor work.
2. As travelling is an integral part of the job, you must have a valid driving licence, or be able to call upon suitable alternative means of transport.
3. As this role will involve working in rough terrain and inclement weather conditions the post holder must have an element of physical fitness.
4. Effective time management and communication skills.
5. Knowledge of the local area and its natural history
6. Experience of working in an Invasive Non-Native Species (INNS) eradication Project
7. Boat handling skills.
8. Experience of dealing with the general public.
9. Experience of working with firearms.

**Job Title: 1011-360 Marine Data Adviser | Grade: D | Salary £41,567  | Location: Inverness preferred (other NatureScot locations and hybrid working considered) Vacancy type: Temporary until 31.03.2029 with possibility of extension | Hours: 35 hours | Closing date: Midnight 13 September 2026 | Candidate Interviews: 30 September 2026**

**Job Purpose Summary**

NatureScot is Scotland’s nature agency. Our purpose is to halt biodiversity loss by 2030 and to restore and regenerate biodiversity by 2045. We work with communities, partners and businesses to ensure that nature thrives and people flourish.

As pressures continue to grow, so does the need for evidence to underpin the complex decision-making required to achieve government’s vision of clean, healthy, safe, productive and biologically diverse seas, managed to meet the long-term needs of people and nature. NatureScot has a key role to play in the development, interpretation and mobilisation of the evidence-base that informs our statutory advice, including in relation to Priority Marine Features (PMFs) and the designation and management of Marine Protected Areas (MPAs).

Focusing on the management and mobilisation of marine biodiversity data, the successful candidate will work closely within our team of existing marine specialists, and a range of partner organisations to help NatureScot deliver the transformation required to ensure a nature-rich future with sustainable use of our seas and land. This post would suit someone with a background in data management with a good attention to detail and an affinity for marine nature conservation.

NatureScot collects and holds significant amounts of marine environmental data, and we also rely on data collected and held by others to carry out our work. We need to ensure that we can obtain the right data to support our business needs, that we collect it in the right way and that we manage and use it as effectively as possible.

There will be opportunities to inspire and engage with stakeholders to collectively influence and take forwards the marine biodiversity data management remit in Scotland, inputting to projects and partnerships aimed at developing knowledge and co-operation in key areas within our remit.   A detailed programme of work will be agreed at the outset of the post, and the post-holder will contribute to the wider work of the Activity Team.

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

* Co-ordinate implementation of the recommendations of the Scottish Marine Biodiversity Data Review, leading stakeholders from the public sector, eNGOs, industry, community groups and academia.
* Lead the ingestion of benthic data outputs from: coastal community groups, and restoration and enhancement initiatives into Marine Recorder Online. This will involve collaborative working with individuals from these groups and initiatives as well as close working with the Marine Citizen Science Coordinator, Marine Recorder Online data managers and other NatureScot staff.
* Provide custodianship to NatureScot’s marine data holdings with a particular focus on rich media: imagery, outputs from passive acoustic monitoring and digital aerial surveys. This will involve close working with project leads, NatureScot’s Digital Asset Management System and external initiatives.
* Ensure marine datasets under NatureScot custodianship have adequate, well managed and published Discovery metadata, alongside additional NatureScot dataset documentation requirements. This will involve encouraging project leads, ensuring consistency across the suite of metadata we are responsible for, and generating metadata for data from community groups and restoration and enhancement initiatives.
* Consider and implement opportunities for adopting innovative practices leveraging machine learning and artificial intelligence in the data engineering and management domain.
* Contribute to the Quality Assurance of data deliverables and the assignment of conservation status to records.
* Input to the development of, and ensure compliance with, MEDIN data standards (data guidelines and discovery metadata), through MEDIN’s Data Standards Working Group.
* Work collaboratively within NatureScot (Marine Information & Data Management Group (MIDMG)) to improve the management of NatureScot’s marine data. Develop and manage links between this work and other strategic discussions/projects relevant to marine data management within NatureScot (e.g. the Information Management Strategy and GIS Transformation) and understand interoperability challenges between NatureScot corporate systems.
* Represent NatureScot at meetings of inter-agency and similar external groups relevant to marine data management.
* Support Assessment and Reporting tasks.
* Service data supply requests.

**Skills (Please refer to these in your Supporting Statement)**

* A sound knowledge of the principles of good practice in data management with experience in their application. This is to include knowledge of: QFAIR principles; Freedom of Information and Environmental Information (Scotland) Regulations legislation; Re-use of Public Sector Information legislation; Data Protection legislation; and Copyright legislation.
* Highly proficient desktop GIS skills with a proven track record of using QGIS and or ESRI ArcGIS Pro. This should be supported with industry experience of loading, transforming and analysing geospatial data; and working with varied coordinate systems, ideally in a marine context.
* Experience of working with scripting languages like Python or R; interacting with relational databases (e.g. SQLite) using SQL or similar; familiarity with APIs and constructing search criteria with JSON data structures within these APIs. An understanding of the opportunities for innovation that these skills bring.
* Understanding of MEDIN Discovery metadata and data standards.
* Knowledge of evolving machine learning and artificial intelligence technologies and their application in the data engineering and management domain.
* A strong background in data quality control, with a good attention to detail.
* Excellent interpersonal skills that can contribute to inspirational collaborative team working with external and internal stakeholders as well as customer orientated service provision.
* Ability to work both flexibly as part of a team and to work independently using own initiative to problem solve; seeking advice, securing additional resources and developing creative approaches when appropriate.
* Effective written and verbal communications, especially the ability to convey complex information clearly and confidently to a variety of audiences.
* Proven ability to plan and manage workloads, work to deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
* An understanding of how data relating to the marine ecology, habitats and species of Scotland is managed.

**Prerequisites Required**

* Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and resident in Scotland for the duration of the job contract.
* To undertake a Disclosure Scotland application.
* Although Gaelic language is not a prerequisite it is a desirable skill in support of our commitment to our Gaelic Language Plan.

**Working for NatureScot - what we offer you**

* NatureScot offers some great benefits to reward and support you whilst you are working for us. Our benefits package includes the civil service pension scheme, a generous holiday leave allowance plus flexi time, and employee discount scheme.  Visit the NatureScot website for further details including below:
* We support flexible working for all roles, including part-time, compressed hours, hybrid working and job share. All vacancies are considered suitable for flexible working unless there is a business reason not to. We encourage applicants to discuss potential flexible working arrangements with us.
* A Civil Service Pension with an employer contribution of 28.97% (7.35% employee contributions) https://www.civilservicepensionscheme.org.uk/memberhub/joining-the-pension-scheme/.
* 41.5 days of annual leave, including 5 fixed public holidays on St Andrews Day, Christmas Day, Boxing Day, New Year’s Day and 2nd January.

# Project Manager Career Programme with Job Guarantee, Live Training and Certifications

## Become a Project Manager

No experience needed. Average UK project manager salaries reach £54,780, over 41% above the national average.

## Course Overview

Project management is one of the most accessible well paid careers in the UK for someone changing direction, because it rewards organisation, judgement and communication more than it rewards a technical background. What it does demand is proof. Employers hiring a project manager need to see that you know the method, the vocabulary, and the tools before they will hand you a budget and a team.

Our Project Manager career programme is built to give you that proof. Over eight modules you will earn four recognised certifications, learn the two ways UK projects actually get delivered, and build the practical tool skills that appear in almost every project manager job description. You will be taught live by an instructor rather than left alone with a video library, and when your training is complete our recruitment team takes over and works with you until you are placed.

The programme is designed for people with no project management background at all. If you have ever run an event, coordinated a team, managed a budget or kept a complicated thing on schedule, you already have the instincts. This programme gives them a name that employers recognise.

On completion of our job guarantee career programmes, we work with you to rebuild your CV into a compelling marketing document that employers want to read, provide you with interview and professional skills training and coaching, and help you build your job search while we map market opportunities for you and introduce you to our network of clients.

### 1. Excel with AI

Live instructor led

Practical Excel skills for modern project professionals. Developed by Newto Training.

Covers spreadsheet skills as a project professional actually uses them, including structuring data properly, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, charts and trackers - and then layers on how AI tools inside and alongside Excel change that work.

Modern Excel can draft formulas from a plain-English description, explain an inherited formula someone else built, summarise a dataset, spot trends and outliers, and build charts and pivot tables from a prompt.

### 2. PL-300: Microsoft Power BI

Live instructor led. Includes the official Microsoft exam.

PL-300 teaches you to answer it with data rather than opinion. You will learn to pull information from different sources, clean and model it, and turn it into dashboards and reports that senior stakeholders can read at a glance.

The module covers preparing data, modelling it, visualising and analysing it, and managing and securing what you publish. For a project manager this is what turns a status report from a list of assertions into something defensible. It is also the certification that most clearly separates you from other candidates at interview, because very few entry level project managers arrive able to build their own reporting.

### 3. PRINCE2 Foundation

Live instructor led. Includes the official PeopleCert exam.

PRINCE2 is the UK project management standard across major industries. Foundation teaches you the language.

You will cover the seven principles, seven practices - business case, organising, quality, plans, risk, issues and progress - and seven processes from start-up to proper closure. You will also learn what each management product is for and who is accountable for what.

There are no prerequisites. This is the genuine open door into the profession, and the point at which your existing experience acquires a vocabulary that recruiters recognise.

### 4. Microsoft Project

Live instructor led

Knowing the method is one thing. Building the schedule is another, and it is what you will be asked to demonstrate in an interview for a waterfall delivery role.

This module takes you through the Microsoft Project environment and then into real scheduling: task durations, milestones, manual and automatic scheduling, task relationships and dependencies, and identifying the critical path. You will move on to managing resources, resolving over allocation, resource levelling, part time resource calendars and overtime, and then into costs, covering variable costs, per usage and fixed costs, and changing rates part way through a project.

By the end you can take a set of requirements and produce a defensible plan with a critical path, a resourced timeline and a cost profile. That is the single most requested practical skill in UK waterfall project manager job adverts.

### 5. Risk Management

Self paced e-learning

Risk is the part of the job that separates a project manager who is trusted from one who is merely tolerated.

This module covers what risk actually is, how to describe it properly, why risk management fails, the common barriers to doing it well, and where corporate governance and internal control fit in.

You will then work through risk management principles and their outcomes, and finally the practical documents: the risk management policy and process guide, risk strategy, issue register, risk improvement plan, risk communications plan, risk response plan and risk progress reports, and how all of them relate to each other.

This module sits deliberately alongside the PRINCE2 risk practice. PRINCE2 tells you that risk must be managed. This module shows you how it is done in a real organisation.

This module is about the human side of delivery, which is the side almost no entry level project manager has been trained in.

You will cover the change process and its impact, including the learning dip and the cycle of competence, and then four approaches to change: behavioural, cognitive, psychodynamic including the change curve, and humanistic, taking in Herzberg and Maslow along the way. From there you move into personality and change, covering Lewin's three step model, communication during change, Tuckman's stages of team development and Belbin team roles, and then into organisational culture, Morgan's organisational metaphors and how culture shapes which change approach will work.

The final section covers leaders and managers, leadership styles including Goleman's, transformational versus transactional leadership, dispersed leadership, and how to sustain change once the project team has moved on.

### 7. PRINCE2 Practitioner

Live instructor led. Includes the official PeopleCert exam.

Practitioner proves you can run a project, not just support one. It is the qualification that helps a CV move from project support to full project manager roles.

You will learn to tailor PRINCE2 to a project's size, risk and complexity, select the right management products, manage change control and tolerances, and use a live business case to make genuine go/no-go decisions.

This is the step in the programme that moves you from supporting projects to being accountable for one.

This module makes sure the answer is both. You will cover the agile mindset and how to blend agile ways of working with PRINCE2 governance, which is what hybrid delivery actually looks like in a large UK organisation. It also covers agile roles and duties, stakeholder engagement, agile leadership basics, risk and change control in fast moving environments, progress tracking with agile appropriate metrics, value driven thinking and how agile is scaled across an organisation.

This module is deliberately last. Once you understand structured delivery properly, agile stops looking like a different religion and starts looking like a set of tools you can choose from. That is exactly how experienced project managers talk about it, and it is how you want to sound in an interview.

## **About Nivoda 🚀**

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

## **Our Mission 🎯**

Nivoda started with a simple observation: buying and selling diamonds was slow, opaque, and inefficient, no matter how big or small your business was. Our platform fixes this by giving every jewellery business, wherever they are in the world, the same access to inventory, financing, and logistics as the biggest players in the industry.

## **About the Role 🤔**

As we expand into jewellery and new markets, the complexity of moving products across borders has grown fast. Loose diamonds have historically had simple customs treatment in most jurisdictions; jewellery is a different story, with its own tariff regimes and duty rules. This is a new, dedicated role that will sit within fulfilment, close to the shipments and the broker relationships where trade compliance actually gets executed day to day preparing documentation, applying classifications, managing broker performance, and owning our duty drawback program end to end. Legal & Compliance own the policy layer: the classification framework, country-of-origin rules, and regulatory interpretation. You'll partner with them constantly and escalate anything genuinely unclear, but this role owns execution.

It's an individual contributor role with high ownership; there's no capability like this at Nivoda today, so you'll be building the operating rhythm as you go, not inheriting one.

## **What will you be doing? 😎**

* Prepare all shipment documentation and commercial invoices, and ensure accurate, complete documentation is retrieved from brokers and carriers and stored centrally on our platform
* Apply the HTS classifications and country-of-origin determinations that Legal & Compliance have approved, consistently across our shipment processes and systems in partnership with product
* Manage day-to-day customs broker relationships, coordinating clearance, reviewing broker performance, and ensuring broker practices stay aligned with our classification framework
* Monitor duties as part of landed shipping costs, catch unexpected duty outcomes, and file claims with customs brokers when errors are found
* Resolve routine customs queries during clearance, and ensure declarations for import and export are applied accurately
* Own the duty drawback program day to day, acting as the internal point of contact with Livingstone, and preparing and validating claims before submission

We're looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy for NMI's Gateway product line, with a focus on card-present devices and vertical markets such as unattended retail, parking, medical, and beyond.

This role sits at the center of product, sales, and marketing, translating platform and device capabilities into compelling, solution-forward value propositions that resonate with the operators, partners, and buyers within each vertical. You will own market positioning, messaging, launches, and enablement for NMI's Gateway, device, and unattended solutions, ensuring NMI is the preferred payments partner across every vertical it serves.

This role requires a strong understanding of how vertical markets evaluate and adopt payment technology, and the ability to explain the value proposition and competitive advantages of NMI's solutions in terms that matter to each vertical, not just the technical specifications of the hardware or gateway itself. You'll help shape how partners, integrators and operators in card-present verticals, in particular the unattended (transportation, parking, vending, etc) space, understand, evaluate, and succeed with NMI, while supporting revenue teams with clear, differentiated, outcome-focused messaging that drives pipeline and adoption. Success in this role looks like partners, integrators and operators understanding how NMI's applications help their business succeed, not a list of device features.

This role is also NMI's evangelist for these solutions. You'll present directly to sales teams, internal and external stakeholders, and prospects, and represent NMI at trade shows, conferences, and other industry events, including external speaking opportunities and briefings with industry analysts. You'll build AI tools into your everyday workflow as a core habit rather than an occasional add-on, and bring enough technical depth across gateways, devices, APIs, and certification processes to hold your own in a room with engineers and technical buyers, not just repeat what they tell you.

## About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

## How We Work - Our Core Values

* Be a Good Person, It's Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
* Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
* Raise the Bar. Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

## Responsibilities

Own Gateway, Device & Vertical Go-to-Market Strategy

* Lead positioning and messaging for NMI's Gateway product line across device and vertical segments, including medical, unattended retail, parking, and other emerging verticals.
* Define clear, solution-forward value propositions for each vertical's buyers and operators, grounded in the business outcomes NMI's applications enable and revenue generation rather than device or technical specifications alone.
* Develop differentiated narratives that articulate why NMI is the payments partner of choice for each vertical, moving away from feature-and-spec language in favor of stories about partner and operator success.
* Partner with Product Management to influence roadmap decisions using vertical market insight and competitive intelligence. Be the customer and go-to-market expert who drives adoption of our Gateway and device solutions.

Drive Product Launches & Market Adoption

* Lead end-to-end go-to-market execution for new Gateway features, devices, and vertical-specific enhancements.
* Collaborate cross-functionally across product, sales, corporate marketing, and channel marketing to ensure successful launch execution.
* Create launch plans, enablement materials, customer-facing messaging, and internal readiness programs that speak to each vertical's priorities and pain points.
* Support adoption and revenue generation by aligning messaging with onboarding, documentation, and the operator experience within each vertical.

Deeply Understand Vertical & Device Ecosystems

* Serve as the in-house expert on buyer and operator personas within medical, unattended, parking, transportation and other priority verticals.
* Conduct market research to understand trends in device commerce, unattended retail, vertical-specific regulation, and payment application monetization.
* Monitor competitors and evolving vertical market dynamics to refine NMI's differentiation strategy.
* Translate ecosystem shifts into actionable, solution-focused messaging and strategic recommendations.

Build Sales & Channel Enablement

* Help sales articulate the business value of NMI's Gateway and device solutions in terms each vertical's buyers care about, not just technical capability.
* Support lifecycle messaging that drives adoption, expansion, and retention among partners across verticals.
* Partner with channel marketing to equip ISOs, software integrators, and reseller partners with compelling, vertical-focused messaging they can use with confidence.

Be an Evangelist for NMI's Solutions

* Represent NMI at trade shows, industry events, and conferences, and pursue external speaking opportunities that build NMI's credibility and visibility in the verticals it serves.
* Build relationships with industry analysts and serve as a credible, technical voice for NMI's Gateway and device story.

* Build business cases to support new vertical market opportunities.
* Drive alignment across product, engineering, and commercial teams around priority verticals and growth strategy.

## **About Pleo**

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

**About the role**   
  
Pleo's Intelligence function covers the full analytical picture - product behaviour, GTM performance, commercial data science, financial reporting, and operational intelligence. The Analytics Engineers who serve these teams own the data modelling layer that all of it runs on: dbt models, metric definitions, and semantic layer contributions that analysts, product teams, and AI tools depend on to get consistent, trustworthy answers.

You'll be embedded in the Product Intelligence team, building the tracking, experimentation, and data modelling foundations that make product data trustworthy and self-serve. You'll join a close-knit team actively migrating our analytics stack onto a new Analytics Warehouse and Omni, moving off legacy tools like Looker and Hippocampus. If you want to build the infrastructure that other people's product decisions run on rather than just report on what exists, this is the opportunity for you.

**Who you'll work with and reporting to**   
  
You will report to an Analytics Manager leading Product Intelligence and Growth Intelligence. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Product Analysts, and Engineering to get tracking, experimentation, and metric definitions right from the ground up. You'll also engage with the broader Analytics Engineering community across Pleo to drive shared standards, especially around the semantic layer that keeps metrics consistent across the organization.

**What you'll be doing**

* Build and maintain dbt models in our new Analytics Warehouse, using a clean, layered architecture and migrating logic off legacy tools as you go.
* Own tracking plan implementation and QA directly in Segment and Amplitude in close partnership with Product and Engineering.
* Support experimentation by modelling assignment and outcome data into structured formats that analysts and PMs can query directly.
* Define and document metrics in our semantic layer, ensuring a single authoritative definition so downstream BI tools and AI applications yield consistent answers.
* Apply AI-augmented data modelling practices as a standard part of how you write, review, and migrate code.
* Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to turn one-off questions into durable, reusable data models.
* Maintain data quality in your domain through dbt tests, freshness SLAs, and proactive monitoring.

**What you bring**

* Solid SQL and dbt experience, with a clear comfort owning models end to end.
* Working knowledge of event-based tracking tools like Segment or Amplitude.
* Experience with Git-based development workflows, including opening and reviewing pull requests.
* Clear communication skills to explain data definitions and structures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Genuine day-to-day use of AI tooling as part of your standard coding and workflow routine.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity and untangling legacy logic to build modern foundations.

**This role is NOT a good fit if**

* You only want to write dashboards without touching or owning the underlying data models.
* You require rigid processes and heavy upfront structure before taking initiative.
* You prefer to avoid data migration, cleanup work, and legacy system refactoring.

**Your first 6 months**

* **Ramp up:** Master our dbt project structure, tracking plans, and migration roadmap while shipping small, reviewed code changes early on.
* **Take ownership:** Own a dedicated slice of the migration, such as an event domain or our core experimentation data models.
* **Drive consistency:** Establish semantic layer definitions for your domain so analysts and PMs can self-serve accurate metrics without custom workarounds.

**Our tech stack context**

* **Data warehouse:** GCP / BigQuery (new Analytics Warehouse)
* **Transformation:** dbt
* **Orchestration:** Airflow
* **Tracking and Oroduct Analytics:** Segment, Amplitude
* **BI and Analytics:** Omni (migrating off legacy Looker and Hippocampus)
* **Languages:** SQL

**Show me the benefits!**

* Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
* Lunch is on us for your work days—enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office.
* Comprehensive private healthcare depending on your location (coverage options include Vitality, Alan, or Médis).
* 25 days of annual holiday plus public holidays, with the option to purchase 5 additional days through salary sacrifice.
* Flexible working options supporting both hybrid and fully remote setups.
* Free mental health and well-being support through MyndUp.
* Generous paid parental leave policies to support growing families.

**The interview process**

1. **Intro Call:** 30 minutes with our Talent Partner
2. **SQL Test:** Completed via CodeSignal / CoderPad
3. **Hiring Manager Interview:** 45 minutes with our Data & Analytics Manager
4. **Team Interview & Live Case:** Data modelling case via CodeSignal
5. **Final Interview:** 30 minutes with our VP of Data & AI

**Application deadline**

To ensure everyone has a fair opportunity to apply, applications for this role will close on **Monday, September 7th at 11:59 PM**.

If you are interested, please submit your application before the deadline. We look forward to reviewing your profile!

We work in person in our office in Old Street because we genuinely enjoy each other's company (most of the time). * **Work both fast and slow:** You'll navigate slow public sector procurement cycles one minute, then help us ship a new feature over lunch the next. The whiplash is intense but it keeps things interesting.

* **Automate and document yourself away:🤖** We're small and growing fast. Build systems and processes that make your job increasingly redundant. There’s always plenty more to do.

**Importantly, This is a list of suggestions.**

If you have experience in only some of this, or have only some of these skills, please do apply anyway.

## **📈 How can you measure your success?**

* **Speed of getting customers successfully using Plinth:** From signed contract to actively using the platform and seeing value.
* **Positive recommendations:** Clients recommending us positively to their networks — it’s a big source of our growth.
* **Increasing use of Plinth:** Clients expanding how they use the platform over time, not just maintaining baseline usage

# **About Us**

Founded in the US in 2022 and now based in London, UK, Recraft is an AI tool for professional designers, illustrators, and marketers, setting a new standard for excellence in image generation.

We designed a tool that lets creators quickly generate and iterate original images, vector art, illustrations, icons, and 3D graphics with AI. Over 3 million users across 190+ countries have produced hundreds of millions of images using Recraft, and we're just getting started.

Join a universe of professional opportunities, develop and support large-scale projects, and shape the future of creativity. We are committed to making Recraft an essential, daily tool for every designer and setting the industry standard. Our mission is to ensure that creators can fully control their creative process with AI, providing them with innovative tools to turn ideas into reality.

If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI, we want you on board!

## **Job Description**

Growth at Recraft is a numbers problem before it's a brand problem. We're looking for a UA Manager who owns paid acquisition end to end: setting up the channels, scaling spend without breaking payback, and knowing which lever moved the number. This is a hands-in-the-accounts role, not an agency-management one — and for the right person, a chance to build the performance marketing engine at Recraft from scratch and scale it toward $1M/month.

One thing to know about the model, because it shapes the job: we don't run a free trial. New users get a pack of free credits, and once they need more, the only way forward is a paid subscription. That means conversion often happens on day one, and the numbers that matter are free-to-paid conversion rate, renewal, and payback by cohort — not trial starts.

## **Key Responsibilities**

* Own paid user acquisition on Meta first — account structure, targeting, bidding, budget pacing, and daily optimization. Meta is where the majority of the budget sits and where we expect the majority of your time to go.
* Open and scale the next channels as Meta matures: Google (Search, PMax, YouTube, App) and TikTok.
* Scale monthly spend aggressively while holding CAC, ROAS, and cohort payback targets. Growth without payback discipline doesn't count.
* Build what isn't there yet: tracking, attribution, naming conventions, dashboards, and reporting — so decisions are made on data everyone trusts.
* Own subscription economics, not vanity metrics: free-to-paid conversion, day-one subscription rate, renewal and churn by month, ARPPU, and LTV by cohort and by channel.
* Run a structured testing cadence on audiences, placements, bidding, and offers — and brief creative based on what the data says, working directly with our Creative Designer.
* Automate the repetitive parts of the job — reporting, pacing, anomaly alerts, creative rotation — using Claude and platform APIs, so your time goes to decisions rather than spreadsheets.
* Forecast and plan budget, and report weekly on spend, CAC, and payback to marketing and leadership.

## **Who You'll Work With**

You'll join the Marketing team and work closely with our Performance Marketing Manager, Creative Designer, and the analytics and product teams. This is a role built around owning a number and bringing your own plan for hitting it, not executing someone else's media plan.

## **Requirements**

* 4+ years in user acquisition or performance marketing for a consumer subscription product — app, web, or both.
* Deep, hands-on Meta expertise. You've run Meta as a primary acquisition channel at meaningful spend, built the account structure yourself, and can explain how you handled the moments where scaling stopped working.
* You've managed a paid budget of at least $100k/month and can walk us through what CAC and payback did as you scaled it.
* Experience setting up performance marketing from scratch — accounts, pixels and server-side events, MMP/SKAN or GA4, attribution logic, and reporting.
* Fluency in subscription economics: free-to-paid conversion, renewal and churn, ARPPU, LTV:CAC, and cohort payback. Comfortable pulling your own numbers in a BI tool, with basic SQL.
* Comfortable using AI in your daily workflow — analysis, reporting, and automation — rather than treating it as a side experiment.
* Based in the EU, Georgia, Armenia, or Serbia, with the right to work as a contractor there.

## **Nice to Have**

* **A track record of scaling paid spend to around $1M/month.** This is a significant plus and would move a candidate to the top of the list. We know it's rare, which is why it sits here rather than in requirements.
* Experience with a credit, token, or usage-based subscription — a model where conversion is driven by hitting a limit rather than by a trial expiring.
* Hands-on experience beyond Meta — Google (Search, PMax, YouTube, App), TikTok, or Apple Search Ads. Strength in a second channel counts for a lot; all of them is not something we expect.
* Experience in the photo, video, or creative-tools segment (Canva, Picsart, Photoroom, VSCO, CapCut-adjacent products) — or another consumer subscription category with hard payback math, such as fitness, health, or education.
* Real experience using Claude or other LLMs to manage and automate performance campaigns: bulk edits, budget pacing scripts, automated creative and cohort reporting.
* Both web and app funnel experience, including web-to-app flows and web paywalls (Stripe, Paddle, or similar).
* Incrementality testing, geo-lift — anything that shows you're skeptical of platform-reported numbers.
* Ad copywriting — able to write your own hooks and headlines instead of waiting on a brief.
* In-house experience at a product company rather than purely agency-side work.
* You're already a Recraft user.

## **What We Offer**

* A full-time contractor engagement, fully remote, with compensation that matches the seniority and ownership this role carries.
* Real ownership of the acquisition budget and the targets attached to it — you set the plan, you spend the money, you own the result.
* A product built on AI image and video generation, growing fast, where your work has a direct, measurable line to company revenue.
* The chance to define what performance marketing looks like at Recraft — the structure and playbook you build is what everyone after you works from.
* An environment where automating your own job with AI is encouraged, not viewed with suspicion.
* Direct collaboration with our Performance Marketing, Creative, analytics, and product teams.
* A team that means it when it says it wants to build the best product in the category — people who give each other direct, useful feedback, share context openly, and step in to help without being asked.

## GRC Automation Specialist (Governance, Risk & Compliance, TPRM)

London, England, United Kingdom; Remote - UK

ID:JR11166 (for internal use only)

**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected OperationsTM Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

## **About the role**

The Governance, Risk, and Compliance Automation Specialist is responsible for assisting in assessing third-party risk across Samsara’s new and existing systems and building automated workflows to support a scaling program.

You take Security seriously, but understand there is a business to operate and strive to build low friction solutions and decisions made in close partnership with others. On a typical day, you might work with Samsara’s legal or procurement team to discuss an ongoing review of a vendor, build and refine AI enabled workflows to scale the vendor risk program, and collaborate with teams across the business to understand and define vendor use cases and data flows.

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You’re energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

#### **In this role, you will:**

* Work with the Manager and Sr. Director of Platform Security and Compliance to provide programmatic updates and communicate both program, third-party, and technical risk to the broader Information Security leadership team
* Drive automation and efficiency in the TPRM program through the use of third-parties, such as Zip and Vanta, and creating native solutions; ensuring security reviews and reassessments scale with company growth.
* Partner with Procurement, Legal, and Privacy to ensure vendor risks are identified, documented, and mitigated throughout the vendor lifecycle.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* 2-4 years of experience in the governance, risk, and compliance space
* Experience implementing or maintaining vendor-risk programs
* Experience performing security and maturity assessments
* Supporting the creation or maintenance of risk registers, compliance inventories, and control mappings across internal and external systems
* Ability to work with systems teams to collaboratively implement security controls across a diverse range of systems, such as Okta, Slack, Salesforce, and internal tooling
* Professional experience coordinating and interacting with external auditors, internal engineering teams, business stakeholders, senior leadership, and security operations teams on procurement activities, audit controls and compliance requirements
* Experience conducting vendor risk assessments, including reviewing security certifications, penetration tests, and policies.
* Strong understanding of vendor integration risks and permission scoping across SaaS platforms (eg. Slack, Google Workspace, and Salesforce)
* Ability to translate complex technical findings and requirements into clear business risks and requirements to non technical stakeholders.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience working with NIST Cybersecurity Framework profiles, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar frameworks
* Experience creating workflows through automation and AI assistance
* Experience working within common GRC and procurement platforms such as Zip and Vanta.
* Experience managing high volumes of vendor requests and competing priorities.
* Prior assessment experience in the Software-as-a-Service industry

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

# Technical Sales Engineer

At Dormer Pramet, we’re proud of our heritage but even more excited about our future. We’re driven by innovation, long-term thinking, and a commitment to growing manufacturing and prosperity for all. We believe that manufacturing excellence creates opportunities: for careers, for communities, and for lasting impact.

We’re Shift Makers passionate about engineering, dedicated to going the extra mile, and focused on making a difference. Whether it’s solving complex challenges or sharing our deep expertise, we build strong relationships with our customers, our colleagues, and the wider community.

Sound like something you’d like to be part of? We’re looking for a passionate, energetic, and innovative **Technical Sales Engineer** to join our team and play a key role across the North West. The successful candidate must be within less than a one hour commute of the North West, as you will be visiting customers four days a week.

**JOB SUMMARY**

As a **Technical Sales Engineer** for Dormer Pramet, you will play a key role in promoting and selling our innovative range of cutting tools. You will grow business with existing end users and distribution partners, while also identifying and developing new opportunities.

This role involves providing technical advice and support, resolving customer challenges efficiently, and working closely with our distribution network to drive mutual success. You’ll also conduct cutting tool tests, interpret technical drawings, and demonstrate value through cost-saving initiatives.

We’re committed to delivering **“Certainty at Every Step”**, offering excellent training, flexible working options, and a rewarding career in a supportive environment with one of the world’s leading engineering groups.

In return, we offer a competitive benefits package including a 7% employer pension contribution, healthcare support through Westfield and BUPA, hybrid/electric car options, and income protection. You’ll also enjoy flexible working, excellent training, and clear opportunities for career growth.

**PROFILE**

You’ll bring a solid engineering background along with product knowledge and/or sales experience. Strong interpersonal skills and a customer-focused mindset will serve you well, as will being results-driven and resilient. Excellent organisation and negotiation skills are essential, and experience within relevant industry segments is highly desirable.

**ABOUT US**

**Dormer Pramet** is a global manufacturer and supplier of cutting tools for the metalworking industry, with over **100** years of expertise. We operate four global manufacturing centres and have 21 offices, serving customers in over 100 countries. Our tools and solutions support a wide range of sectors - from general machining and maintenance to heavy industry, railway, and airframe assembly.

**HOW TO APPLY** Interested in the challenge? Please click the ‘apply now’ button. For further information visit our website. Closing date: **Friday 18th September 2026**

**Revenue recognition is about to get a lot more interesting.** As we shift from license-based to subscription and AI consumption revenue models, the rulebook for "when is revenue actually revenue" is being rewritten in real time — and we need someone who can write it. If you want a seat at the table where deals get shaped before they're signed, not just booked after the fact, this is that seat.

**Location & working model:** Holon, Hybrid

The Revenue Accountant is the organization's technical authority on when and how revenue is recognized — a role whose importance is amplified dramatically by this shift. Applying ASC 606/IFRS 15 to an evolving portfolio of multi-element contracts — combining SaaS licenses, implementation services, professional services, and usage-based AI consumption fees — you'll ensure revenue recognition is technically correct, consistently applied, and free of restatement risk. You'll also serve as the pre-signature checkpoint for commercial contracts, reviewing non-standard deal structures before they're executed.

##### **Scope & Accountability:**

##### **Revenue Recognition & Technical Accounting**

* Apply ASC 606/IFRS 15 to the organization's contract portfolio — performing multi-element arrangement analysis, identifying and allocating standalone selling prices, and determining the appropriate timing and amount of revenue recognition for each performance obligation.
* Monitor the evolving portfolio of subscription, AI consumption, and professional services arrangements for revenue recognition implications, proactively identifying contract structures or business model changes that create new technical accounting questions.
* Develop, maintain, and communicate revenue recognition accounting policies and procedures across the finance and commercial functions, ensuring consistent application as the organization's contract portfolio evolves through the SaaS transition.

##### **Revenue Close & Reporting**

* Execute revenue recognition-specific month-end close activities: preparing revenue recognition schedules, reconciling deferred revenue accounts, booking revenue journal entries, and producing the revenue management report for financial management review.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring revenue recognition calculations and schedules through ERP-native functionality or specialist revenue recognition platforms, reducing manual effort and improving close-cycle consistency.

##### **Deal Desk & Pre-Signature Review**

* Review non-standard commercial contracts submitted through the Deal Desk approval workflow, assessing revenue recognition implications and providing written guidance before contract execution.
* Serve as the technical accounting checkpoint in the commercial approval process for non-standard deal structures.

##### **Controls & Audit**

* Manage the relationship with external auditors on revenue recognition matters, preparing technical accounting memos, providing audit support workpapers, and resolving revenue accounting queries during audit cycles.
* Administer Sarbanes-Oxley or equivalent internal controls compliance requirements specific to the revenue recognition process, ensuring that controls are designed, documented, and operating effectively.

##### **Your experience & profile:**

* Strong technical grounding in ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition, ideally within enterprise SaaS or software environments.
* Experience with multi-element arrangements, standalone selling price analysis, and complex contract structures.
* Comfortable operating as a pre-signature technical checkpoint, partnering with Deal Desk, Sales, and Legal.
* Experience managing external audit relationships and SOX (or equivalent) controls for revenue processes.
* Familiarity with ERP-native or specialist revenue recognition platforms and an interest in automating manual close activities.
