Savanta is looking for an experienced engineering team lead to lead an agile team building a cutting-edge AI platform for market research.

About Us:

Savanta is a leading data, market research and advisory company helping the world's leading brands make better decisions, faster. With over 500 people across offices in multiple countries, we combine deep research expertise, proprietary technology and high-impact consulting to give our clients a complete view of their markets, their customers and their competitors.

About the Role:

Modern AI has created new possibilities in market research, the ability to use real world market data and AI models to generate synthetic responses to market research questions. You will lead the team responsible for Virtual Personas, Savanta’s synthetic personas solution built using our unique data set.

This role is based in our London office, with the expectation to be onsite 1-3 days per week.  All candidates will be considered equally, however, unfortunately we are unable to offer visa sponsorship.

You will lead up to 4 engineers working in a cross functional agile team alongside a product manager, with input from our UX designer and QA teams. The team is to deliver the product roadmap alongside driving further adoption of cloud first technologies; we are Azure based, with PostgreSQL and MongoDB as our primary data stores and a multi-provider LLM stack (OpenAI, Google Gemini and Anthropic).

We want you to dive in, get your hands dirty, and figure things out, but also to be someone your team can rely on for help and guidance when they need it.

Our Tech Team works within a learning and collaborative environment, where empowerment is key to our success, along with developing a culture of innovation and creating an environment where everyone can excel.

This is a great opportunity to lead engineering in a totally new field using cutting edge technology. Virtual Personas sits at the frontier of applied AI in the industry and has the potential to fundamentally change the way market research is done. Savanta intends to be a pioneer in this area and is putting in the investment to ensure that happens.

You'll also be responsible for:

* Part of a team responsible for setting direction for Virtual Personas
* Delivery of the Product roadmap
* Managing a team consisting of a range of skillsets and experience
* Full stack development, across Python/FastAPI services and React/TypeScript front ends
* Continuously improving the team's processes for iterative development, including embedding automated testing and CI quality gates into a fast-moving AI product
* Championing the responsible and secure use of LLMs - including prompt-injection awareness, defensive design, and sound data handling for personas built on real respondent data
* Setting technical direction for the team
* Interacting directly with customers, understanding their needs, and generalising them
* Finding ways to build fast, scalable, flexible systems without blowing the budget
* Mentoring, supporting, and encouraging our developers
* Conducting regular 121's, setting objectives and assisting with tailored development plans

Our engineering environment includes technologies such as Python (FastAPI), LangChain/ LangGraph for multi-agent LLM orchestration, React/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Azure (App Service, Container Registry, Blob Storage), Docker, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD pipelines.

About You:

You will have a strong engineering background, and a track record of leading teams that have launched and scaled up new products while maintaining good engineering practices. You will be innovative and comfortable with working in a rapidly evolving business area.

Essential Criteria:

* Experience leading agile rapid release iterations, ideally on fast-moving AI/LLM-powered products
* Extensive experience specifically with Python and modern async web frameworks, or experience in closely related languages
* Hands-on experience building or maintaining LLM-powered applications - prompt design, multi-provider integration, and agent orchestration (e.g. LangChain/LangGraph or an equivalent framework)
* Strong RDBMS experience (e.g. PostgreSQL) and comfort with document stores (e.g. MongoDB) and caching layers (e.g. Redis)
* Comfortable working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as part of the daily workflow
* A willingness to learn - new technologies (including emerging AI tooling), our business and platform, and ways of working - is an absolute must
* Full product delivery mindset focused on a tested user experience
* Encourages a test-first approach as part of stories, aiming for high automated coverage, and comfortable establishing CI quality gates (lint, type-check, test) where they don't yet exist
* Runs meetings such as project kick-offs, stakeholder check-ins, and retrospectives
* Comfortable with some ambiguity and shifting priorities in your work environment, and comfortable with managed change
* Confident in using spikes to de-risk work as well as guiding the team in iterating towards a long-term scalable architecture - including hardening AI features against risks such as prompt injection and unbounded model behaviour

Desirable Criteria:

* Experience with FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy, and/or Node/Express
* Experience with React/TypeScript front-end development
* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or other multi-agent/LLM orchestration frameworks
* Experience configuring Azure services (App Service, Container Registry, Blob Storage) or AWS equivalents
* Familiarity with LLM observability/evaluation tooling (e.g. Langfuse) and resilience patterns for third-party AI providers (e.g. circuit breakers, provider fallback)
* Awareness of data protection and AI transparency considerations relevant to handling panel/respondent data and AI-generated outputs (e.g. GDPR, EU AI Act) - as context for engineering decisions, not as a compliance determination
* Experience/interest of informal leadership or formal management experience
* Experience working across team boundaries with stakeholders

## Principal Integration Engineer

### Job Introduction

We are looking for an exceptional Principal Integration Engineer to shape and evolve the Selfridges integration landscape. This is one of the broadest technical roles in the team, spanning almost every technology we run. You’ll define the technical direction, standards and engineering approach for secure, scalable and supportable integrations. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on technical leadership, setting the patterns, standards and platforms that other teams rely on while staying close to design, technical review and leading the modernisation of the estate.

Reporting to the Head of Engineering and Quality, you will translate strategy into delivery leading the modernisation of our integration estate by shaping the integration approach, design and roadmap. You'll work closely with architects, engineering and platform teams to keep integration design decisions aligned to our wider technology strategy.

**Role Responsibility**

Our estate reflects a good blend of build-and-buy technology with established enterprise platforms alongside a growing set of modern digital, cloud and SaaS systems, connected through Oracle SOA & ODI, managed APIs and a GraphQL layer. As with many retailers, some integrations have accumulated over time and now need to be simplified and modernised.

As Principal Integration Engineer, you'll set the technical direction and standards, adopting modern integration patterns and engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, supportable solutions. This includes exploring API-first design, event-driven integration, cloud-native services, and the right use of automation and AI where they add real business value.

You'll also look ahead, helping shape and evolve our current and target-state integration architecture, working with Senior Solution Architects to build the roadmap to get us there.

As Principal Integration Engineer you will:

* Act as the principal technical SME for integration engineering for Selfridges providing deep leadership across various integration solutions
* Own integration delivery and roadmap, ensuring we design & build a coherent system architecture across Selfridges; driving end to end governance, design patterns, coding standards, code review practices and CI/CD approaches that teams adopt in practice
* Define and maintain integration engineering standards, patterns, guardrails, and best practices for system-to-system integrations, APIs, events, and workflows
* Provide hands-on technical leadership for the design and implementation of complex Oracle SOA integrations and related integration technologies
* Drive adoption of modern integration patterns, including API-first design, event-driven architectures, cloud-native, microservices aligned integrations, and reusable integration components secure by design
* Lead a small integration team, setting clear priorities, improving ways of working and ensuring delivery excellence with line management responsibility for internal integration engineers alongside third-party engineers
* Manage integration suppliers and partners providing technical governance, monitoring SLA performance, and ensuring delivery aligns with the established design principles, standards and strategies.
* Mentor and develop integration engineers, raising technical capability, architectural understanding and engineering discipline across the team
* Work closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects and third parties to understand integration requirements, translating them into robust integration designs that balance speed, resilience, supportability and long-term value
* Evaluate opportunities to simplify the integration landscape and introduce more cost-effective, automated and flexible integration approaches
* Collaborate with Solution Architects to define clear boundaries between integration and application layers, keeping integration aligned with our wider IT strategy and target-state architecture
* Monitor technology trends, platform capabilities and industry best practice in integration engineering, using insight and evidence to evolve our integration roadmap
* Oversee ongoing support and maintenance, ensuring business-critical integrations and data flows stay stable and reliable
* Lead integration workshops and design sessions, and take part in technical governance reviewing designs, assuring quality, and presenting at forums where needed

 

**The Ideal Candidate**

* Significant experience working with integrations ideally with a retail background
* Strong, hands-on integration engineering experience with integration platforms such as Oracle Fusion Middleware (SOA/ODI/MFT), Boomi APIM, Graph QL is beneficial
* Experience designing scalable, secure and maintainable integration architectures in a complex enterprise environment
* Solid understanding of APIs such as REST and SOAP, XML and JSON, as well as file-based integrations including EDI and CSV
* A proven track record of owning an integration platform end-to-end, with a strong understanding of modern integration approaches such as headless and microservices architectures.
* Good understanding of Service Oriented Architecture principles, with practical experience designing and building microservices
* Strong understanding of data transformation, mapping, validation and the controls needed to keep data accurate and reliable across integrated systems
* Comfortable with cloud-native building blocks VPC, IAM, containers, API Gateway, Lambda, encryption, TLS, application security and automation
* Experience designing and engineering interfaces for enterprise systems e.g. order management, Xstore, Salesforce, merchandising or Workday is beneficial
* Ability to assess new integration technologies and platform capabilities pragmatically, weighing innovation against cost, maintainability and delivery risk
* Experience using agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, SAFe)
* Experience leading a small integration team setting clear priorities, improving ways of working and ensuring delivery excellence
* Experience mentoring and guiding integration engineers, helping them improve design quality, coding practices and architectural awareness
* A structured, analytical approach to problem-solving, architecture and prioritization comfortable navigating technical complexity, managing trade-offs, and bringing clarity to ambiguous situations
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders

Work with us because you:

* Want to be part of a bank built for the dynamics of the modern world
* Relish a challenge and enjoy a fast-paced, innovative and hardworking culture
* Enjoy finding new and better ways to solve complexity and make things happen
* Want to belong to a diverse culture that stands shoulder to shoulder with minority and underrepresented groups
* Care about society and the environment and want to be part of a business that cares too
* Want to continue to grow professionally and be the best version of yourself

## The Role & Responsibilities

Shawbrook Healthcare (incorporating ThinCats Healthcare, part of Shawbrook Bank) provides flexible asset-backed and cashflow lending solutions of between £2m and £35m, supporting growth and acquisition across the UK healthcare sector.

We have a clear sector strategy, real appetite to deploy capital and an experienced set of decision-makers. What turns that into a market position is execution — and that is where this role sits. As Associate Director, Transaction Management, you will take live healthcare opportunities from term sheet through diligence, credit, legals and completion, owning the process and the pace. You will also work alongside our Origination team on live pitches, helping shape structures and pricing at the point where deals are won.

This is a role for someone who wants to be hands-on in transactions rather than one step removed from them, and who wants their fingerprints on a franchise that is being built now rather than one that is already finished. You will benefit from:

* A **clear sector strategy** and genuine appetite to lend
* A **highly collaborative team culture**, with strong support across Origination, Credit, Portfolio and Operations
* The ability to **move at pace with conviction**, backed by experienced decision-makers
* **Visible impact** — your deals, your relationships, your reputation in a growing franchise
* Structured development, with a **clear path towards Director-level roles** for those who deliver

**Our healthcare coverage** spans elderly, specialist and children's residential care; home care; special educational needs; pharmacy; dental; veterinary; GP practices; day nurseries; private medical (including private hospitals, diagnostics, IVF, therapies, surgical and rehabilitation, aesthetics and MedTech); and ophthalmology. Typical borrowers generate £1m–£15m+ EBITDA.

**Key responsibilities**

***Own transaction execution (primary focus)***

* Combine working alongside Directors and leading the end-to-end execution of healthcare transactions from agreed structure through to drawdown, taking a 'Right First Time' approach to process, systems and data
* Drive momentum across all internal and external stakeholders, holding the timetable and keeping deals decision-ready
* Complete business, sector, market, credit and financial due diligence, including financial, revenue and margin analysis, financial modelling and sensitivity analysis
* Prepare, present and own credit papers through Deal Forum and Investment Committee, with clear, balanced recommendations and high governance standards
* Draft and issue indicative and final term sheets in partnership with Credit and Legal
* Shape facilities, pricing, covenants and protections that work commercially for the client and remain robust through downside scenarios
* Lead legal engagement and documentation, and co-ordinate security, KYC and loan completion
* Manage drawdown dates and deliver effective handovers to Portfolio and Borrower Services

***Support origination on live opportunities***

* Support Directors and Senior Directors at client and advisor meetings, including preparation of pitch materials, indicative structures and pricing
* Provide pricing portal and credit grading input to inform front-end decisions
* Develop tailored debt structures that demonstrate a sound understanding of the borrower's business and sector
* Build and maintain your own relationships across the healthcare professional community — advisors, operators and investors — and build a presence in your local market

## The Person

**Skills and experience**

* Experience gained in a relevant market or environment — for example corporate banking, leveraged finance, structured finance, private credit or debt advisory
* Demonstrable experience of end-to-end transaction and/or project management, ideally including transactions taken to completion
* Sharp credit judgement: confident interrogating financial statements, cash generation, resilience and downside risk, and comfortable with both asset-backed and pure cashflow lending
* Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, with excellent attention to detail
* Commercial edge: a developing instinct for pricing, structure and terms, and an understanding of how to protect returns
* High-pace execution: comfortable running multiple complex workstreams and making decisions with imperfect information
* Influence and communication: excellent written and verbal skills, with the ability to land complex ideas simply for Credit, senior stakeholders, clients and advisors
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise competing demands effectively
* Experience of building and managing multiple stakeholder relationships
* Healthcare sector experience, and an understanding of relevant business models and regulatory frameworks, is an advantage — a real appetite to build that expertise is essential

***Key attributes***

* A genuine desire to be hands-on in the execution of transactions
* Passion for supporting high-growth healthcare businesses and the entrepreneurs behind them
* Self-starter with a can-do attitude and a bias towards resolving issues rather than escalating them
* Ownership of outcomes — committed to getting things right and driving quality
* High integrity, and comfortable being honest and transparent with clients and colleagues
* Adaptable, and supportive of continual improvement in a fast-moving environment
* Potential and ambition to develop into future senior roles within the franchise

## Reward

Your Wellbeing - We take your health and well-being very seriously by providing a range of benefits to give you and your family peace of mind. These include:

* Market leading family friendly policies such as access to our Maternity, Adoption and Paternity policies from Day 1 of your employment
* Free access to Headspace, a mindfulness & meditation digital health app
* Free access to Peppy digital health app that offers personalised support through fertility treatment becoming a parent or menopause
* EAP (Employee Assistance Programme) - Offering you support on a wide range of subjects including financial concerns, mental wellbeing and more general queries around family, work, housing, and health
* Cycle to work scheme
* Discounts on gym membership
* Contributory pension scheme & death in service

* Minimum of 27 days holiday per year
* Option to buy or sell holiday days through our flexi-holiday scheme
* Discounts on gym membership nationwide
* Access to discounts on a range of high street and online brands
* Community support and charitable giving

* Participation in our annual discretionary bonus scheme designed to reward your contribution to our success
* Proudly Shawbrook recognition scheme focused on recognising our role models and thanking our colleagues for a job well done

# Database Administrator (short term contract)

UK

**Database Administrator (contract)** 

 

  

**Who We Are and What We Do** 

 

 

At SilverRail, we're on a mission to reshape the way the world travels, and we're inviting you to be part of this journey. Rail is becoming the go-to choice for short and medium-haul travel worldwide, and we're here to help make it happen. 

  

In the face of the ongoing climate crisis, our vision is crystal clear. We are transforming the online customer experience for rail travel, making it easier than ever for customers to find, buy and use rail. Our cutting-edge technology is the backbone of rail and travel agencies worldwide, making it effortless for travellers to choose the eco-friendly option and reduce their carbon footprint.  

  

We have more than 15 years of trailblazing success behind us, and our teams are spread across the globe, with bases in London, Boston, Brisbane, and Stockholm. We thrive on the philosophy of 'fail-fast-fail-early,' which drives us to find ingenious solutions to complex challenges. 

  

Join us, and help shape the future of travel! 

 

 

  

 

**The Role**    
 

We're looking for a MySQL Database Administrator to join our Engineering team on an initial three-month contract to take ownership of the database infrastructure that underpins SilverRail's rail distribution platforms. These systems process high volumes of search, booking and ticketing transactions for rail operators, retailers and travellers across the UK, Europe, North America and Australia/APAC, so reliability, performance and data integrity are critical to everything we do. 

 

The role sits within the Platform Engineering function and works closely with engineering, infrastructure and platform teams to design, tune and safeguard the databases behind our products over the course of the contract. You'll report to the Engineering Manager (Database & Infrastructure). 

 

We're looking for an experienced contractor with a solid grounding in MySQL database administration who can get up to speed quickly and work autonomously on schema design, query and database optimisation, and cloud-hosted database infrastructure from day one. We are looking for someone who has supported systems with high transaction volumes and strict availability requirements, such as travel, e-commerce or financial services. 

 

 

**Key Responsibilities** 

 

Database Administration & Design 

* Design, implement and maintain MySQL database schemas that support scalable, reliable and high-performance applications.

* Own the day-to-day administration of production MySQL databases, including monitoring, capacity planning and health checks.

* Plan and execute schema changes and migrations with minimal disruption to live services.

* Performance & Optimisation

* Optimise SQL queries, indexes and schema design to improve performance and reduce latency across high-traffic systems.

* Use SQL analytics to investigate performance bottlenecks and inform optimisation and capacity decisions.

* Design and maintain read/write splitting strategies to balance load across primary and replica databases.

 

Cloud Infrastructure 

* Manage and maintain AWS RDS instances, including provisioning, configuration, patching, backups and scaling.

* Support high-availability architecture and disaster recovery planning for database infrastructure.

**Salary and Benefits**: from £100,000 - £140,000 (subject to experience), plus bonus, private medical cover, 38 days annual leave, excellent pension, 12x salary life assurance, career breaks, income protection, 3x volunteering days and much more.

Join Standard Life's expanding Pension Risk Transfer (PRT) business and be part of one of the most exciting growth stories in the UK retirement market. Backed by a recently announced £2bn capital commitment and a bold vision for future growth, we're investing in our people, capabilities and market presence as we support an increasing number of pension schemes through complex de-risking journeys. 

As a Transaction Manager, you'll be at the centre of that growth, taking ownership of transaction pricing, negotiation and execution whilst working alongside industry-leading experts to deliver innovative solutions and outstanding customer outcomes. If you're looking for an opportunity to combine technical expertise, commercial influence and tangible market impact, there has never been a more exciting time to join our team.

**Who are we?**

We’re Standard Life, a retirement specialist focused entirely on retirement savings and income. We champion the belief that everyone’s journey to and through retirement can be better, and for more than 200 years, we’ve been helping our customers plan and prepare for their financial futures.

Life today is increasingly complicated, uncertain and unpredictable. People move through different careers, face unexpected moments and navigate important choices. We offer our colleagues flexibility, trust and benefits that work for whatever life brings. In return we expect curiosity, connection, accountability and high standards. We make room for what matters - so you can bring your best, every day.

**The Opportunity**

You will lead the pricing, negotiation and execution of small and medium-sized Bulk Purchase Annuity transactions, taking responsibility for all aspects of deal management and governance through to contract completion. You will also support senior colleagues on the delivery of larger and more complex transactions. 

Combining strong technical expertise with commercial judgement, you will play a central role in shaping transaction strategy, overseeing pricing and supporting informed and effective decision-making. You will work closely with colleagues across the business to deliver successful transaction outcomes that support our strategy and maintain a clear focus on customers and policyholders. 

A key part of the role will be building strong relationships with trustees, sponsors, advisers and internal stakeholders, while helping to develop the technical capability and future talent of the wider team.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead transaction execution and commercial decision-making**

* Lead all aspects of deal management for small and medium-sized transactions, taking responsibility for delivery from the initial transaction process through to contract completion.
* Support senior colleagues on the delivery of larger and more complex transactions.
* Lead transaction pricing, negotiation and execution, ensuring activity is coordinated effectively across all relevant workstreams.
* Oversee the quality and accuracy of pricing, applying the agreed pricing basis alongside commercial judgement, current market dynamics and Standard Life’s wider strategy.
* Use strong technical and business knowledge to support informed decision-making and successful commercial outcomes.
* Contribute to the legal aspects of transactions and work closely with internal and external legal advisers to support effective execution.

**Deliver robust risk management and governance**

* Ensure transactions are delivered in line with relevant risk management and governance requirements.
* Take responsibility for relevant audits, documentation and annual reviews.
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, quality and governance across all areas of transaction delivery.

**Provide technical and strategic expertise**

* Act as an actuarial subject matter expert on strategic business and Group-level projects.
* Provide specialist technical input to support business decision-making and the delivery of strategic priorities.
* Apply knowledge of pension liabilities, complex benefit structures and Bulk Purchase Annuity pricing to support transaction development and execution.
* Use external market developments and internal information to provide meaningful insight and inform commercial decision-making.

**Build trusted relationships and communicate with impact**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with trustees, sponsors and advisers to UK Defined Benefit pension schemes.
* Communicate complex actuarial and technical information clearly and credibly to specialist audiences.
* Develop trusted relationships across the business, including with Senior Leadership, Finance, Capital Management, Asset Management and Line 2.
* Contribute to relevant pipeline, marketing, brand and PR activity where required.

**Lead, develop and collaborate**

* Lead, coach and mentor actuarial trainees and analysts, helping individuals to maximise their contribution and develop their careers.
* Support recruitment activity and the development of a strong internal talent pipeline.
* Work collaboratively across Capital Management and Asset Management to support workload prioritisation and the effective delivery of transactions.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, ways of working and the use of technology across the transaction process.
* Promote a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture across the team and wider business.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for an experienced pensions professional with a strong track record of leading and managing the execution of Bulk Purchase Annuity transactions, or similar work gained within an Employee Benefit Consultancy, bulk annuity provider or reinsurer.

You will bring strong technical expertise, including experience valuing pension liabilities and working with complex pension benefit structures. You will also have experience working directly with trustees, sponsors and advisers to UK Defined Benefit pension schemes, either within an insurer or DB pensions consultancy. 

Commercially minded and results-focused, you will be comfortable overseeing pricing, applying commercial judgement and making effective decisions in a fast-moving transaction environment. You will be able to balance commercial objectives with the need for robust governance, risk management, accuracy and positive customer outcomes.

You will be a confident relationship manager and communicator, able to convey technical actuarial information clearly to specialist audiences while making complex issues accessible to broader business stakeholders. You will also have experience training, managing and developing more junior colleagues. 

Knowledge of the Solvency UK regulatory regime and the pricing of Bulk Purchase Annuity transactions would be beneficial, as would an established network across the Defined Benefit pensions market, including Employee Benefit Consultants, legal firms and professional trustees.  
 

**Personal Attributes**  
  
This role would suit someone who is;

* Commercially astute, applying sound judgement to pricing, negotiation and transaction decision-making.
* Technically strong, with the ability to analyse complex pension liabilities, benefit structures and transaction considerations.
* An influential communicator, able to present complex issues and recommendations clearly to stakeholders at all levels.
* Relationship-led, building credibility and trusted relationships with clients, advisers and internal stakeholders.
* Results-focused, delivering accurate and high-quality outcomes within demanding transaction timescales.
* Risk-aware, maintaining strong governance and professional standards throughout the transaction process.
* Collaborative, working effectively across organisational boundaries to deliver shared outcomes.
* Improvement-focused, identifying opportunities to strengthen processes, technology and ways of working.
* A supportive leader, coaching and developing colleagues while contributing to a strong team culture.

**Qualifications & Certifications**

* Fellow of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries.
* Applicants will ideally hold a university degree, or equivalent qualification, in a relevant field.

**We want to hire the whole version of you.**

We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels accepted and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If your experience looks different from what we’ve advertised and you believe that you can bring value to the role, we’d love to hear from you.

# Project Manager - Energy & Resources | Expression of Interest

## United Kingdom, GBR

The UK energy sector is undergoing rapid transformation. Increasing demand, evolving regulation, network investment and ambitious net zero targets are driving some of the most significant infrastructure programmes in a generation.

At Stantec, we're supporting clients across the energy landscape to deliver the projects that will power the future. We're looking for Project Managers to join our growing Energy team's talent pool and play a key role in delivering complex, high-impact projects that support the UK's energy transition.

With opportunities available across our UK offices, you'll work on some of the industry's most exciting and technically challenging projects while helping to create a more sustainable future.

**About the Role**

As a Project Manager, you'll lead the successful delivery of multidisciplinary energy projects across a diverse portfolio of sectors. This could include Transmission & Distribution, HVDC and interconnector schemes, wind farms, solar and renewable energy developments, Energy from Waste facilities, hydropower and dam projects, substations, overhead line infrastructure, connections schemes, protection and control systems, LVAC solutions, FEED studies, and both new-build and refurbishment programmes. You'll also have the opportunity to support projects involving geotechnical and building design solutions. Working closely with technical teams, clients and key stakeholders, you'll oversee projects from inception through to completion, ensuring delivery against programme, budget and quality objectives while helping to shape the future of the UK's energy infrastructure.

**Your Impact**

You'll help deliver critical infrastructure that supports the decarbonisation of the UK's energy system while contributing to projects that make a tangible difference to communities and the environment.

Key responsibilities will include:

* Leading multidisciplinary project teams through the full project lifecycle
* Managing project scope, budgets, schedules, risks and change control processes
* Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, contractors and internal stakeholders
* Supporting the successful delivery of complex engineering and infrastructure projects
* Ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to a high standard of quality
* Contributing to the continued growth and success of our Energy business

As part of a collaborative and expanding team, you'll work alongside industry specialists on projects that are shaping the future of energy across the UK.

**About You**

We're interested in hearing from individuals who have experience managing complex engineering, infrastructure or energy-related projects and can demonstrate a strong understanding of project delivery principles.

You'll ideally bring:

* Experience delivering projects within the Energy, Power or closely related sectors
* A recognised project management qualification such as APM PMQ or equivalent
* Experience managing project budgets, programmes and commercial aspects of delivery
* Knowledge of risk management and change control processes across the project lifecycle
* The ability to lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including design disciplines
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* A collaborative approach and commitment to safe working practices

Experience working within regulated industries would be advantageous.

The Group Treasury & Cashflow Manager will strengthen and further develop Strata’s Group-wide approach to treasury, cashflow visibility and liquidity planning. Working across all seven operating companies - Strata Create, Wonderland, Element, On Event Production Co., Trinity Event Solutions, Collider and Sherbet - together with the holding company and any entity operating outside the UK, the role will provide a clear, forward-looking view of cash, funding requirements and financial commitments to support confident commercial decision-making.

Our work is project-based, with costs, deposits, supplier prepayments, freelance crew, venue commitments and staged client billing often moving at different speeds, in different currencies, across seven businesses. Major productions can create material short-term movements in Group cash, so this role brings structure, consistency and insight to the cashflow view, ensuring treasury supports growth, operational discipline and informed decision-making.

The role reports to the Group CFO, works closely with the Group COO, and is the Group's single point of contact for banks, facility providers and our investors on all matters of liquidity, covenant and cash. It works collaboratively with finance leads in each operating company, sharing standards, systems and best practice. This is a build role - the model, the policy and the banking relationships are owned from day one.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Cashflow Forecasting*

* Build and run a rolling 13-week direct cashflow forecast at Group and operating company level, refreshed weekly
* Own the medium-term view - 12-month (rolling) cashflow bridged to budget and forecast
* Forecast at project level for major productions, so cash exposure is visible before the Group commits, not after
* Track forecast accuracy, explain variances and improve the model each cycle
* Set the standard for operating company forecast submissions and challenge them where they do not hold up

*Liquidity & Banking*

* Manage day-to-day Group liquidity and headroom, with a known cash position across every account every morning
* Own bank and facility relationships, drawdowns and account structure
* Assess and implement cash pooling or sweeping where the entity structure allows
* Maintain and stress-test covenant headroom, and produce covenant compliance reporting to the required calendar
* Manage all investor interest payments (facility, loan note & other related)
* Own the payment run, authorisation matrix and banking controls across all entities

*Working Capital*

* Drive working capital performance across the Group: debtor days, creditor terms, WIP, unbilled revenue, deposit and staged-payment discipline
* Set and monitor working capital targets by operating company with the Group CFO and COO
* Work with commercial and finance leads to fix causes rather than chase symptoms - billing milestones that do not match delivery, contracts signed on terms we cannot fund, purchase orders raised without cash cover
* Support debtor escalation with evidence, working alongside account leads

*Risk, FX & Structure*

* Identify and manage foreign currency exposure on international projects and supplier commitments
* Recommend and execute a hedging policy that is proportionate rather than exotic
* Manage intercompany funding, balances and settlement, keeping positions clean and documented
* Own counterparty and payment fraud controls
* Work with the Group CFO and external advisers on the treasury implications of entity structure, including entities operating outside the UK

*Reporting & Governance*

* Produce the weekly cash report to the executive and the treasury pack for Board and investor reporting
* Draft, implement and maintain the Group treasury policy and delegated authority framework
* Support funding events, refinancing and transaction-related cash reporting
* Provide cash and funding input to acquisition activity and integration planning

*Systems & Continuous Improvement*

* Own the treasury toolset, assessing whether current systems are fit for a group of this scale and leading selection and implementation if they are not
* Automate the manual - consolidating seven spreadsheets by hand is not a long-term answer
* Define, document and maintain treasury processes and frameworks, scaling them as the business grows

*Collaboration Across Strata and the Group*

* Partner closely with operating company finance leads, Managing Directors and commercial teams
* Build treasury literacy across the Group so cash discipline is understood at brief stage, not at invoice stage
* Contribute to Group-wide procurement, banking and supplier consolidation initiatives

As our **Software Engineer (Data)**, you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.

You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.

# **What you’ll be working on**

* **Own everything that flows into Ben:** build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.
* **Keep everything running on time:** own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.
* **Scale and manage our data infrastructure:** build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.
* **Connect Ben to every system our customers run:** build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.
* **Build the data layer our agents act on:** help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.
* **Shape what we build:** work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.
* **Build it to enterprise standard:** build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

# **Behind the scenes**

Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.

Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.

We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.

# **Your skills and experience**

* Strong experience with **Python** and **SQL**.
* A few years **building and running production data pipelines** that other people relied on.
* Comfortable with **infrastructure as code**, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.
* A good grasp of **ETL/ELT and orchestration**.
* Experience **building or running data integrations and connectors**, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.
* **Solid software engineering fundamentals**: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.
* You keep **security in mind** when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.

# **Nice to have, not essential**:

* Experience working on **customer-facing data integrations** such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format
* Experience with **MCP server development**, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.

We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.

# 

# **Why join us?**

Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.

At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them.

You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries.

🧠 ***Comprehensive mental health support and professional coaching** through a leading provider*

# Senior Controls Manager

**Advert Closes: Wednesday 16th September**

**Senior Controls Manager at The Crown Estate**

***Are you an experienced controls, audit or risk professional with a passion for finance transformation and ERP delivery?***

This is a rare opportunity to play a pivotal role in one of The Crown Estate's most significant transformation programmes, leading the design, implementation and ongoing governance of a robust financial and technology controls environment that will support the organisation long into the future.

**What You'll Be Doing**

At The Crown Estate, we create lasting and shared value for the nation. As Senior Controls Manager, you will lead all controls-related activities within our ERP replacement programme, ensuring the new platform meets regulatory, audit, risk and financial reporting requirements while supporting efficient and effective business operations.

Reporting to the Process Lead, you'll act as the key link between Finance, Technology, Risk, Internal Audit and external delivery partners, helping to build a scalable controls framework that strengthens governance, supports decision-making and drives continuous improvement.

Following implementation, you'll assume ownership of the Finance Controls Framework, ensuring controls remain effective, compliant and aligned to business needs as the organisation continues to evolve.

**The Opportunity**

This role offers the chance to shape and lead the controls agenda across a large-scale transformation programme and beyond.

During the ERP programme, you will:

* Lead the end-to-end controls workstream.
* Define the controls strategy, scope and controls catalogue aligned to the Finance taxonomy and organisational risk appetite.
* Oversee the design and implementation of financial controls, automated controls, configurable controls, reporting controls and IT General Controls (ITGCs).
* Ensure alignment between process design, ERP configuration, integrations and controls requirements.
* Challenge and guide implementation partners on control design and best practice.
* Lead controls testing, remediation activities and audit readiness activities.
* Support cutover planning, go-live readiness and hypercare, ensuring controls-related sign-off requirements are achieved.
* Develop segregation of duties frameworks, access control models and conflict mitigation strategies.

Following go-live, you will:

* Own and maintain the Finance Controls Framework.
* Establish governance forums and controls performance reporting.
* Monitor controls effectiveness through KPIs, assurance activities and issue management processes.
* Lead periodic controls reviews, walkthroughs and risk assessments.
* Ensure future system enhancements and organisational changes continue to operate within a robust control environment.
* Drive control automation, simplification and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Build controls capability across Finance and Technology teams through training, coaching and stakeholder engagement.

You'll also act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, preparing governance papers, controls reporting and Audit Committee updates while helping to foster a culture of strong control ownership and accountability.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who combines deep controls expertise with the confidence and credibility to influence stakeholders across a complex transformation environment.

You'll bring:

* Significant experience in finance controls, internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR), SOX or UK equivalent control frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and implementing controls within major ERP programmes such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar.
* Excellent knowledge of financial processes including Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, FP&A and Tax.
* Deep understanding of IT General Controls, application controls, access management, segregation of duties and data integrity controls.
* Experience working closely with Internal Audit, Risk and Technology functions.
* A professional qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CIA, CISA or equivalent.
* Experience within audit, risk management, internal controls advisory, finance transformation or consulting environments.
* Great analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex processes and system designs.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to challenge constructively while building trusted relationships.
* A highly organised and methodical approach with strong governance and documentation skills.
* The ability to remain calm under pressure while delivering high-quality outcomes within a complex programme environment.

**Why Join The Crown Estate?**

You'll have the opportunity to influence a business-critical transformation programme while helping to create lasting value for the country. Working alongside talented colleagues and senior leaders, you'll play a key role in embedding a modern, effective and sustainable controls environment that supports our long-term ambitions.

**Our Offering / benefits:**

As well as a competitive salary, pension and performance related bonus offering, we have a wealth of benefits available ranging from flexible working; market leading family policies and shopping discounts in the West End, to private healthcare; life and critical illness cover and 28 days holiday with the option to buy more. We value work life balance and your wellbeing highly, enabling you to be your best self to work.

**Disability Disclaimer:**

We are a proud disability confident employer and operate the offer of interview scheme **Disability Confident employer scheme - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk)**.

We are happy to offer alternative application methods or formats and can be flexible on our process to enable you to have the best opportunity.

If you have any questions about our recruitment process or would like to talk about adjustments, please contact us directly, or at careers@thecrownestate.co.uk

Please note that if we receive a high volume of applications, we may close this advert early. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible

**We're on a mission to protect society from fraud and money laundering.** We've already protected over 3 million people through life's big transactions.

Fraud and regulation are rising, costing the UK economy over £100bn every year; this makes it more difficult for businesses to protect themselves and their clients - individuals like you and me - from fraud and money laundering.

Our co-founders Olly and Jack were led to this area when a friend was defrauded of £25K when buying their first property. At the time, anti-fraud technology didn't exist, which meant that completing the anti-fraud checks required in these processes was largely manual. These big life moments should be exciting, but instead are often confusing and scary due to the painful process of completing these paper-based checks and the risk of fraud.

Thirdfort helps businesses to facilitate these anti-fraud checks so that individuals know they can transact safely and seamlessly with professionals during these big transactions. Our anti-fraud platform provides a secure way for professionals in regulated sectors like Lawyers, Estate Agents and Accountants to transfer funds and verify sensitive information through app-based document checks, facial recognition and open banking.

***While the role is ideally full-time, we’re open to considering candidates able to work 30 hours per week for the right candidate.***

Turning Point is a leading Social Enterprise which supports people with a wide range of complex needs across Learning Disabilities, Mental Health, Substance Use and Public Health. As Clinical Lead, you will play a pivotal role in delivering safe, effective and evidence‐based care to people accessing our service in Wakefield. Working with some of our most complex service users, you will combine hands‐on clinical expertise with strong leadership to ensure consistently high standards of care and positive outcomes.

You will be central to the clinical direction of the service, providing leadership across clinical governance, supervision and appraisal, workforce development, and service innovation. We are proud to be a responsive, forward‐thinking service, proactively addressing emerging trends such as ketamine use among adults and young people, and the growing risk of synthetic opioids (e.g. nitazenes).

With extensive experience in the substance use field, you will be a key contributor to the ongoing delivery and development of high‐quality clinical interventions. You will work collaboratively with the Wakefield management team, clinicians, local health partners and wider stakeholders to design and deliver holistic, person‐centred care that supports service users throughout their recovery journey.

This role offers a genuine opportunity to shape service delivery, lead clinical innovation and help build a service recognised for clinical excellence. We are looking for a dynamic, motivated and forward‐thinking Clinical Lead who is passionate about achieving the very best outcomes for the people we support.

Turning Point is committed to the on-going professional development of all our staff and we offer regular structured supervision, a well-developed monthly CPD program and full support with appraisals and revalidation. Through joining Turning Point, you will receive a warm welcome, extensive training, and the chance to thrive in a lively and aspirational service and organisation.

Turning Point has several integrated Substance Use services and the Clinical Leads meet regularly providing invaluable peer support for one another, supported via the Clinical Director

The successful candidate will:

* have appropriate experience in addiction medicine at a clinical leadership level:
* be a ‘Specialist’ doctor in addiction: either a Consultant Addiction Psychiatrist or a specialist doctor from another background such as General Practice, who has the appropriate experience & qualifications (as per the RCPsych / RCGP Competency Framework)

* We are here to embrace change even when it is complex and uncomfortable
* We treat each other and those we support as individuals however difficult and challenging
* We deliver better outcomes by encouraging ideas and new thinking
* We commit to building a strong and financially viable Turning Point together

As a leading health and social care provider with more than 300 locations across England, we take real pride in the services we offer.

* Support clients in the development and application of laser processing and related equipment.

* Deliver technical solutions to meet the client’s needs within planned budget and timescale.

* A degree or equivalent qualification in a science or engineering discipline.
* Demonstrable experience in welding/materials processing.
* The ability to work alone on your own initiative and as an effective part of the team.

This is one of the most exciting problems in applied AI right now: take the cutting edge of machine learning, optimisation, and agentic systems, and make it work inside real businesses — not in a lab, but on live customer problems where the answer has to hold up commercially.

**About the role:**

In this role the successful candidate will work alongside a talented group of engineers and scientists supporting the industrialisation of Li-ion batteries and cells. Reporting to the Head of Product Engineering this position will support the capture and analysis of data generated from the production and test of UKBIC baseline and customer products.

 

The purpose of this role is to deliver data insights that assess the impact of manufacturing variation on product performance, thereby determining product and process improvement opportunities to enable successful scale-up to quality.

 

The company has recently deployed a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to capture equipment, process and quality data across its facilities and is developing the associated data pipelines into Siemens Insights Hub. This role will act as the Product Engineering owner and internal customer for analytics capability development, working closely with the Data Engineer and Manufacturing Systems Integration Engineer to define data structures, traceability requirements, dashboards and analytical workflows. The successful candidate will help shape the evolution of Insights Hub from foundational time-series data visualisation and reporting through to advanced statistical analysis, modelling, machine learning and predictive analytics capabilities.

 

The analytics capability is expected to evolve in stages, beginning with establishing access to manufacturing and test data through time-series visualisation and traceability, before advancing into variable-to-variable correlations, process characterisation, feature engineering, statistical modelling, predictive analytics and machine learning. The successful candidate will play a leading role in defining and delivering this capability roadmap.

**Key Deliverables**

In summary, the key deliverables for this role are:

1.     
Define and deliver the Product Engineering analytics roadmap for Siemens Insights Hub.

2.     
Deliver and report data insights to customer and internal programmes, on time and to target.

3.     
Develop and continuously improve analytical methods, models and tools that support data-driven decision making.

4.     
Capture, document and communicate analytical methods, models and findings to build organisational capability.

5.     
Develop code to support the above activity and implement processes that ensure these are stored securely and version controlled.

**Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities**

* Act as the Product Engineering owner and internal customer for Siemens Insights Hub analytics capability development.
* Define data, traceability, reporting and dashboard requirements in collaboration with Data Engineering and Manufacturing Systems Integration teams.
* Promote a culture of data-driven decision making through effective analysis, visualisation and communication of insights.
* Determine relationships between manufacturing process parameters, quality measurements, defects and product performance.
* Analyse manufacturing and test data to identify trends, root causes and opportunities for product, process, yield and quality improvement.
* Develop derived metrics, calculated features and engineering insights from raw manufacturing and test data.
* Apply statistical methods, data modelling and machine learning techniques to improve process understanding and predict product outcomes.
* Create and programme data models and analytical tools using simulated and real-world datasets to support engineering and business decisions.
* Provide analytical inputs to other engineering capabilities, including product and process simulation activities.
* Implement and execute good practice in the secure storage and control of developed code.
* Make data-driven recommendations that facilitate the continuous improvement of manufacturing processes and product performance

**Key Interactions**

* As well as working directly with Product Engineering peers the Data scientists will work cross functionally within the project team including:
* **Manufacturing Engineering & Quality** – Capturing and post processing of on-line of off-line measurement data. Determine data dashboard requirement for Siemens Insights Hub.
* **Digital Manufacturing** –  Working closely with the Data Engineer and Manufacturing Systems Integration Engineer as the Product Engineering customer for Siemens Insights Hub. Define data, traceability and analytics requirements, validate delivered capabilities and help shape the roadmap from basic reporting through to advanced analytics and predictive modelling
* **Product engineering** –  Analysing product performance, quality and validation data to identify trends, establish relationships with manufacturing processes and support product and process improvement activities.

job_description:
## **The role**

At Wayve, we are building AI that learns to drive from experience.

We do not hand-code cars to drive. We train our models from data gathered across the real world, making our ability to identify, understand and learn from the right data fundamental to everything we build.

We are looking for a VP of Data to lead the data strategy behind our autonomous driving technology.

This is a senior engineering leadership role with end-to-end ownership of how Wayve uses data to improve our AI. You will determine what data we need, how we acquire it, how we understand and enrich it, and ultimately how we turn it into measurable improvements in model performance.

The scale and shape of the problem is unique. Our data comes from our own vehicles, OEM programmes, partners and external sources, spanning different vehicles, sensors, markets and driving environments. Within that corpus, the most valuable examples are often the hardest to find: rare behaviours, unusual interactions, safety-critical events and the long tail of real-world driving.

Your job is not simply to build the systems that process this data. It is to decide what data matters and why, and build the strategy, organisation and learning loop that allows Wayve to learn from it faster.

You will lead Wayve’s Data organisation and provide senior ownership for data within Engineering, partnering closely across AI, Science, Validation, Product, Compute and our commercial teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own Wayve’s data strategy:** Set the strategy across the complete AI learning cycle, determining what data we need and how it should drive model performance, from foundation model training through specialised driving capabilities and production programmes.
* **Build the data flywheel:** Own the learning loop from real-world signals and model behaviour through data discovery, curation and enrichment into training, evaluation, deployment and measurement.
* **Find the data that matters:** Develop intelligent approaches to discovering rare, surprising and safety-critical scenarios within extremely large datasets, using techniques such as embeddings, semantic search, learned representations and model-driven data selection.
* **Lead data acquisition and enrichment:** Define how Wayve collects, buys, generates and enriches data across our own fleet, OEM programmes, partners and external sources, balancing coverage, quality, speed and economics.
* **Connect data investment to model performance:** Establish how we measure the value of data and make rigorous trade-offs across quality, accuracy, speed, cost and scale, ensuring investment is focused where it creates the greatest impact.
* **Scale our data strategy globally:** Build an approach that supports multiple OEMs, vehicle platforms, sensor configurations, geographies and regulatory environments while maintaining a scalable global architecture.
* **Build and lead the organisation:** Lead and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary Data organisation, partnering closely with AI, Science, Validation, Product, Compute, Finance and Commercial teams.

**About You**

You are a senior technical leader who has operated at the intersection of AI, data and large-scale model development.

You can set direction in ambiguity and make high-quality decisions without perfect information. You are equally comfortable going deep into the characteristics and value of a dataset, challenging how a team measures model improvement, making significant investment decisions, or defining how an organisation should operate.

You have strong technical judgement, but think about data through the impact it has on the intelligence and performance of the system, rather than simply the infrastructure required to store and process it.

You can hold the full system in your head while still going deep on the details that matter.

**Essential**

* Significant engineering leadership experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing technical organisations.
* Deep technical expertise in computer vision, video, multimodal AI or related perception problems.
* Experience leading large-scale data capabilities that directly influence model training, evaluation and performance.
* Strong intuition for what makes data valuable, with experience in data discovery, selection, curation and enrichment at scale.
* Strong technical and commercial judgement, including making trade-offs across quality, speed, cost, scale and build-versus-partner decisions.
* Ability to move between strategy and technical detail, set direction in ambiguity, and influence effectively across senior technical and business stakeholders.

**Desirable**

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a strong advantage:

* Autonomous driving, robotics or embodied AI.
* Large-scale video, multimodal or foundation model training.
* Semantic search, embeddings, active learning, auto-labelling or other approaches to intelligent data selection and enrichment.
* Large-scale real-world data acquisition across fleets, customers, partners or multiple geographies.

Yorkshire and the Humber are looking to recruit a number of Senior Crime Scene Investigators to be based across the YaTH region, in substantive and acting up positions for the next 12 months.

The CSI Hubs are situated in: Ossett, Leeds, Bradford, Sheffield, York, Thirsk, Harrogate, Scarborough, Hull & Scunthorpe.    
  
Candidates should be Advanced Crime Scene Investigators, or equivalent, showing potential to progress to the role of Senior Crime Scene Investigators.  
  
This is an ideal opportunity for individuals who are wishing to progress their career within the Crime Scene Investigation profession. Candidates will have knowledge of the practical techniques used to examine more serious and major crime scenes.

Candidates will be capable of learning quickly, have good communication skills, and be able to deal with the effects of crime ranging from dealing appropriately with distressed victims, through to the impact on individuals at scenes of extreme violence.  
  
In addition, you must hold a full current UK/European driving license, and have a flexible, positive attitude to borderless working to ensure a full regional Crime Scene Investigation service.  
  
**Training and Development**  
Senior Crime Scene Investigators in the region are trained to high national standards, working to strict regulations and procedures. If not already qualified as a Senior Crime Scene Investigator, successful candidates will attend the College of Policing Crime Scene Investigation Stage 2 course. This will be delivered locally, over 4 weeks, on full-time hours Monday to Friday. On successful completion of the Stage 2 training course, and the associated Senior Crime Scene Investigator Baseline Assessment, you will work independently attending all types of crime scenes, including serious and major crime, recovering forensic evidence in support of criminal investigations.  
  
**Remuneration and work pattern**  
You will be expected to work in a 7-day, 24 hour rotating shift pattern. This includes night-time working if based in West or South Yorkshire OR participating in an overnight on call rota if based in North Yorkshire or the Humberside area. The shift pattern includes weekend working with two weekends out of three worked. You will be paid monthly; plus additional shift and weekend working allowances, and on-call payments in North Yorkshire and the Humberside areas.

You will be entitled to a generous annual leave allowance, which increases with service. You will be automatically enrolled into the local government pension scheme. All candidates will have opportunity to develop into the advanced Senior CSI role.  
  
**Assessment and Interview**  
Candidates will need to complete an electronic application form. From this, successful candidates will be invited to our CSI Training Centre in Wetherby for a practical scene assessment. Candidates will be offered a 2-hour time slot on either 12th, 13th or 14th October.  
Candidates who meet the prior agreed pass mark on practical assessment will be invited to a CVF based interview. Interviews will take place between 19th – 22nd October at Wetherby. Interview dates and times will be confirmed with candidates at the conclusion of all practical assessments.  
If applying for the role, you will need to be available during these dates, to fulfil both parts of the process, alternative dates will not be offered.  
  
A regional succession list will be held from this process for 12 months from the 22nd October for ALL acting and substantive positions.

* Define and maintain alert severity standards that clearly distinguish P1 vs. P2 vs. P3 vs. informational alerts, ensuring consistent classification across all services.
* Review "missed detection" findings from the Major Incident Manager's Post-Incident Reviews and build new monitoring coverage to prevent recurrence of undetected issues.
* Ensure every alert in the ecosystem links to a documented runbook with clear response procedures that Engineers can execute independently.

* Build revenue impact calculation models for use during major incidents, enabling the team to quantify business impact in dollar terms.
* Define and maintain business KPI dashboards monitoring operational metrics including handle, active users, concurrent sessions, bet volume per minute, and Caesars Rewards pipeline health.

* Collaborate with the Problem Manager to support event readiness by building enhanced dashboards, lowering detection thresholds, and adding event-specific synthetic monitors per the readiness plan.

* Partner with product and engineering teams to agree on monitoring thresholds and ensure observability is built into the development lifecycle.

* 5+ years of experience in IT operations, site reliability engineering, observability engineering, or a senior technical monitoring role.

You will have proven experience of delivering basic welfare benefits advice in a housing or public sector setting and an ability to work closely with others to deliver excellent customer service.

**What will my working week look like?**

No two weeks will be the same! You will be responsible for assessing all referrals into the Welfare Benefit & Debt Advice team. As the first point of contact into the team you will assist with low level benefit enquiries from customers and the income team and assign more complex cases to the Welfare Benefit & Debt Advice Officers. This role will also involve collaborative working with Welfare Benefit & Debt Advice Officers, colleagues in the Income and Housing Management Teams, DWP and Local Authority partners.

There is an increasing demand for the YHG Welfare Benefit & Debt Advice Service in response to the cost of-living crisis and you will need to demonstrate resilience working in a demanding and challenging environment.

Ideally, you will live within 25 miles of our Head Office in Warrington as you will need to be based within a reasonable travelling distance to attend meetings and training courses when needed.

**What will I be responsible for doing?**

First and foremost, you will co-ordinate the triaging of referrals into the welfare benefits team, supporting with low level benefit enquiries, supporting customers to address any urgent/emergency support and assigning cases to the Welfare Benefit & Debt Advice Officers further, specialist support.

You will also support the team and YHG by assessing customers that are moving into YHG properties, ensuring affordability and income maximisation, providing guidance on any benefit issues/constraints that accepting a property offer may bring.

One of the great things about this role is that it brings a real opportunity for you to support our customers with their financial and wider wellbeing and really make a difference to their lives!

**And what would make me stand out from the crowd?**

To be a successful Welfare Benefit & Debt Advice Triage Officer**,** here at YHG, you will be....

* A good understanding of welfare benefits
* Ability to manage own workload
* Able to sensitively explore customer circumstances.
* Passionate about customer service and outcomes for customers
* A strong communicator with a high level of attention to detail and enjoy working as part of a fast- paced team

* have excellent customer care skills
* be well organised, self-motivated and a problem solver
* have strong communication and interpersonal skills
